sgrob dpon pra bha hasnyi la sa phrin las phur pa'i chos skor rnams dang / ta zig gi yul du slob dpon dha na sam skri ta'i zhal snga nas srid pa ma mo'i chos skor rnams dang / yul phu lung nag por slob dpon rom bu gu hya la sa 'jis rten mchod bstod kyi chos skor rnams dang / mon gyi yu' du slob dpon shānni sar bha'i spyin snga nas dmod pa drag sngags kyi chos skor rnams gsan pa ste rig 'dzin chen po brgyad las sgrub sde brgyad dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba las sgyu 'phruzhwa gyi chos skor gsan pa sogs 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub du ma las mdo rgyud rigs pa'i gnas rnams la sbyangs pa'i tshul bstan pas chos gang la'ang chags thogs mi mnga' ba mkhas pa'i khyu mchog sacig ngu ra gyur to/ de nas slob dpon gyis za hor yul khams thams cad bdul bya'i zhing du gzigs te/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling nas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te skyed mos tshal gyi bar snang la skyel mo spung gis bzhugs pa dag rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi sra sa mo lha lcam man da ra ba lubor dang bcas pas mardol nas rim gyis pho brang du sadan drangs te rin po che'i khri'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ chogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams rshang dkor nor che rgu thams cad phyag rten du phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba las/ yo ga rnam pa gsum gyi chos gsungs te thams cad smin cing grol bar mardod/ de'i tshe man da ra ba mtha' mi dbe sbyong zhig dang bsdebs nas 57

gda' zhes yul mi rnams kyis klan ka 'tshol ba la brten/ rgyal po gtsug las 'dzin thugs rab tu 'khrugs te zhe sngang me ltar 'bar bar gyur nas / za hor gyi yul mi 'bum phrag bcu bdun tsam la tsan dan gyi shing dang / stal mar gyi khral bsdus te gson bsregs kyis lung pa thams cad me dud chen pos gang bar byas so/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa dang / rgyal chen ris bzhi sogs dkar phyogs kyi lha dang dam can srung ma skar tshogs bkram pa bzhin ra mdar byon/ slob dpon chen pos sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis skad cig la me dpung chen po mtsho ru bsgyur/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog par mdzad/ thugs kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis za hor yul khams thams cad kyi khams dang / dbang po dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen pas gdul bya'i zhing mchog tu gyur par gzigs shing bzhugs pa na/ rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin 'khe ra dang bcas pas ngo mtshar phul du byung ba thob nas 'gyod tshangs phul / slob dpo na gyi sku la rgyal po'i na bza' rin thang bajiod du med pa'i zab ber sngo khra dang / le brgan gyi na bza' sobs za 'og gi ber chen lnga rim gyis brtsegs mar gsol/ dbu zhwa pad 'dab can sogs rgyal po'i rgyan gos thams cad rdzogs par spras te phul/ rol mo'i tshogs kyi mchod pa du mas mchod cing shing rta la bzhugs su gsol te pho brang du spyan drangs/58

de nas lha lcam gzungs mar phul te rgyal pos dbu ma dzad rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa gcig la mkha' 'gro 'khrigs pa'i dben gnas dur khrod chen po dga' ba'i tshal du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur thams cad rdzobs par gnang zhing za hor yul khams thams cad nges legs kyi lam la bkod par mdzwad do/ de nas 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i phyir brag phugamā ra ti kar byon te ma gon po tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shing tshe yi rig 'dzin zla ba gsum dang zhag bdun du sgrub par mardod/ de'i tshe mdun gyi bar snang la mgon po tshe dpag me da dngos su byon pa'i zhal gzisas /gu ru yab yum gyi spyi bor bum pa bzhag zhal du 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi blud/tshe rgyud bye ba phrag brgya gnang nas 'khor ba ma stongs pa'i bar du rdo rje'i sku la skye 'chi med pa'i dbang bskur mchog tu grub pa thob pa'i tshe 'chi med pad ma 'byung gnas su grags/ de nas slar rmi nga gu ru yab yu ma ldom bu bar brdzus nas a rgyacha/ gyi grong khyer chen por bsod stoms la byon pa 'i tshe/ khams kyi rgyasmu phran rnams kyis ngo shes te bdud blon rnams dang lhan cig rgyal po la gsang thabs kyis sdig pa spyi khur byas te/ yab yum lhan cig tsan dan gyi me la gson sre ga zhus pa na/ stal mar zhing dor tsam zhig mtshor 'khyelī ba'i dbus su sol phung se dkyil na me tog pad ma'i sdong po khri 'phang 'khor lo bzhi pa'i tshad tsam gyi steng du yab 59

yum gnyis sangs rgyas langs spyo da rdzogs pa'i cha lugs su 'khril sbuor mdzad cing / 'gro ba rnams thugs rjes sgrol ba'i brdar thod phreng dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol te gzi brjid mngon par 'phags pa blta bas chog mi shes par bzhugs pa'i tshe pad ma thod phreng rtsa la lam pa da ma badzra rtsal du grasas/ rgyal po 'khuor dang bcas pas bzong par gsol ba dang / 'bas spyi bor blangs te dbu'i ma chod gnas su bkur zhing pho brang du spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyis bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khoor gyi zhal phyes te rgyal po ya/ba yum 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang bskur zhing gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor dpag tu med pa bskor/rgyal po'i bla mchod lo bcu gsum ma rdod de en dra bo lha nikhor las can gyi tshom bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa skye ba med pa 'i chos la bzod pa thob cing phung po lhag med du phyag rgya chen po mchos si rig 'dzin grub/ de nas rgya gar rtso phyogs kyi rgyal po klu yi khyab 'jug ces bya bas mu stegs pa'i ston pa bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rdoo rje gdan du brdzangs nas nang pa 'i paṇa ḍi ta rnams dang lhan cig rtso da pa la zhugs pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul mas lung bstan pa ltar slob dpon chen po dzā lan dzña ra'i dur khrod nas rdo rje gdan du rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te mu stegs pa'i ston pa 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rtsod pa sa pham par mdzad/ de nas rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa na slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma'i rig sngags la brten nas/60

gnam lcasas kyi thog phab ste mu stesas pa'i grong khyer thams cad la das pa ra mdzad pa'i tshe 'phags pa seng se sgra sgrogs rtsal du grags/ ji zhis na ma tha' 'khetshob zangs gling be mu stegs rgyal pos zangs kha sbyar du bcub nas lcags gzer btab ste chu bo gang gā la bskyur ba na/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam mkha' la sar mthad cing chu bo gyen du ldog ste 'khyil bas rgya' po 'i pho brang yu la lngo ngas dang bcas pa 'jig la nye ba'i dus/ bzod par gsol zhing rgyal blone 'khor bcas nang pa'i bstan pa la bcug pa'i tshe gu ru mkha' lding rtsal du grags/ slar mu stegs kun tu rgyu rnams kyis nang pa'i bstan pa dar ba 'a ma bzod nas ngan sngasas dug sbyor gyis sku bkrong bar brtsams pa na/ rtsi dug bdud rtsir bsgyur zhing mtshan dpe mazi mdangs sngar bas lhag par bsnan te thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod pa'i tshe gu ru nyi ma 'od zer du grags/ de nas rgya bal gyi so mtshams ya nga le skyood kyi brag phug tu byon te rgyal po dge 'dzin gyi sras mo shākya de wi sgrub rten du mdzad de/dpal yang dag gi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po mchog si ris 'dzin bsgrubs ༈ de'i tshe he ru ka gal po che dang / phur pa bi to ṅka ma 'bum sde la brten nas yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub thabs kyi bstan bcos kyang mang du ma dzad / phur srung ma mo bcu gnyis dang skyes bu ging bzhi rnams kyis srog snying phul zhing dam la btags pa 'i tshe rdo rje drag po rtsal du grabs/ gzhan yang slob da rio rme mcho skyes dang / bram ze 61

sa ra ha dang / be rū pa dang / nag po spyod pa chen po la sogs pa sku'i bkod pa dang mtshan gyi rnam grangs sna tshogs pas sgo nas lhang ga la dang / ta zig dang /rgya nag dang / zangs gling ngang / gser gling dang / kha che dang / zhang zhung dang /ma ru rtse dang / 'a zha dang / bru sha dang / 'gro lding dang / ge sar dang / tho gar dang / srin po'i yul dang / ru pa sta la sogs pa 'i yul gru mang por dngos dang rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas skal pa dang 'tshams par chos bsnan cing / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi duca kha las bskyabs par mdzad do/༈ khyad par bod kha ba can gyi ljongs su mdzad pa ji lta ra bskyangs pa'i tshul ni/ 'ardzam dpal rtsargyud las/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /sa la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snon pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya lon pa drag po lcags sprel la mtsho bri zhing rim gyis mi yi 'gro ba chags te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i tshul ni/ snying rje pad ma dkar po las/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po 'od ma'i tshal du bzhugs pa 'i tshe/mardood spu nas 'od zer byang phyogs su spros te zhal 'dzum pa mdzwad pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gyis rgyu rkyen zhus par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gang gis kyang gdul byar ma gyur pa'i gnas / 'dre srin du mas gang ba mtha' 'khob kha ba can 62

gyi rgyal khams der ma 'ongs pa'i dus su dam pa'i chos nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig dar zhing rgyas par 'dug ste/ sems can de rnams kyang thar pa byang chub kyi la ma la 'god par 'gyur ro/ mtha' 'khob de 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yin no/ de gang zhe na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas stong gi spyan sngar smon lam btab ste/ bdag gis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gang gis kyang zhabs kyis ma bcags pa'i gnas/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na yod pa'i sems can 'dul dka' ba de rnams thar pa byang chub kyi lam la 'god par gyur cig ces dang / bdag 'dre srin la sogs pa sems can de dag thams cad kyi pha ma ltabur gyur cig 'gro ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon lta bur gyur cig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me ltabur gyur cig ces sogs ji ltar dam bcas pa'i tshul gsungs pa ltar/ bod kyi 'gro ba chags pa nas thog mar mi ma yin gyis bdag tu bzung zhing rim gyis rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcus dbang byas/ de nas 'ardzam dpal rtsargyud las lung bstan pa ltar byang chub se mas dpa 'a sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sprul par grags pa rje la snga ba sanya' khri btsan po nas gnam gyi khri bdun/ snod kyi steng gnyis/ bar gyi legs drug sa la lde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan lngar grags pa rnams rim par byon zhing rgyal rabs nyer bdun tsam gyi ring 63

chab srid sgrung dang / lde'u/ pon gsum gyis bskyangs/ rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa byang sems kun tu bzang po'i sgyu 'phrul lha tho tho ri banyan btsan gyi sku ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ rgyal rabs so gsum pa dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po'i rol gar skye bo yisrun pa 'dul dka' ba rnams kyi gshed du byon pa/ mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la dam pa'i chos kyi srol bzang po gtod par mdzwad/ de nas rgyal rabs so bdun pa rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor la mi yi zol gyis byon pa/ dpal chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde 'u btsan gyis dgung lo bco lnga pa la rgyal srid bzung / rim gyis yab mes rnams kyi yis tshang gzigs rnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa byang phyogs su dar bar mardod pa'i thugs bas ma bskyed de/ zhang ma zhang khrom pa skyes sogs bdud blon rnams thabs la mkhas pas tshar bcad de rje 'bangs thams cad chos byed pa'i chad so grub/ rgya gar nas mkhan po bo dhi satwa spyan drangs/ pho brang rlung 'tshubs kyi yang thog tu bzhugs su gsol te/ rje 'bangs rnams la dge ba bcu dang / khams bco brgyad/ sten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam sa las brtsams te chos gsungs/ thugs dam bsarma yas kyi rmang bstang zhing brtsig par brtsams pa na/ bod kyi lha srin rnams khros te brtsig tu ma btub pa'i tshe mkhan po'i zhal nas/ sngar yab mes kyi sku ring la gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / chos bsgyur ba sogs mdzwad na yang / chos 64

tshugs ma thub par sgeng nag byung ba dang / rgyal po 'asa' 'is sku tshe thung ba ngang /chos 'chang pa 'i tshe bzigs ltas ngan pa byung ba ngang blorna juo chos la mai ngasa' ba rnams kyi dbang du 'gro ba 'di rnams sna bod kyi lca srin sadus pa carna snams ma thul bas lan/ 'on kyang rgyal po'i thusas dasongs 'grub pa'i thabs yang de da lta rgya bar dang bal yul gyi sa mtshams na/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad ma sa ma bha wa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi zlos gar/ ma ngal gyi dri mas ma gos shing sin dhu rgya mtsho'i gling du sku 'khrungs pa tshe la dbang ba'i ris 'dzin dang /phyas rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa/ dus gsum cis car du mkhyen cing lha ma srin sde brgyad bran bzhin du khol ba/ 'dzam bu'i gling na rig sngags 'chang 'di bas mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba med pas de nyid spyan drongs shig ces lung bsnan pa ltar/ slob da rio na chen po spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar sba gsal snang dang /seng mgo lha lung gzig g.yog dang bcas par phyag rten du saser gyi pa tra dang gser phye mang po bskur te brdzangs/ slob dpe na rgya gar dha hu la'i satsug lag khang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen de/ bal po ra byorme༈ bal yu/la nyi ma khud kyi mtsho 'gram du gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis ma jal/ bod du byon pa ra zhal gyis bzhes rte khyed rnams kyis lha 'dre'i gzer mi thub pas sngon la so nga zhig ngas lha srin rnams 'dul bzhin rjes la 'ong gi gsungs nas pho nya ba rnams sngon la baji ngas /65

phebs lam du bal bod kyi lha srin bdug pa can ma nga po dam la btags/ de nas byang lam brgyud mnga' ris skor sasum/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ mdo khams sgang drug bcas bod kyi sa gzhi lag mthil tsam yang ma lus par zhabs kyais bcags nas lha srirna thams cad dam la btags pa'i tshe gu ru snang srid zil gnon du grags/ khyad par brtan ma bcu gnyis/ mgur lha bcu gsum/ dgi bsnyen nyer gcig gtsobor gyur pa'i mi ma yin mthu bo che thams cad dam la btags shing srog snying blangs/ brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du mnga' bdag rje 'bangs rnams dang mjal zhing / mchod pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas brag dmar mgrin bzang du gdan drangs/ de ltar mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'ardooms te slar yar gtsug lag khang gi sa 'dul dang sa dpyad mdzad/ slob dpon chen po dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs te has po ri yi steng gi nam mkha' la rdo rje'i gar mardod cing sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ mkhan po'i lung bzhin rgya gar a tan ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs te lcasas pho stag gi lo la ming bting / slob dpon chen pos dregs pa can thams cad las la bkol bas nyin mo mi yis brtsigs pa bas mtshan mo lha srin gyis brtsi gas pa mtho bar byung ste/ gza' dang sgyu skar dge bsnyen nyer gcig sogs gnam sa bar gyi lha srin kun gyis las byas/ tshangs pa dang brgya sbyon/ rgyal chen bzhi la 66

sogs pas gyang btang / de ltar dbu rtse rigs gsum ri rab kyi tshul du bzhengs pa dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun grub pa'i gtsug lag khang khor yug rten dang brten par bcas pa lo lnga la 'byongs/ mkhan slob gnyis kyis nyin gsum du rab tu gnas par mdzad/ rje 'bangs thams cad rab gnas kyi dga' ston bzang po lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du byas/ dus de tsam na bod chen po'i rgyal khams thams cad bde skyed lha dang mnyam par grags/ rgya gar nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs/ bo dhi satwas ma khan po mdzad de sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ bod phrug blo rno ba mang po rgya gar du brdzangs nas sgra dang yi ge bslabs pas skad gahais smra ba'i dbang phyug dam par gyur/ de ltar mkhan slob bi ma la sogs rgya sar nas paṇa ḍi ta brgya rtsabargyad gdan drangs/ bee ro ska cog sogs bod kyi lo tsā ba brgya rtsabargyad kyis mtshams sbyar nas rgya chos ma lus pa bod skad du bsgyur/ rnam dag khrims khang gling du 'dul khrims 'bogs/ mai g.yo bsam gtan gling du bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag brda sbyor tshang mang gling du brda sbyor/ dkor mdzod pe har gling du nor 'jog bee ro tsana'i gling du chos 'chad pa sogs mnyam med bu ram rshang pa'i lung rtogs kyi bsnan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de'i tshe rgyud lung man ngag gi skor phal che ba ni rgya dpe shrī na len dra'i gtsug lag khang dang / a 67

rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzwod du bzhusas pa rnams slob dpon pad ma sa rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig la blangs nas sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur bar mdzwad/ phyis jo bo rje bod du byon te bsam yas su phebs pa'i tshe/ mdo rgyud kyi 'gyur rnams la gzigs pas/ sngar ma mardzal ba'i sngags kyi rgyud sde mang du byung bas/ rgyud 'di rnams blob dpon chen pos a rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas spyan drangs pa yin te 'ong / rgya gar na ming tsam yang med ces gsungs so/ rje 'bangs skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la slob dpon chen po'i gas nga sngags thun mong dang bla med ci rigs pa'i dbang bskur ba dang phur pa 'bum sde dang / man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba sogs gsungs/ skabs 'di dag gi tshe gu ru pad ma sam lha war grags/ khyad par du'ang bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du/ thugs sras snying spe bu dgu sogs rje 'bangs skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ mnga' bdag chen po sogs gtso bo bka' babs kyi slob ma brgyad dang / las can gyi skyes bu mang du byung / slob dpon gyis man dag dang sgrub thabs bstan pa bzhin dben gnas rnams su sgrub pa mardod/ bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub brnyes shing rdzu 'phrul 'gran zla med pa'i mngon rtags 'chang ba sha snag byung / de ltar smin grol du bkod pa'i slob ma la'ang snga thog bsam yas sa 'dul mardod skabs rje 'bangs nyer gcig bar du sgrub chen 68

bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur stsal ba'i tshe 'chims phu'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga rnams gtsobo yin la/ gzhan yang yer pa'i 'od lus grub pa brgyad cu/ chu bo ri'i sgom chen brgya rtsabargyad/ yang rdzong gi sngags pa sum cu/ shel brag gi rtogs ldanang lnga / mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsalnga / rnal 'byor ma bdun la sogs pa rnams dang / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yang mes 'khon klu dbang srung ba dang / phab mo gru pa'i yang mes pa a mes byang chub 'dre bkol/ grub chen bla( rgyan pa'i yang mes rgyus byang chub gzhon nu rnams kyis malce'on rlangs/ rngog 'khenan/ roga'agos/ spang / so/ zur/ gnubs/ rgyus/ skyo la sogs pa'i gdung rigs las dam pa'i skyes bu mang du byon pa rnams dang / pod kyi che rgu phal mo che'i yang mes thams cad blob dpon chen po'i dngos slob tu gyur pa sha stag go gzhanayang ma 'ongs par dbon sras bdud kyi sprul pas bsnan pa bsnub par mkhyen nas rgyal po la 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bsnan dang / mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i thabs dang man ngag mang po mdzad/ slob dpon chen po dang / pa gor bee ro tsan/gnubs nam mkha'i snying po gsum gyis bstan pa srung ba'i drag sngags mang po bsgyur te rgyal po la gnang / gsang sngags kyi bstan pa mai nub pa dang / rtog ge bas bslad cing bcos su med pas byin slabs mi yal ba dang / gdul bya rim par 'byung ba la dgongs nas rgyal po'i bla gter brgyad/ thugs gter chen po 69

lnga / zab pa'i gter chen nyer lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i ming can ming med kyi gter kha grangs las 'das pa sbas/ de dag 'don pa'i dus dang / rtags dang ༈'don pa'i gang zag las can chos bdag sogs lung bstan re re bzhin stsal/gzhan yang dus skabs ci rigs par slob dpon chen po las can gyi 'khor dang bcas pa gzho stod sta sgro nas brtsams bod kyi sa gzhi rta rmig tsam yang ma lus par zhabs kyis bcags/ las can gyi 'khor rnams la zab rgyas kyi gdams pa dpag tu med pa gnang / mnga' ris slor du gangs brag nyi shu/ dbus gtsang du sgrub gnas nyer gcig mdo khams khul du gnas chen nyer lnga / stod smad bar gsum du sbas yul gyi rgyal po gsum/ lung lnga / ljongs gsum/ gling gcigade re re la yang rtsab dang yan lagame tog 'bras bu'i tshul du yod pa sogs gangs brag ri mtsho thams cad sgrub gnas su byin gyis bslabs/ khyad par mon kha nee ring seng ge rdzong sogs stag tshang ming can bcu gsum du khro bo 'chol ba'i skur bzhengs nas/ bod kyi lha srin che phra thams cad dam la btags shing gter gyi srung mar bzhag pa'i tshe slar yang gu ru rdo rje gro lod rtsal du grags/ phyi rabs yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir bum thang rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag sogs la sku rjes/gnam mtsho phyug mo sogs grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la phyag rjes/ de bzhin sgrub gnas thams cad du gu ru yab yum gyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs ngo 70

mtshar ba'i bkod pa grangs las 'das par bzhag go lha sras mu khri btsan po'i tsherje 'bangs nyi shu rtsagacig la sogs pa yan mchod rnams khra 'brug tu byon te bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sgrub chen mardod cing smin grol gyi gdams pa dpas tu med pa gnang ngo / de ltar slob dpon chen po bod du lo hril po lnga bcu rtsabazhi dang zla ba drug bzhugs te shing sprel sprel zla'i tshes bcu la srin yul du gshegs par bzhed pa na rje 'bangs thams cad mya ngan gyis non/ slob dpon lī 'jig rten gyi zas nor ri ltar spungs pa phyal nas bshol btab kyang ma gsan/ bka' las/ngas bod yul du lha srin dam 'dogs lan gsum bgyid thub pa byung na chos rgyal gyi chab srid mtha' nas rgyas shing / bod khams bde skyeng yun du gnas pa zhig 'byung ba yin pa la/ bdud blon rnams kyis mardod pa'i 'phro bsgol bar bskul ba'i dbang gis lha klu'i dam bzhag gsum pa dang / bod kyi rgyal brgyud mnga' thang 'phel ba'i sbyin sreg rnams ma grub par 'phro la lus pas/ ma 'ongs pa na lha srin sde brgyad rnams khengs log nas mtha'i 'gong po dang bsngongs te rgyal khrims dang chos khrims bzhig mtha' ma bod khams hor gyi mnga' 'og tu tshud nas sdug bsngal bzod dka' bas mnar bar 'gyur la/ 'on kyang nga'i sprul pa rnams kyis cung zad re phyir bsring bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ de nas yon mchod rnams zur mkhar rdo'i mchod rten du chibs bzhol/ rje 'bangs rnam sa la thugs rje chen 71

po'i gdams pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs re re bzhin rgyas par stsal/ de nas gzhegs pa ra brtsams pa na / thams cad snying brton pa ltar gyur te slob dpon gyi zhal la blta zhing smre ngas 'byin pa la/'di skad ces/ da lta smre ngag 'don mi 'tshal/ /khyed rnams zo mdog bde dus 'dir/ /nga 'gro srin po'i yul du 'gro/ /da lta srin po ma btul na/ /'dzwam gling srin gyis snongs par byed/ /de phyir srin po 'dul du 'gro/ /bod rnams sku kharma sa ci bder bzhugs/ /zhes dang / bod la drin cher byas kyang drin mi dran//drin du tshor na gsol ba snying nas thob/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i tshe/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel smon lam khyad par gyis/ /sangs rgyas gzhan bas bdag nyid thugs rje myur/ /bsus na pad 'byung gzhan no rje 'bangs kun//zhes dang / nga la mos na tshes bcu'i mchod rgyun zungs/ /bka' bzhi2 bsgrub pas bod khams bde la 'be|da/ /thugs la btags so las can lha yi sras//nga dang mjal gyi rje 'bangs thusas ma chad/ /zhes dang / nang redagong re bod kyi don la 'byon/ /nyi zer 'char sdud mdangs la chibs te 'byon/ /yar ngo tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon/ /mdor na nga yi rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams /spos ldan tshogs gtor rin chen 'bar ba bshams/ /chig bdun gsol 'debs gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas/ /sgod pa ltag sprod rol mo'i sgras bskul 72

na ༈ /skyel rgyan nga nyid rnga yab dpal ri nas/ /gces pa'i bu ngus ma yis mi bathod ltar/ /byin gyis slob 'byon dam tshig na ra kan/ /zhes gsungs te gung thang la thog nas spyan bar snang la gzigs pa'i mod sprin gseb nas rta mchog rin po che byung ba la chibs te lha rnams kyisatshom chong/ pa'i sprin phung dang / lha'i rol mo'i glu dbyangs du ma'i bstod pa dang bcas de yid ltar myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis srin yul rnga yab gling du gshegs/ zangs mdob ngapal ri'i rtse mor srin dro 'i rgyal po rakṣa thod phreng garmes spar te de'i gsob tu bzhusas/ pho brang pad ma 'od kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'i bkod pa bsam las 'das par sprul/ shar zhi ba chos kyi pho brang sogs srin po'i gling brgyad du'ang sprul pa re re rgyal po'i tshul du bzhugs/ yum ye thes mtsho rgyal yang khro mo'i rnam par sprul te bzhusas rshang /rig 'dzin 'bum phrag tshogs kyis bskor ba'i srin po rnams la chos ston pa dang /skye 'chi med pa 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku la dbang 'byor bas 'jig rten 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar de srid du lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi tshul du bzhugs so/ de ltar bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos ci bder phongs su spyod chos pa ni 'phags yul du 'dul 'dzirme grangs med pa'i dbus su nyi zla ltar grags pa rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol son pa mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang / dpal o ḍi ya na'i slob dpon chen po padma sam bha 73

wa/ chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gam khri srong lde'u btsan te rigs gsum mgon po mi yi gzugs su byon pa mkhan slob chos gsum dang / paṇaḍi ta bi ma la mi tre/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ shīn rta gar bha/ ka ma la shī la sogs dang /lo tsā ba bee ro tsan/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ rma rin chen mchog gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ gnyags lo ye shes gzhon nu/gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs sprul pa'i lo paṇa bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba brgya rtsabargyad zung du grags pa rnams kyi gzhal du med pa'i drin la sa byung bas na / slar yang byin rlabs kyi rtsab snga 'gyur rdo rje thes pa'i ring brgyud bka'i chu bo dang / nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi chos sgo ji snyed pa la brten pa'i rtsabargyud rig 'dzin gyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / dngos grub kyi rtsab yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs / phrin las kyi rtsab gnas gsum gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro rab 'byams/bstan skyong legs ldan rdo rje srin po sogs mgon po pho rgyud/ sngags srung ma mo ral gcig ma sogs lha mo mo rgyud/ dpal mason ma ning nag po sogs gnyis med kyi rgyud dang / gzhan yang khyab 'jug dug gi spu sgra/ dam can rdo rje legs pa/ rgyal chen rnam mang sgos sras/ ban chen rdo rje bdud 'dul/ btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun/ lha sman tshe ring mched lnga / bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu sogs/ dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum/ gsang bdarga phyag 74

nardo rje/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas/ bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pa chos srung dam can rgya mtsho ste/ rtsagasu ma lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dus 'dir dgongs su gsol zhes mchod par brjod cing snyan gsan dbab pa ste/ gang la dgongs she na/ snyigs lnga'i dus 'dir rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rin po che nyams dma' zhing / nag phyogs yid srub kyi tshub ma lhan re bzhin brtas pa dang / chos byed phal cher me tog mda' can gyis bslus te rnam g.yeng kun rtog gi rba klong ni 'khrugs/ bzhad sgrub rnal ma'i bsnyan pa ni chu lha'i phrag tu yib la nye/ dug lnga'i rang gdangs phyi ru shar bas nad mtshon dmag 'khrugs mu ge sogs mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe sna tshogs kyi rlung dmar ni ldang / ya rabs dam pa'i ngang tshul can ni khas nyen dbang chung du bas/ rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i sdig to can rnams ni mnga' thang gung la reg pa sogs phyogs dus gnas skabs kyi ngang tshul ya ma brla ji snyed pa dag dang / khyad par bdag cag gi ston pa'i zhal snga nas/ nga yi bstan pa zab mo 'di/ /gzhan gyis 'jig par mi nus te/ /nga min nga 'dra zhig gis bsnub/ /btsun pa 'dul khrims med pa dang / /ban de dam tshig med pa dang / /bud med ngo tsha med pa ste/zhes sku gas gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong ba so thar gyi sngom pa nos kyang dgag sgrub kyi bslab bya la gces spras su mi byed/ gzhan phan gzhir 75

bcas sgrub pa byang sems kyi sdom pa phog kyang rang 'dod yid byed dbang btsan pas nyes ltung gi khur brtsegs/ thams cad mnyam par lta ba gsang sngags kyi sngom pa thob kyang rtsab dang yan lag gi dam tshig la 'das nyams 'gal ral du gyur pa sogs mkhan slob dge ba'i gnyen rnams dang bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa das gi thugs dang 'gal ba'i kha na ma tho ba gang dang gang bsags pa thams cad rtsagasum lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing gzhags so/ phyin chad mi bgyi sdom lags na thugs bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ spyi dang nye ring gi mched lcam thams cad dkyil 'khor dang tshom bu gcig tu 'grogs shing mthar 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams ngam par lhan cig pa'i 'khor du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig snyam du snying thag pa nas bsams shing bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i phrin las bcol zhing smon par bya'o/༈ gnyis pa rdo rje chos srung rnams la dmigs kyis phrin las bcol ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ thub bsnan mdo dang sngags kyi tshul mtha' dag /gangs can ljongs su brtse bas drangs gyur pa/ /cher cher spel ba'i rdo rje dam dgongs nas/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang bye brag thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che mdo dang sngags kyi tshul la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub mchis pa'i gnas gang dang gang du phrin las phyogs mthar spel ba'i 76

khas blangs tha tshig gi mna' bor ba bzhin mnyam che/da shākya'i rgyal po'i lu nga rtogs kyi bsnan pa yongs rdzogs rgya sar 'phags pa'i yāl dang a rgyan mkha' 'asgra'i gling sogs yul gru du ma nas lo paṇa rnams kyis snyigs dus 'gro ba mtha' ya sa pa'i don du thugs brtse'i 'jug pa lhag par g.yo zhing gas nga ba gsum gyi phrin las dpag par dka' ba dang du blangs rte/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa phrag tu 'khur nas ngal dub sna tshogs khyad du bsad de gangs can gyi ñdzo ngas su drangs rshang dkar 'byams yug gcig gis khyab par mdzwad pa la/ ye shes dang la sa lī sa grub pa'i dam can chos srung pho nya yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i yazhwa gam chen po dran par gyis la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mi nyams shing phyogs kun tu 'phel ba dang / bstan 'dzin skyes bu gang du bzhugs pa rnams/ kyi sku tshe bsrings la/ dkar phyogs lha mi rnam sa la sngong grosas dang rgyab rten dus la sa mi yol zhing / snod bcud 'jig rten mtha' dag bde legs kyi dpal la/ rol zhing 'phags nor yan lag bdun dang dge brgyad dge bcu'i dngos pos rtag tu 'tsho ba dang / dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i cho 'phrul zad mi shes pa ma tha' dag mcho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs mdo sngags zung 'jug gi bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas shing yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bstan pa yun du gnas shing 'jig rten skye rgu thams cad phan bde legs tshogs la sbyor gzod pa'i sems 77

bskyed rmad du byung ba la brten/ bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral sogs la 'bod cing bskul 'debs pa la sa/ rang don phran tshegs tsam la sems te rtsagasum lha tsholas chos skyong bcas pa dpang du gsol zhing / mnan sreg 'phang pa'i las sbyor dang / ngan sngags mthu gtad dug sbyor sogs la brtso na pa ni theg pa chen po lta ci nang pa'i khyur yang mi tshud pa ngo tsha zhe khrel gyi gnas su gsungs te/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las/ ma gus ngo tsha nyes chung ngo tsha dang / /mi bzod ngo tsha yongs nyams ngo tsha dang / /rnam 'phro ngo tsha lta chung ngo tsha dang / /theg gzhan ngo tsha byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /zhes so/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags la brten nas dasos pa'i dbang gis mngon spyod kyi las la 'jug rigs na'ang /thog mar ni lha dang bla ma'i gnang zhing lta dgongs gdengs dang ldan pa dgos pa la sa/ sazhan du rang gzhen phung la sbyor zhing nyes ltung bskyed pa'i rgyur zad de/dri me da bshags pa 'i rgyud las/ sgrol ba'i tshe na ting 'dzin gnas ma stob//skyes bu ging chen thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /sgrio la ging bdag po'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /zhes dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan mar me mardod kyis/ rgyud kun bzhad dang nyan pa dang / /sbyin sreg mchod sbyin la sogs pa/ /slob dpon dbang bskur brnyes gyur zhing / /de nyid rig la nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i lam la slob par 'dod pa dag gis kun mkhyen chos kyi 78

rgyal po'i sems nyid ngal gso las ji skad byung ba bzhin/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ tshe mi rtag pa/ 'khenar ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras/ thar pa'i phan yon/ dase ba'i bzhes gnyen brten tshul rnams kyis rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du song nas nam du yang nges 'byung skyo shas dad pa dag snang gi yon tan rnams 'bral mi thes pa ngang yul rkyen gyis 'phrog mi nus pa dgos/ de ltar dam pa'i chos la 'jub pa'i tshe/ gzhi dad pa med na snrod kha sbub pa lta bu'i skyon dang /grogs brtson 'grus med na snod zhabs brdol ltabu'i skyon dang / man ngag zab mo gsang ma thub na snod zhogs ral lta bu'i skyon dang / chags sngang dang phrag dog gis chos byed pa snod dug can ltabu'i skyon du gsu ngas pa dang / sgrob dpon chen pos kyang / dam tshig bsrung ba la dad pa dang brtson 'grus shes rab gsum tshang dgosaca dad pa med na gsang sngags kyi smod du mi rung2 brtson 'grus med na le lo can tha mal du shor2 shes rab med na gsang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mo dbye mi shes/ zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams la dran pa nye bar bzhag go de'i 'og tu theg pa dang grub mtha'i rnam gzhag rnams la sgro 'dogs chod pa thos bsam gyi shes rab bskyed dgos pa ni/ ji skad du/ de la bye brag smra ba bsnan/ /mdo sde pa ni de las phyis/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa de las phyis//zhes dang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/79

/sems can mchog la rnal 'byor te/ /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / de ltar blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis mdo sngags gzhung lugs rnams zhwa thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal bskyed par bya ste/ de yang thos pa'i shes rab rngam po che zan za ba ltabu/ bsam pa'i shes rab zon mos sha za ba ltabu sgom pa'i shes rab bu chung gis zhun mar za ba ltabu dgos par gsungs so/ shes rab rnam gsum de dag phyogs rer ma shor sprugs par nyams su blangs pa 'a sa bang rung gis chog par sems pa ni dam pa'i tshul dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ de ltar bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi sgom pa gang yin de yang don med min//gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bsnarna pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ gang dag sbyangs pa sngon du song ba dbang po cig char ba'i rigs can nyin mo'i skar ma ltar re dga' tsam srid pa ni ma gtogs so/ de lta bas na mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams la thos bsam gyis rgyud sbyangs pa dag gis bla ma'i man ngag bzhin zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin dang / bsten sgrub yan lag bzhi la brten pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa las/ gzod gzhan don gyi phrin las la 'jug cing bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan la gdengs ma rnyed pa dang 80

shusadang mi ljan pa dag gis thun mong chos spyod bcu yi bya ba la 'bad pa 'don pa gtsocheb las/ dang po'i la sa can gyis rnal 'byor pa'i bya ba la lad mor shor na nol spyod du gyur nas rang rgyud 'ching ba las ma 'das pa ni/ man ngag rin po 'isgodzod las/ zol ma drug gis bslu ba'i chos drug ni/ /lta ba zol ma gdeng du ma tshud pa'i/ /g.yam rgyusas spros bral 'dis kyang rang sems bslu/khri rtsapa zol ma gnad du ma thebs pa'i/ /blun sgorma yid dpyod 'dis kyang rang jims bsu/ /spyod pa zol ma bag dang mi ldan pa'i/ /smyo spyod rtsing po 'dis kyang rangalgems bsu/ /dam tshig zol ma nyes ltung mi 'dzem pa'i/ /srung sdom ngo sgogo 'dis kyang rang sems bsu/ /thos bsam zol ma sangs rgyas mi 'dod pa'i//nga mkhas grags 'dod 'dis kyang rang sems bsu/ /'bras bu zol ma sems da ma rtogs pa'i/ /phyi dus yid slon 'dis kyang rang sems bsu/ /bsu brid dbang du ma song shin tu gces/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/༈ gsum pa snga 'gyur chos rgyal lo paṇa tshogs kyi bka' drin rjes su dran pas smon pa ni/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /rigs gsum sgems pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol mo yis/ /gangs can phan bde'i nyi ma gsal bar mthad/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba sasungs te/phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing gi rdul sted du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dus 81

gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa rnams dang / da lta'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la mtshon na 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzwad sogs dang / da ltar ba'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mgon po sogs bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje mi bzad rgyan gyi gcor lo'i yon tan dang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa ni rigs gsum gyi sems dpa' ste 'ardzam dpal smra ba'i seng ge spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje rnams so/ rigs gsum lha tshogs de dag gis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i tshul ni bcom ldan 'das sku tshe 'du byed byin gyis brlabs te gsung rjes su bsnan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis bskal ba nas bskal ba'i bar du bsnan kyang zad par mi 'gyur zhing mtshan tsam 'dzin pa'ang bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngogs su gsungs pa ni/ lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdud sdig can gyis gsol ba/ bcom lngan 'das sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyi mtshan yongs su bsgrags pa ni mi mngon lags kyi/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gcig pu'i ming ni de lta ma lags te/ 'jam dpal gyi ming thos nas bdag cag 'jigs zhing dngangs nas skrag ste 'chi 'pho ba snyam du sems so/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ sdig can de bzhin te 'jim dpal gzhon nur gyur pas rnam dbye med par sems can gyi 82

—38byas pa dang byed par 'gyur ba de ltar sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyis ma mdzad do/ zhes dang / 'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i mdo las/gad gis 'ardom dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i ming thos pa de dag gis ni sangs rgyasamangon sum mthong bar smra'o/ zhes dang / gang gis sangs rgyas bye ba phrag theg phrag 'bum gyis mtshan brjod pa bas ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i cher brjod na de nyid de bas ches bsod nams mang du bskyed de zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / yang za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po ni mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon/ skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs/'jigs shing skrag pa rnams la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ mun par gyur pa rnams kyi sgronomer gyur pa/ nyi mas gdung ba rnams kyi gdugs su gyur pa/ nad kyis btab pa rnams kyi mya ngan las 'das par snon par byed pa ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyai dbang po'i ming dran pa de dag ni bde ba dang ldan pa yin no/ de dag ni na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las thar te 'khor ba'i tha mar 'gyur zhing bde ba can du skyes nas snang ba mtha' yas las chos nyan cing rtag tu de na gnas par 'gyur to/zhes dang / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po las kyang / sems can tshad med pa gang dag sdug bsngal myong ba dang / me chu dang srin po gshed ma gcan gzan sogs 'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mnar ba de dag gis spyan ras gzigs 83

kyi mtshan thos na 'jigs pa de las thar bar 'gyur te/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / yang rig pa mchog gi cho ga rgyas pa las/ phyag na rdo rje khyod kyi mtshan brgyad po gsang sngags kyi 'khor dang bcas pa thos na/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa yang sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje mthong zhing bgegs dang log 'dren bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsabazhi 'byer bar 'gyur/ gang thos na tshangs par ma spyad pa yang tshangs par spyod par 'gyur/ zhes dang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud chen po las/ 'byung po'i bdag po gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'bum phrag sang gā'i klung dgu bcu rtsaganyis kyi bye ma snyed la phyag byas pa bas/gang gis rig pa'i rgyal po chen po'i mchog lag na rdo rje la yid kyis phyag byas pa de ni de nyid las bsod nams mang du bskyed do/ zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ de lta bas na 'phags pa rigs gsum sems dpa' mchog gi phrin las sna sus kyang gzhal ba mi nus shing / sgru 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs pas sems can ma smin pa ni smin par mardod/ smin pa grol ba'i lam la bkod pa dang / grol ba mthar thug pa'i gnas la sbyor bar mardod pa las/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su gdul bya dus la babs pa'i tshe chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang / rgyal rabs so gsum pa'i dus na srong btsan sgam po/ chos blon zu mi sam bho ṭa/mgar snong btsan yul srung rnarma sa dang / rgyal rabs so bdun pa la mkhas slob 84

chos gsum gyi rnam par byon nas phan bde legs tshogs kyi sgo 'phar bzang po thub pa'ibastan pa rin po che nyi ma ltar sasal bar madzrad pa dang / gzhan yang ji srid sangs rgyas kyi bsan pa gnas pa'i bar de srid du sprul pa'i mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par ston pa ni/ ris med mkhas grub rnams la zhal gzigs thob pa dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i mngon rtags tshad ma mang du byung ba sogs rnam thar lo rgyus dag las gsal ba bzhin no/ de ltar snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid mkhas slob chos gsum gyi thugs bskyed las byung zhing / khyad par slob dpon chen po'i phrin las la rag lus pas na mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bsnan pa rin po che mi nub cing phyogs dus kunatu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces pa'o/༈ gnyis pa bye brag phyes te smon pa la'ang/ tshigs su bcad pa rgyud bcu bdun gyi grangs kyis bsnyad pa las/ dang po la paṇa mkhas grub rgyun ma 'chad par byon pa rnams kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mardod pa las brtsams te smon pa la/ dngos dang / shugs bstan rjes 'jug la gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags pa chen po'i tshogs/ /bsam bzhin sprul pa'izlos gar nyer bzung nas/ /dri med rgyal bsnan nor bu'i rgyal mtshan sgreng / /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs 85

rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / zla ba sgron me'i mdo dang / 'jam dpal rtsargyud/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsaba'i rgyud sogs mdo rgyud rnams las 'phags pod mkhas grub kyi skyes bu rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa la bzhugs pa rnams lung du bstan pa ltar/ snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gdul bya mu rgod can rnams 'dul ba la yul gru tha dad du mar bsam bzhin srid pa nye bar bzung nas/ sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don mthun pa dang / don la spyod pa ste bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la brten nas/ lan grangs bcu drug ga'al ba'i gserabatsom ltar/ rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rin po che mdo sngags zung 'jus se lam dri ma med pa/ 'dul ba la snang / mdo sde la 'jug mngon pa'i chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba'i sde smod rin po che rnam pa gsum dgongs 'grel grasas che zhing phul du byung ba dang bcas pa bsgyur bshad mdzwad cing dkar chag tu gartan la phab pa dang / rim par 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi srol gtod pa sogs 'ardom gling yul gru gzhan du bsod nams kyis ma 'chun pa dag gangs can pa'i snyer 'tsho dam par gyur zhing / yid srub kyis glasas rnyed pa'i so skabs dang bral ba su ma rtsen lha'i gos bzang la rin po che'i tog gis spras pa ltabu phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mnyam med bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs byang phyogs kha ba can du 'dren par mdzad pas na sngon byon dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gsob tu med 86

cing / khyad par bla( rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje kho nar rag lus pa 'i don gyis bsnan pa spyi dang bye brag mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa 'i ring lugs mi lhamasapar phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces so/༈ gnyis pa rjes 'jug la gdams pa ni/ shākya'i bstan pa byang phyosas su darazhing 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi rgyurna ma nub par gnas pa mtha' darga chu 'go gangs la zug pa ltar snon pa sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs las byung bar shes dgos pa ni/ sdud pa las/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /'chad dang rigs pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa / /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu//zhes gsungs pa banin no/ de lta bas na ston pa bcom ldan 'das lhums su zhugs pa dang / sku bltams pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / mngon pa ra rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / chos kyi 'khor la bskor ba dang / cho 'phrul bstan pa dang / sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i mardod pa rnams rjes su dran pas dus tshisas kyi chos ston byed pa dang / zla ba byung ngo sga yar mar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu rnams su tshogs mchod sogs dge sbyor la lhas par brtson pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung byang zheng nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba sobs phan yan mang du gsungs pa rnams lhams su blang bar bya zhing dkon mchog sasurmi la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems 87

bskyed pa dang yan lag bdun pa phul ba dang / gzungs sngasas zab mo 'don pa dang / zhi lhag gi ring ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa dang / dus nges pa dang ma nges pa'i gso skyong blang ba dang / bsnyen gnas kyi dus khrims dag kyang bsrung zhing dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o/ mdor na kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi sems nyid ngal gso las/ nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad nyi shu dgu//tshes bcu yar ngo mar ngo nyin dang mtshan / bsnyen sgrub tshogs mchod bskang bshalas 'bad par bya/ /zhes dang / 'grel par/ de'ang dngos grub sgrub pa dang bskang bshags bya ba'i dus drug ste/ tshes bco lnga dang / zla bas snong pas gnam stong dang / tshes brgyad dang / nyi shu lnga dang / tshes bcu dang / nyi shu dgu ste/'di dag la phyir mkha' 'gro rgyu zhing nang du rtsarlung khyad par can gyi 'du ba zhes bya ba yin no/ khyad par du yar ngo'i tshes bcu nyin mo dang / mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste nyi shu lnga'i mtshan mo sgrub pa po'i gnas su mkha' 'gro grub pa can 'du bas las bang yang 'grub pa'i phyir bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhi la brtson pa dang / tshogs mchod dang bskang bshags bya ba la 'bad pa ra bya'o/ des ni zla ba de'i ring la nyams pa thams cad gso pa dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'grub bo༈zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ e ma skal pa re bzang / da re bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang mched lcam 'dus pa zhal bzhugs pa mang po mjal bar gda' bas nga re 88

dga' lham pas/ dben gnas sgrub sde dang gtsug lag chos 'khor dag tu dam ldanarnal 'byor pa rnams 'dus te tshogs 'khor dga' ston gyi 'du ba nyams su myong ba dang / bag med pa spangs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad spyod dwang du blang zhingaglu gar phyag rgya la sogs par rol zhing bstan pa rgyas pa'i spon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ mdor na rgyal bsnan rin po che zhes pa 'chad nyan tsam dang gzugs brnyan tsam du ma lus par so byang sngags gsum gyi nyams len la rtsol ba bskyed par rigs so/ de la so so thar pa'i sngom pa ni / sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sem sa sna yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bsnan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshig rkang dang pos ni kha na ma tho ba las sems bsrung zhing lus dang ngag gis bsngom pa'i tshul khrims dang / gnyis pas shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / gsum pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa rnams bsnan to/ byang chub sems dpa'i snom pa ni/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ma skyes pa ni bskyed gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med par yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces pa bzhin smon 'jug gi sems bskyed de gzhan don du 'gyur na lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun la gnang ba yod kyang rang don du dam pa'i chos 'dul ba ltar 'jug cing nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims la slob pa ste tshig rkang dang po dang gnyis pas bstan to/ smon pa'i 89

bslab bya dkar chos bzhi dang tshad med bzhi la rton cing 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslab pas tshul khrims dang stang nge 'dzin dang shes rab gsum ka tshang ba ni tshig rkang gsum pas bstan pa dang / de ltar dase ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims la brten nas sems dang po bskyed pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa dang / skye ba gcig gi thogs pa'i sa rnams su mngon rtogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba las bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la gzhol bas sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni tshig rkang mtha' mas bsnan to/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi tshul ni/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig /spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa / /'a11 la phan phyir bdag gis spyad/ /byang chub sems mchog ngam pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na /rdo rje rgyal po'i byin rlabs stsol/ /dus ngan tha ma'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sangs rgyas mardod dka' bdag gis sgrub/ /byang chub spyod dka' bdag gis spyad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag cag bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /ces 'byung ba bzhin/ tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis ni sgo gsum tha mal du mi 'chor ba rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor bstan to/ de nas chig rkang gnyis dag gis ni grol lam bag yod dang / thabs lam brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bstan to/ de nas sho 90

bo ka gcig gis ni sngags dang phyag rgya dam tshig sogasargyudakyidangosapornamasad ba na rto/ tshis sho lo ka mtha' ma rnams kyis ni 'e ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngonaspyod kyi phrin las rnams bsnan cing / las dang po pas rnal 'byor dang / la'abyor pas grub cob dang / grub thob kyais tham sa cad ma khyen pa'i spyod pa mi bya bar dus tshod dang 'brel dgos par bstan pa'o/༈ da ni gnyis pa rgya chos ma lus bod skad du bsgyur ba la yi rangs pa 'i sgo nas smon pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye bras tu bshad pa sanyis las/ dang po ni / thun mong thun min gzhung kun rang dbang gis/ /ma nor bsgyur zhus gtan la phab pa yis/ /gangs ljongs snang ba'i sgo chen thog mar phyes/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig ces gsungs te/ thun mong gi gzhung sde ༈da rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / thun min rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod rnam sa sna gtsobo dang / sgra dang tshad ma bzo dang gso ba sogs kyi rgyun ya nga byung mod kyi/de dag ni phyi dar gyi dus su lo pa ṇa skye sa mchog rnams kyis ches sasal bar byas so/ 'o na sngar smos pa'i gzhung rnams gang dang gang zhe na/ de das re re bzhin sgos kyis mi lang pas shes par 'dod pa dag gi bka' bstan rnams kyi dkar chag dang rgyud 'bum rin po che'i dkar chag 'ardom gling mtha' gru khyab pa'i rgyan sogs la blta bar bya'o/ gzhung de dag ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ rang dbang gis te chos so 91

so yang dag pa'i rig pa dang / spobs pa so so yang dag pa'i rig pa dang / do2 so so yang ngag pa'i rig pa dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag pa'i ris pa rnam sa la dbang 'byor zhing sngon gnas rjes su dran pa sogs phal gyi bsam brjod las 'das pa'i mkhyen rab kyis stobs das 'a sa so/ tshul ji ltar bsgyur na / tshis la lhag chad dang don gyi spyi 'ol tshod tsam ma yin par ma nor bar bsgyur byed dang zhus chen mchan bu'i lo tsā ba sogs kyis ngal ba brgya phrag khyad du bsad de gtan la phab par mardod do/ de las gang zhig byung zhe na/ da lta'i bar bod gangs can pa dang skal pa dang ldan pa'i 'dzwam gling yul gru bzhan gyi 'gro ba mang po ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i g.yang sa las skyob pa dang / thar pa dang rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu dam pa'i chos snang ba'i sgo 'phar bzang po theg pa gsum gyi yon tan ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes pa mi nyams par gong du 'phel ba'i rgyu ma nor ba sde/phyis byung gi la paṇa rnams kyang sngar gyi shul lam kho na la brten nas 'gyur zhus ci rigs mardod pa las bstan pa'i srol chen po gsar du satod pa ni med do/ de lta bu dpag par dka' ba'i mdzwad pa la jo bo lha gcig di paṃ ka ras kyang bsngags brjod phul 'dug pa ltar/ chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyi phyag rjes dang slob dpon chen po'i bka' drin las byung bas na/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid mi nyams zhing phyogs kun tu rgyas par gyur cig ces so/92

༈ gnyis pa che ba drug ldan gyi tshul bye bras tu bsnan pa ni/ mkhas pa chen po rong hwam pas/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur la phyi 'gyur ba rnam sa 'a sa khyad pa ra du 'phags pa'i che ba drug yod ces gsungs te/ dang po lpun 'dren yan bdas si cheb ni/ snga 'gyur gyi yon bdag 'phasas pa risas gsum mgon ngo rnam pargyal po'i tshul bzung ba ma nga' bdas re sa dbon rnam sasu ma yi na sa sa phyis 'gyur ba rnams kyi yan bdag dang mi 'dra/ sanis pa gang du bsgyur zhing satan la phab pa'i gnas ni/ sngon sprul pa'i gtsug 'a ba khang bas ma yas sosas chos 'khor stod smad du yi na pas/ da lta'i dgon phas phug tu bsgyur ba dang mai 'dra/gsum pa sgyu ri byed lo ṭwā ba'i khyad par ni/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba sgra bsgyur beero tsa na dang / ska cog zhang gsum༈ rma gnyasas so gas sbrul pa'i lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i chos yin/ da lta'i lo tsā ba dbyar mang yul du baji da/ dgun rgya bal du yug re phyin nas bsgyur ba dang mai 'dra/ bzhi pa paṇaḍi ta'i khyad par sna/ sngon gyi parṇa ḍi ta mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang / sangs rgyas sas nga ba dang / slob dpon chen po pad ma thaX/nga gnas dang / pan chen bi ma 'a mi tra sogs sangs rgyas dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang 'phags rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i chos yin/ da lta 'i gse ra shā pyo'am pa du 'khyams pa'i paṇa ḍi ta dang mi 'dra/ lnga pa zhu rten me tog gi khyad par sna/me na gser sha ba'i blud bu gang dang bre la gzhal nas phul te zhus pa'i chos yin/93

da lta mchan nas gser zho re re gnyis gnyis bton nas zhus pa dang mi 'dra/drug pa chos kyi khyad par ni/ sngon 'phags yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gra ma nyams pa'i dus su bsgyur ba ma zad/ 'phags yul na med pa'i rgyud dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa 'a dang grub pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung ste/ das pa'i zhing na bzhugs pa dang / 'ardom bu'i gling gi cha shas sing ga la dang / nub phyogs a rgyan gyi yul sogs nas slob dpon chen po pad ma dang bi ma la mi tre sogs kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas blangs nas bsgyur bas rgya gar du pan grub yangs la ma grags pa mang po zhig kyang bod kyi bsod nams kyi skal bar byon/ 'gyur yang sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams sprul pa'i sku yin pas don ji lta ba bzhin gtan la phebs pas go sla zhing byings marngal ba la rlabs che/ phyis kyi lo tstsha ba rnams kyi rdon bsgyu ra ma nus par rgya dpe'i go rim ltar/ sgra bsgrur byas pas tshig grims la go dka'/ byings mjil ba la rlabs chung ba ltar snang bas mi 'dra ba yin no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ de la kha cig thugs ma rangs pas snga 'gyur lo paṇa rnams kyis don 'gyur mardod nus pa dang phyi 'gyur la tshig tsam las don 'gyur mi nus pa de 'dra e yin zer ro/ de lī brjod rgyu mang du mchis kyang spros pa dor te mdo tsam bstan na/ rje rong zom chen po ni phyi dar gyi mkhas pa zhig yin par kun gyis bkur la/ skabs der byon pa'i 94

tshapaṇarnams kyi snang tshul kyang yu bu cas las rong zom pa thugs rgyus che ba stonadumed/ skyes bu dam pa sa brdzun dang yams rgyusas satan nas mi mardod pa rdzihaid kyi bca' yig las 'byung ba ltar yid ches par nus mod/ 'on kyang da du gsal kha 'don dgos na/ rngog lo chen pos/ bi ro tsan nam mkha' mtha' da malham/ ska cog rnam gnyis nyi zla zung gcig ste/ rirme chen bzang po tho ras skar chen tsam/ kho bo de drung srin bu me khyer bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa las so/ de ltar kha ba can du dam pa'i chos snang ba'i sgo thog mar phyes pa'i tshul labadud 'joms 'gro 'dul gling pas༈ 'di ltar bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam yang med pa'i gdol spyod mun gling gnas skabs kyi bde 'bras tsam re ster ba'i la ba chos su smra ba la gtan gyi skyabs su re ltos 'cha' dgos pa'i skal ba ngarnga bganyams nyes par gyur pa la/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos chos kyi sgron me spor bar brtsams pa'ang nag phyogs kyi 'byung po ma rung pa rnams 'khrug pa'i cho 'phrul mthor rlung drag po mi bzad pas gzhan dbang du gyur bar nye ba'i tshe/ slob dpon chen po pad ma'i zhabs kyi thugs rjes lha srin gdug pa can du gyur ro cog btul nas bod rnams chos ci bder byed chog pa mardod/ gtsug lag khang dang chos spre'akhor bzhengs/ sngon chad ma grags pas chos skad tsam slob pa'ang blo mthu chung ba'i bod rnams la 'bad pa chen pos chos kyi srol btsugs/ rab tu byung ba btub 95

bab mi btub thog mar nyams sad pa nas brtsams sangs rgyas kyi bsnan pa rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi ming gzhir bzhengs su gastang / sde snod gsum dang gsang sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho tsam bsgrur/ 'thor ba bsdus/ gcus pa bsrang / gzhi gtan la phabs/ lam nyams 'os tu bcug nyan bshad sgom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal khams dkar 'byams su btang nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bag yangs su spyad chog pa 'di sngon byon mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul ba'i lo paṇa de rnams kyi bka' drin yin pas so/ de'i phyir phyis su 'gyur ba la grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa dang lo ṭwā ba rnams kyang sngon gyi chen po de dag gis lam srol btod pa'i shul du dka' ba med par 'jug tu yod pa dang /rang gi blo gros de'i snon mar song ba la ngo mtshar du mi 'dzin pa'i khar zhes sogs gsungs so/ chos rje mi pham pas kyang / rgyal bstan ljongs 'dir 'dren pa mes dbon gsum/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng mardod mkhan slob chos ༈/bsnan pa yun du skyong ba bsnan 'dzin tshogs/ /'di rnams bod la bka' drin 'gran zla bral/ /gangs ljongs smra ba'i sgo 'byed sa lho ṭa/ /mdo rgyud bstan pa'i snang byed ska cog zhang / /bcu phrag rigs lam gsal byed mkhas dbang tshogs//'di dag bod yul chos kyi nyi ma yin/ /de phyir mdo rgyud rig gnas bcas pa yi/ /shing rta'i lam srol snga 'gyur pa yis phyes/ /de yi rtsalag ris bral dam 96

pas spel / /deng sang bar du bstan pa'i mnga' thang rgyas/ /de lta na'ang nu zhos 'akrang pa yi/ /phru gu'i tshobs kyis ma la 'khu ba ltar/ /blo zhan byas pa mi gzo 'ga' zhig gis/ /rang che 'byin zhing bstan rnying dman par 'dzin/ /kye ma ho//rgyal bstan chu gter zab mo'i klong brgal nas/ /mdo dang rgyud sde'i chos kyi snying poni/ /'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub mchog rnam sa kyi/ /drin las snga 'gyur ba la mchis mo da kyi/ /so so'i grub mtha'i zab gnas ma phig pa'i/ /blo chung rnams kyis bltas na rnying ma'i chos/ /phal dang mi 'dra sger chos mang ba'i phyir/ /yang dag yin min som nyi'i gzeb tu chud/ /rgya che'i chos mdzod rtogs shing zab mo'i gnad/ /khong du chud pa'i blo ldan 'gas bltas na/ ༈chos sgo grangs mang kun gyi mthar thug si/ /zab gnad ston phyir kun gyi rtse mor mthong //legs par bsam na snga 'gyur dus nyid kyi/ /bstan 'dzin rnams ni bka' drin 'gran bral zhing / /bstan pa rgya mtsho bsil ldan ljongs su khyab/ /bsnan zhugs kun kyang de yi drin la bsten/ /de lta mod kyi sde snod sasum gyi chos/ /snga 'gyur yin yang 'di la rtsod pa med/ /ches zab rdo rjetheg pa nang rgyud gsum/ /'phags yul phal la'ang yongs su ma grags mod/ /rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs pa'i paṇa grub kyi/ /drin las bod smongs skal bar bzhag na'ang / /zab gnad mai shes phyogs re'i mig can gyis/ /'di dag rnying ma'i chos zhes the tshom gyi/ /gzhi 97

byas phrag dog tshig ngan bdud kyis bsgrags/ /nor bu'i gter chen rnying ma'i sger skal gyur/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs don ches zab pa'i/ /dgongs pa dmar 'byin man ngag snying po'i gzhung / /'di rnams yin kyang skal pa sa ma 'chun pa 'i//sngags 'dzin rnams la sa 'og gsher bzhin gyur/ /yang dag lam bzang ma thong ba'i shes rab can/ /yod na gsar rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa'i mtha' ji bzhin nges pa 'di la rag las kyang / /rgyud las rgyud kyi man ngag ltabu yin//'di dag so skye mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /dpyad pas gsar du rnyed pa'i bsnan bcos dang / /rtog ge'i rang bzos bcos pa ma yin te/ /rgyal ba nyid kyi rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud/ /gzhan du sbas pa 'dir ni mngon bsnan phyir/ /rnyed dka'i chos mchog 'di rnams legs bzung na/ /zab cing rtogs par dka' ba yin mod kyi//rtogs na don che 'di dang mtshungs gzhan med/ /legs legs 'grigs 'grigs 'dra ba'i khas len 'ga'/ /rtogs sla yin yin 'dra yang phug brtas na//byis pa mgu bar byed pa'i ngang tshul las/ /ring khur mi bzod bye ma'i chang bu 'dra/ /mthar thug dpyod pa'i rigs pas grub pa yi/ /zab don rdo rje'i sasang bshad 'di dag la/ /nges pa skyes na nam mkha' ji srid du/ /pha rol rgol bas nam yang bskyod mi nus/ /snga 'gyur chos mdzod nor bu'i gling skyes kyang / /nor skal chad 'ga' gzhan zer 'ching bu len/ /rang gi chos la thi tshom za byed pa/98

/lha skal chad pas 'byung po sgrub dang mtshungs/ ༈skal ba ma chog gyur nges pa'i blo ldan rnams/ /kun rtog 'phel ba'i sna mang mi tshol zhing / /brgyud pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog la/ /rang nus ji bzhin spyod pas ngoms par 'gyur//de ltar brjod pa 'di la gzhan dag gis/ /rang zhen rang bstod che ba yin snyam na/ /rton pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i blo gros kyis/ /lta ba'i gnad dang nyams len man dag gzhung / /chos kyi chings dang bsu med rigs pa'i lam/ /thams cad ring mo zhig tu rtogs gyis dang / /de nas the tshom mun pa dwangs pa yi/ /nges shes nyin mor byed pa bzhin du 'char/ /de lta ra mthong na snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus//bsnan zhabs skyes pa chos smra'i khur 'dzin bdag /rnam byang phyogs kyi yon tan cha phra zhing / /las nyon sdug bsngal brgya yis mnar mod kyi/ /bstan pa 'di la gus pa rtse sacig pas/ /nam nam zhor zhor ci nus 'bad pa yis/ /snga 'gyur bsnan la ji phan brjod par byas / /de das pha yi kha phor gtsang zhen ltar/ /zhen pas ma yin nges pa skyes las yin/ /grub mtha' mi mthun gzhan la sngang ba yis//sun 'byin ma yin theg don gsal phyir yin/ /de ltar rgyal ba nid dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /dngos byon snga 'gyur dam pa mchog rnams la/ /bka' drin byas pa legs par mthong ba dang / /theg mchog chos la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /chal chol smra ba'i nges pa tshe rabs brgyar/ /ro 'dzin ral gris 'thag pa'i las ngan 99

khur/ /mi len chos mchog smra ba pad ma'i ljags/ /skye ba kun tu thob snyam spro ba skyes/ /'on kyang bdag 'dra so skye dman pa yi/ ༈blo yi nus pas zab don ma rtogs nas/ /cung zad nyes par bshad pa mchis srid na/ ༈rtsasasum lha dang srung ma'i tshogs la bshags/ /dad pa'i sems dang brgyud pa 'i man ngag mthus/ /ma nor legs par bshad pa'i cha gang mchis/ /de yi dge bas skye bo ma lus kun༈/zab don rdo rje'i gsung la dad gyur cig /ma 'ongs snga 'gyur bsnan zhabs skyes rnams kyang / /brgyud pa'i man ngag ldan byas rang lugs kyi/ /khas len rnams las cung zad mi 'da' bar/ /dad cing spro ba'i sems kyis bzung byas na/ /dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes yongs 'dzin cing / /tshe rabs kun tu theg mchog chos kyi 'byor/ /smra ba rab yangs pad ma'i ljags thob nas/ /rgyal ba'i chos mdzwod smra ba'i dbang por 'gyur/ zhes bya ba gsungs so/༈ gsum pa bka' dang dgongs 'grel grags che ba mod mi dma' ba la yi rangs pas smon pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / phye ste bshad pa gnyis las/dang po ni/ skal bzang gdul byas mdo dang sngags kyi tshul/ /nyams su len la gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /bka' dang dgongs pa 'grel ba'i gzhung kun rdzogs//mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig ces bya ba gsungs te/ rang rgyud skal bzang du bgyid 'dod pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi nyer spyod du sde snod gsum dang 100

rgyud sde bzhi'am drug gi tshul mtha' dag thos bsam bsgom pas nyams su len pa la thabs kyi rnam pa 'ga' zhig ma tshang bas gzhan la ltos dgos pa'am 'gram chu ldang bar bya ba med de/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi cha rkyen rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos kyi tshul rnams rin po che'i sgrom bu kha phye ba ltar ci dgar 'jug pa'i rjod byed gsung rab ma lus pa bod kyi skad du bzhugs pa'i phyir na/ lo paṇa skyes mchog rnams kyi drin dang de'ang slob dpon sangs rgyas galhas pa'i phrin las mtha' yas pa'i stobs kyis drangs pa las byung bas na/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs sam bsnan pa 'di nyid lus can kun gyi phan bde legs tshogs rgya mcho'i 'byung gnas dam par 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa cung zad phye ste bshad pa la/ legs par gsungs pa'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos so/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po bka'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen ston pa sangs rgyas la brten nas byung ba'i khyad par bzhi ldan gyi gsung rab/ de dang lung gi chos 'khor don gcig khyad par bzhi ni/ brjod bya don dang ldan pa/ rjod byed ngag chig dri ma med pa/ byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba/ 'bras bu zhi ba'i phan yon ston pa dang 101

bzhir lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las sasungs pa ltar/ rgyud bla ma la sa/ bang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams gsum kun nas spon mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzwad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /zhes gsungs/ yang bajiod bya bslab pa gsum/jiod byed ngag tshig dri med/ sgrub byed tshad ma gsu ma ldan/ 'bras bu thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba dang bzhir bshad de/ bslab pa gsum snon ngag tshig dri ma med/ /tshad ma gsum ldan thog mtha' bar dge ba/ /de sna chen por gsungs pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ /ldog pa gzhan gyi gzhung du shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gnyis pa bka'i sgra don ni/ subhā rṣata zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ su ni bzang podang / bde ba dang / rab dang / legs pa lnga la 'jus pa las 'dir legs pa/ bhā kṣa ta gsungs pa ste/ legs par gsungs pas na bka'o/ ji ltar legs par gsungs snyam rna/ rnam pa bcus te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/rnam pa bcu dag gis te/ yang dag par bslang ba nyid kyis dang / dbang du mdzad pa nyid kyis dang / 'jug pa nyid kyis dang / rab tu bstan pa nyid kyis dang /rab tu dbye ba nyid kyis dang / rten haid kyis dang / go bar mdzwad pa nyid kyis dang / gdags pa nyid kyis dang / dus nyid kyis dang / yon tan yongs su 'dzin pa nyid kyis so/ zhes 'byung ngo / gsum pa bka'i dbye ba la bzhi/ bdag 102

rkyen gyi sgo nas/ dus kyi sgo nas / sde tshan gyi sgo nas/ sanyen po'i ṅgo nas dbye ba'o/ dang po bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhal nas sasungs pa dang /byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang gsum las༈ dang po zhal nas gsungs pa la'ang gnyis kyi/ ston pas mdun bsus nas bsungs pa ni sdud pa lta bu ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'ad sa kyis 'khor bzhi po de das yang dab par rab tu dga' bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ston cing / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ zhes gsungs/'khor gyis zhus nas gsungs pa ni 'ardzam dpal mtshan bajiod ltabu ste/ rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /rdo rje 'chang chen sasang sngasas 'chang ༈ /dpag med rnams kyis dgyes pa yis/ /rab sasungs gang la gas bshad du gsol/ zhes so/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' la gsum ste/ ston pas rdo rje snying po dang rnam grol zla ba'i spyi bor phyag bzhag pas 'chad pa dang zhu ba'i spobs pa skyes nas mdo sde sa bcu pa gsungs pa lta bu skus byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang /bcom ljan 'das kyis/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa 'a chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du khyod spobs par byos shig ces gsungs pa sa rab 103

'byor gyis brgyad snong pa ra sher phyin gyi banada'aga'azhigabashadapaltabuṅgesung sis byin gyis brlabs pa 'i bka' dang / thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' la gsum las/ ston pas zab mo snang ba'i ding nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthus shā ri'i bu dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis kyis dri ba dri lan gyi sgo nas bsungs pa sher snying ltabu thugs stang nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang / yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus nam mkha' dang bya dang ljon shing sogs ra sa kyang chos kyi sgra byung ba lta bu thubs bden pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' ngang / sangs rgyas kyi mthus nyan thos dang gnod sbyin sogs kyis smras pa 'bras bu khyad par can 'byin nus kyi sngags tshig bkar bsdus pa ltabu thusas rje'i snobanu sa byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' zhes bya'o༈ gsum pa rjes su banang ba'i bka' ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa 'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo/ nga yo ngas su mya rngan la sa 'das pa 'i 'os tu bsdu ba byed pa'i tshe/ 'di skad bdag ṅges thos pa'i dus sacig na/ zhes pas gling slong la/ bar du rma tshams sbyor ba'i chis dang / mthar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhis bya ba'i bar gyis sdus rshab ces gdam sa pa bzhin du sdud pa po rnam sa kyis de ltar bcug pa'i ngab tshig rnarme sa bkar bsdus pa ltabu'o/ gnyis pa dus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ chos 'khor rim pa gsum ste/ ngang po bden bzhi'i/ gnyis pa mtshan 104

nyid med pa 'i/ sasu ma pa don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos 'khor ro༈ sasu ma pa sde tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ sasung rab yan la ga bcu banyis sa ma dgu ste/ bcu gnyis sna/ brgyang snong 'grel chen las / mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad ched bajiod rtogs pa bajiod/ /de lta byung dang gling bzhi dang /khren tu rgyas dang skyes rabs bcas/ /gtan phab rmad du byung ba'i sde/ /de ltar rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs/dgu ni/ rtogs bajiod/ de lta bu byung / gtan la phab pa 'i sde gsum ma gtogs pa'o/ /de ltar yang tshig rgasal las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdo sde la sku gas pa/ ༈bden pa gnyis brten bstan pa rnam pa dgu/ zhes so / /bcu gnyis po'ang sde snod gsu ma du 'du ste/ lung phran tshesas la sa༈ mdo yi sde dang dbyangs su bsnyad pa'i sde/ /lung bsnan tshigs su bcad pa 'i sde dang ni/ /ched du brjod pa lda ni mdo sder 'dus/ /gling gzhi'i sde dang rtogs pa bajiod pa dang / /de ltar byung ba'i sde zhes bya ba dang / /skyes pa rabs dang bzhi ni 'dul bar bsdus/khren tu rgyas dang mid du byung ba dang / /gtan la phab pa sasum sna mngon par bsdus/ zhes gsungs/ bzhi pa gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye na༈ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ lha 31 bzhis zhus pa las/ thub pa chen pos snatshos rnams kyi/ /phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong la/ /zhes so/ de yang 'dod chasas dang ༈ the 105

sngang dang / gti mug dang / dug gsum cha mnyam las gyur pa ni khri chig snong re re'i gnyin por 'dul ba dang / mardo sde dang / mngon pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sde snod rnams nyi khri chig stong re re gsungs pa yin te/ mi zad pa'i gter bstan pa las/ 'dod chags zhe sngang gti mug dang / ༈dug gsum cha mnyam spyod pa dag /nyi khri chig stong gnyin po ni/ /chos kyi phung po de sted gsungs/ /zhes so/ de la gsang sngags ni/ snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis las shin tu rgyas pa'i sde'o gsungs/ mkhas pa snar ston seng ge 'od ni gtan la phab pa'am rmad du byung ba'i sde yin gsung ngo ༈de las gzhan du paṇa chen bi ma la mi tres rdzogs pa chen po dung yig can du/ sde snod las mngon pa ste/ zhes pas sngags mngon pa'i sde snod du bsdu bar mdzad pa ltar/ skye nyi ma rdo rje sogs kyang mngon pa'i sde snod la phyi rnang gnyis las sngags nang gi mngon pa'o༈ zhes bzhed/ slob dpon shānasta pa dang snar ston seng ge 'od sogs sna zab mo'i don mdor bsdus te snon pas sngabs ni mdo sde'i sde snod de/de kho na nyid bsdus pa 'i rgyud las/ mdo sde 'di ni legs bzhad pa/ zhes dang /rnam 'joms las/ mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /zhes gsungs par 'dod/rang lugs mngon pa dang mdo sder bsdu ba sogs ni rgyud gzhung phyogs re ba dang bsdun nas de dang der 'jos par mardod pa yin pas mi 'gal yang / rgyud sde 106

sbyi'i dbang du na slob dpon āraya de ba dang ༈ ros bde gshebs chen po / kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer rnams kyi dbongs pa ltar rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dam sde stod bzhi pa zhes rang rkang thub pa gcig tu bzhag go kun byed las/ tham sa cad 'dul pa'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /sde snod bzhi pa nyi khri chig stong gsungs //zhes dang / dpung bzang gi zhus pa las kyang / bye ba phrag gsum dang ni 'bum phrag lnga/ /rig 'dzin sde snod du ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes lasungs pa'i phyir ro/ yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang si sdom pa'o/ /thes gsungs pa ltar/ de gsum snon byed nyan thos dang / byang sems dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces gsum du bsdu tshul gcig dang /mdo sde rgyan las/ sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung / /bsdus pa'i phyir te rgyu ni dgur 'dod do/ /zhes pas/ chos kyi phung po thams cad bsdu na 'dul ba dang / mdo sde dang / mngon pa'i sde snod gsum mam/ nyan thos dang ༈byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod de gnyis su bsdur rung ngo / de las 'dir gsu ma du bsdu ba'i dbang du byas rme / grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan sna/ rgyu dgus sne snod gsum du gzhag ste/ spang bya dang / bslab bya dang / thes bya la ltos nas gsum gsum mo/ de la spang bya la ltos nas gsum du bzhas pa ni/ the tshom gyi gnyen por mdo sde/ mtha' gnyis la sbyor ba'i gnyen por 'dul ba/ rang lta mchos 107

'dzin gyi gasnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod rnams gsungs/ bslab bya la ltos nas mdo sdes bslab pa gsum bshad/ 'dul bas lhas pa chu' khrims dang sems sgrub༈ ma ngon pas lhag pa shes rab sgrub pa yin no/ thes bya la ñtso sa nas chos dang don mdo sdes bshad/ 'dul bas sgrub/ mngon spro sa 'bel ba'i gartam rnam par gtan la dbab pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba ste/ rgyu dgu po 'dis sde snod gsum du bzhag la/ de ltar bzhag pa'i dgos pa 'ang / sde snod gsum la thos pas sems la bag chags 'jog bsam pas don rtogs par byed/ bsgom pa sa zhi gnas kyis nyon mongs pa zhi zhing lhag mthong gis de kho na nyid rab tu rtogs pa'i sgo nas rnam par grol bar byed pa ste/ rgyan las/ de ni bag chags stogs dang zhi ba dang / /rab tu rtogs pas rnam par grol bar byed/ /ces gsungs so ༈zhar byung sgra don ni/ su tre'i sgra las maso spos pas na mdo zhes bya ste༈ de las/gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /chos don spos phyir mdo yin no/ /zhes pas mdo sde dang / a lha ni mngon pa yin la/ yi ge gzhan bsnan pas mngon du gyur ba sogs su 'gyur te/ mngon du'i phyir dang yang yang dang / /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa 'i chos/ /zhes pas mngon pa dang / bi na ya zhes pa 'dul ba ste/ yi ge dbri bsnan gyis ltung ba sogs su 'gyur bas/ ltung dang 'byung dang ldang pa dang / /nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang / /bcas pa dang ni rab 108

dbye dang / /rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ ༈ces sasungs la/ sde snod ces pa bi ṭa ka'i sgra las drangs na pi ṇḍiḍa ka bsdus pa'i gong bu dang / pi ṭa ka bre bo che la 'jug pas shes bya'i don thams cad brjod byar bsdus pas sam/ 'di dab si nang du brjod bya mang po bsdus pas na sde snod ces bya ba'o ༈ gnyis pa dgongs 'grel brnya rna bcos kyi rnam ga'ag bstan pa 'a sasu ma mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ gtso bo bstan bcos zheo ma pa 'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ rang gi zhe 'dod grub mtha' gzhan la ston pa 'i phyir bsdebs pa'i lung gi chos de bstan bcos tsam gyi ma tshan nyid/ gang zhig khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa de bstan bcos rnam dag gi mtshan nid༈ khyad chos bzhi po gang rung dang bral ba de bstan bcos ltar snang gi mtshan nyid do/ khyad chos bzhi ni/ rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng me da pa'i yid can gyis tshig don rtogs pa'i shes rab dang sa/zhan la phan 'dod kyi snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa kun slong si khyad par/sdeb sbyor dag pa'i tshig 'brel chags pa jiod byed tshig si khyad par/ thar pa don sanyer gyi gdul bya la nye bar ma kho ba'i thabs ston pa bajiod bya don gyi khyad pa ra/tshig de la thos bsam byas pas thar pa thob pa'i nus pa yod pa byed las kyi khyad par te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhika rgyal ba ston pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa dam pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/109

/de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ gahais pa sgra don ni/ shasatra'i sgra las shā ba na 'chos pa ste/ rgyu nyon mongs dug gsum las bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos pa'i phyir dang / tra ya skyob pa ste/ 'bras bu ngan 'gro dang srid pa 'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i phyir 'chos skyob kyi yon tan dang ldan pas na bstan bcos te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro'i srid las skyob byed gang yin pa/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bsnan bcos te༈ /gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa bsnan bcos kyi dbye ba la ngo bo mchog dman/ dgos pa byed las/ rtsom byed gang zag ji ltar brtsams tshul/bshad bya bka'i/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang drug las/ dang po byed las mchog dman gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bde 'dus kyi tshoms kyi chings las/ bsnan bcos don med don dman dang / /don log don ldan bzhir shes bya/ /zhes pas bzhi ste/ don med pa bya rog so brtag gi bstan bcos ltabu/ don dman pa thun mong gi rig gnas bzhi'i bstan bcos ltabu/ don las pa phyi rol mu stegs pa'i bsnan bcos ltabu/ don dang ldan pa sangs rgyas pa'i nang rig pa'i bstan bcos ltabu'o/ /sa sde las dgur bzhad de/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /bstan bcos 110

rnam pa dgu yin no/ /zhes gsum tshan sasum las/ snga ma gnyis bstan bcos ltar snang ba ste dman pa dang / phyi ma re re bstan bcos yang dag pa ste mchog yinano/ gnyis pa dgos pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ bka'i don rgya chen po sdud pa'i bsnan bcos/ 'khrugs pa go rim bsdebs pa'i bstan bcos/ zab mornam par 'byed pa'i bsnan bcos dang gsum sī/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin mngon pa kun las btus pa/ 'dul ba mdo rtsab / rgyud bla ma ltabu'o/ gsum pa rtsom byed gang zag gi sgo nas dbye ba la lnga ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa la bstan bcos su byas pa rdo rje chos kyis mdzad pa'i bde 'dus kyi lung lnga dang / byams chos sde lda ltabu/ dgra bcom pa sa gsungs pa la bstan bcos su byas pa mngon pa sde bdun ltabu ste/ sde bdun ni mdzwod 'grel las/chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa 'i bstan bcosamoong gal bus//khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyed kyis/ /ye shes la 'jug ka ta'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bzhes kyis/ /rmi nga dag 'gro ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /gsus po che yis byas zhes grags/ /zhes gsungs/ de la bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyi lugs ltar na/ ston pas yul dus gang zag tha dad la thor bur gsungs pa rnams shā ri'i bu sogs kyis bsdus pas ched du bajiod pa'i tshoms bzhin tu bka' yin pas / dgongs 'grel gyi thog ma ni bye brag bshad 111

ma dzwod yi na no zhes zer/ mdo sde pa lta ra na mngorme pa sde bdun ni nyan thos so skye dag gis byas nas ston pa'i gsung dgra bcom pas bsdu sa pa ra kha 'phangs par 'dod pas dgongs 'grel gyi thog ma sde bdun yin no zhis zer ro/ gzhan du kha cig /sde bdun bka' ma yin te/ nor ba du ma yod pa'i phyir༈ shā ra'i bu la sogs pas byas pa'o/ /zhes kyang zer ro/ yang byang sems 'phags pas gsungs pa la bsnan bcos su byas pa sa bsu ma pa la gnas pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mardod pa'i rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga dang / bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sngom rnam gnyis ltabu/ yi darma lha'i lung bstan thob nas brtsams pa la bstan bcos su byas pa phyogs kyi glang po'i tshad ma kun las btus pa dang / kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab mardood bdun ltabu/ rang gi grub mthas zlos shing gzhan gyi log rtog sun 'byin pa la mkhas pa so skye'i paṇaḍi tas brtsam sa pa la bsnan bcos su byas pa dbyig gnyen gyi pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad ltabu'o/ bzhi pa ji ltar brtsam tshul gyi sgo nas dbyen/ bka' nyid la 'grel pa ra btags pa'i bstan bcos dang / bka'i don rang rgyud du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/dang po la 'ang bzhi las/ tshig don gnyis ka zhib tu gtan la 'bebs pa ni rgya cher 'grel te/ so thar gyi mdo'i 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa dang / dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od ltabu/ tshig gi cha spros pa dang bcas nas 'chad pa ni tshig 11lha

'grel te/ ched du bajiod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa dang snying 'grel phyogs bcu mun selaltabu/ go dka' ba'i sanas rnam pa ra 'byed pa mi da7'a 'grel te༈sdudapa'i 'grel pa ltabu/ don gyi band gtso bor bsdus te gartan 'a 'bebs pa ni bsdus don gyi 'grel pa sde/ bi ma la'i snying 'grel paglir tha dang / rong zom chenapo'i le lag gi 'grel ri ltabu rnams so/ gnis sa bka'i don rang rgyud du brtsams pa'i bsnan bcos la'ang gsum la sa/ bka' gcis sga don rdzosas par ston pa'i bstan bcos sna 'dul ba mdo rtsab/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i sgyu 'phrul lam rim lta bu༈ bka' thor bu'i don snon pa'i bstan bcos nee dge tshul gyi kā ri ka ltabu/ bka' rma nga po'i don ston pa'i bstan bcos ni zhi ba lha'i bslab btus dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i yon tan mdzod ltabu'o/ lnga pa bzhad bya bka'i sgo nas dbye na bka' spyi'i 'grel par byed pa la/ tshig gi cha 'grel par byed pa brda sprod pa'i bsnan bcos ka tsan ltabu/don gyi cha 'aspel par byed pa tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa ltabu/ bye bras so so'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos la/ chos 'khor dang po'i dgongs 'grel la'ang / lta ba / spyod pa / lta spyod zung 'brel du gtan la 'bebs pa'i bsnan bcos dang gsum las/ dang po ni mngon pa mardood ltabu ste/ lus rnam gzhag sngon du 'gro bas gnas brgyad kyi/ dang po shes par bya ba'i yul phung khams skye 113

mched/ gnyis pas dbang po'i rang bzhin dang 'dus byas kyi skye tshul rgyurkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ gsum pas sdug bden snod bcud kyi 'jis rten/ bzhi pas las/ lnga pas nyin mongs pa'i rnam gzhag drug pas lam dang gang zas bstan pas lam nyams su len tshul/ bdun pas 'bras bu yongs shes thob tshul/brgyad pas sngar drug par bstan pa'i gnyen po lam bdenagyi rten du bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug sosas kyi rnam gzhag bsnan no/ gnyis pa spyod pa'i cha ston pa sna 'dul ba mdo rtsab ltabu ste/ gzhi bcu bdun las rab byung gi gzhi dang por bstan nas/ de nas rnam 'byed gnyis dang / gzhi bcu drug rnams gzhir byas pa la/gzhung dam pa dngaphran tshegs kyi skabs nas 'byung ba rnams ji ltar rigs pa sbyar nas 'chad cing / me tog phreng rgyud ltabu ni rnam 'byed gzhir byas pa la sazhan rnams ci rigs par sbyar nas 'chad do/ gsum pa lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa ni bye brag phad mdzod chen mo ltabu ste/ de la bye brag tu shkad pa'i don ni zhib mor bzhad pa'i don yin la/ 'di ni nyer sbas kyi dus su dgra bcom pa rnams kyis spyi mthun du brtsams zer ba dang / kha cig grags pa dang thams cad 'dod sogs kyis mardod par 'dod/ don la dgra bcom pa de dag gi gsung rgyun phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa gnas brtan rnams kyi rna ba nas rna bar brgyung pa phyis yi ger bkod pa yin no/ yang chos 'khor bar pa'i dgongs 'grel la'ang / lta ba/ spyod pa/114

ltaspyod zung 'brel du gtan la 'bebs pa 'i bsnan bcos dang gsum las/ dang poni klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rigs tshogs ltabu ste/ bsgrub bya bden dngos dgag pa la rtsab shes rab/ rigs pa drug cu pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa ste gsum/ sgrub byed rtog ge'i rigs pa 'gos pa la rtsod zlog dang zhib mo rnam 'thag bcas rigs tshogs lnga'am/ de'i steng du don dam par rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob tu tha snyad 'thad cing grub par snon pa tha snyad sgrub pa bsnan pas rigs tshogs drug ces 81ngas su grags mod/ tshig gsal gyi dgongs pa ltar na rigs tshogs lngar 'thad ces gsung / gnyis pa spyod pa ston pa ni zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug ltabu ste/le'u bcu yis byang sems phan yon dang / /sdig bshags gtsor ston byang chub sems yongs bzung / /bag yod shes bzhin bsrung dang bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab bsngo ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ gsum pa lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa ni mngon rtogs rgyan lta bu ste/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'jug yul mkhyen pa gsum/ 'jug chos sbyor ba bzhi/ 'jug 'bras chos sku ste/ dngos brgyad don bdun cus gtan la 'bebs par byed do/ yang chos 'khor gsum pa bka' tha ma'i dgongs 'aspel la'ang / lta ba spyod pa/ lta spyod zung 'brel du gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum las/ dang po ni rgyud bla ma dang 115
