'byed rnam sasnyis ltabu ste/ rgyud bla ma ra/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs kham sa dang byang chub dang /yan tan sa ngas rgyas phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos ku2 gyi lus sna mdor bsdu na/ /rdo rje yi sna gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes pas dkon mchog gsum dang / de'i rgyu khams bde bzhegs snying po/ 'bras bu byang chub dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi dang phrin las bdun rnams gartan la 'bebs pa ra byed/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed ni/ yad med dam rtas chad kyi mtha' bsal nas dbu ma'i lam snon par byed/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed nitsāchos can 'khor ba dang / chos nid mya ngan las 'das pa'i rnam dbye ston par byed pa'i gzhung ngo / gnyis pa spyod pa snon pa sna sngom pa ni shu pa ltabu ste༈ byang sems dbang 'bring gi rtsaltung bzhi snyes byas zhi drus dang bcas pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i sazhung ngo ༈ gsum pa lta spyong zung 'brel du ston pa sna mardo sde rgyan ltabu ste/ thes cherna bka' sgrub sogs skabs ni shu rtsasacig gis/ risas dang chos la mos pa dang / /zhes sosas don chadra bcu'i suo nas btan na 'angebs par byeng do༈ /de bzhin du ris pa 'dzin pa'i sde sno da cir ring ༈ rgyud sde bzhi'am drus si dgongs pa 'grel pa ra byed pa 'i brnya na bcos rnams rte/ dper ma tshon na༈ nee ba ston pa 'i bsnan bcos slob dporna chen po pad ma'i lta phreng dang / ska ba dpal brtsesas kyi lta rim snang ba bcu bdun pa ltabu/ spyod pa snon pa'i bstan bcos sgeg pa rdo rje'i dam 116

tshig gsa' bkra lta bu rsha spyo da zung 'bril du snon ju 'i bstan bcos rlo ba da ro na sangs rgyas sasang ba'i sgyu 'phrul 'a ma drem bkeng rsha bu rnam sa so / drugo pa brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dbye ba 'a / ji sted pa ston pa 'i bstarna bcos༈ ji tshe ba rnyo na nga 'i bstan bcos/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i thabs snon pa 'i bstan bcos dang gsum / de'i dang po ji sted ske rtso na pa 'i bsnan bcos la 'ang ༈ phasnyer pa dang /khyad par can gnyis las / phal pa ni/ 'jis rten ju 'i ‘zusas kyi brnya na bcos skye po gso thig dang / tsa ra ka rgyal po lugs kyi bstarna bcos ltabu sne/ de dag kyang dngos su ma ngon mtho'i rgyu yi na rmo da༈ brgyud nas thar pa'i rten du'ang srid pa yin te/ shes rab brgya pa las mai yi chos lugs le sas spya da 2/ /lha yul bskuld pa thag mi ring / ༈lha dang mi yi them skas la /'dzegs na thar pa sam na 'dug /ces dang / gzhan ya nga brtag pa brgyad sna/ rin chen sa sazhi sos ljo na zhing / /rta glang pho mo brtag pa 'o/ /zhis pa ltar de das brngas bhe 'i bstar bcos la lce gas pa rnams so sanyis pa khyad par can sna/ rig ru 'i gnas dang juo ba'e gtso bor btan la 'bebs pa 'i bstan bcos rnam sa de/ drirme ra rme ngas ba ru 'i ru ri rdo las/ gaspu te byang chub sems dpa 'a rig ri 'i dngos po dza ra ma bslab rnga rnam du'ang bla na med pa yang dag pa ra rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thams cad ma lcem pa'i ye shes thob par mi nus so/ de 3 bas na bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa 'i phyir ris 117

pa'i dngos po lnga bslab par bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ gnyis pa ji lta ba ston pa'i bsnan bcos ni bdag med pa'i rang bzhin gtan la 'babes pa rtsa'ajug bzhi gsum lta bu'o/ gsum pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i thabs snon pa 'i bstan bcos ni/ byang sa dang spyod 'jug ltabu'o/༈ bzhi pa brjod bya rnam dag gi tshul las brtsams te smon pa la༈ ma dor bstan dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis so/ dang po ni/ bden bsung bka' yi rgya mtsho chen po las/ /zab mo'i chos gter nor bus mngon par madzres/ /ma do dang sngags kyi lam bzang zung du 'brel/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bden par gsungs pa'i bka' ni/ ji skad du rgyal tshab byams pas/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar/ ston pa'i bdas rkyen las byung ba'i ngag gang zhis brjod bya don rnam par dag cing rjod byed yang dag pa'i tshig dang 'brel ba༈ byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa spong zhing zhi ba'i yan tan thob par mardod pa ste spobs pa bzhi ldan gyi ngag gam/ ya nga na 'phags pa dkon ma chog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo las/ dam pa 'i chos ni thog mar dgeb/ bar du dge ba/ mtha' mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa / yongs su rdzogs pa zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin 118

yonatan zad mi shes pa'i bdab nyid chu gter chen po gastang mtha' mi mngon pa zhe rig 1/rdo 'a rig tsho ridagalas/ sbyasa'ajus sdukhas pa rnams kyaX dngas 'gral du brtsams pa' ma na bcos zab chong rgya che ba ja snyed pa das kyang ja skad du/ nyon rdzungs dgra rnamasam lus 'as pa dang / zhes ba bya la sogs pa dang / gang ṭwāṃsaX gil ba sgonapa 'ba' zhig gi zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar/ 'chos skyob 4 yan tan sto mdang sa pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ded dpon mkhas pas lag tu ma zhing byi dor gyis rgyal mtshan rtse mo/ra mchod pa sa dgos 'dod thams cad dzos ba nya bkadī yi doXngs pri zab ci~X rtsogs dka' ༷ rnams gyi dasongs ma lodubasnanabasaṭwāṃramapa'angasnaḍisapasaspraṭwāṃshang / bajiod bya phuḍa du do dang sngags lam bzang po sacag dgag sdu shos la mchog tu ma ma napar zeg pa dang grub mtha' 'og ma rnams gong maX lam stesas su shes / stogazhung lugs thams cad gdadis paX shanee ba' thabs 'gal med zudi sha cho napa/ matrom̐ skyes ༷la ba sanyas pa 'aspe rang lugs sam bsta ༷ pa 'ad gas dus kuX tu ma nyams shang rgyas la yun ḍing du gapy-is par gyur cag /༈gnyasapargyasapaṭwāṃbashad pal/spyar yā na' sgra la sa theg pa zhes the dzil ༵jug pa ltar 'ar lam gong naX ོ༷nga du bgrod par de dang 'dra ga pa/ sdud pa las/ theg pa 'ad na mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang9

chen te/ /dga' bskyed bde ba mngon par thob byed theg pa'i mchog /de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan zlo/ /zhes gsungs so/ dbye na gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes gang la sang 'dul du bstan pa'i phyir/lang kar gshegs pa las/ sems can rnams sna yongs drang phyir/ /theb pa mtha' dag ngas bzhad de/ /'di zhes dmigs su yad ma yin/ /ces so/ /de yang cung zad bsdus te brjod na/ dam chos pad dkar las/ theg pa gcig ste theg pa gsum du med/ /ces pa lta bu la dgongs te mthar zug theg pa gcig tu sgrub pa dang / yang theg pa chung ngu dang chen po ste rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba gnyis dang ༈nyan rang byang sems kyi theg pa gsum mam/ spyi mdo las/ kun 'byung 'dren dang dka' thub rig /dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar gsum dang / 'jam dpal sgyu drwa las༈ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gis 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes rgyu'i theg pa gsum dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gcig ste bzhi dang / yang gsang snying las/ lha dang mi'i theg padang / nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang byang chub kyi theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / bla na med pa'i theg pa / zhes gsungs pa ltar ram/ yang kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa la nyan rang byang sems gsum dang / dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa la bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum dang / dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa la ma hā 120

a nu a ti gsum du phye bas theg pa rim pa dgu ste/ kha cig gis rdo rje snying 'grel du/ sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dasongs pa min//zhes gsungs pa'i don gyis theg pa gsum las grangs gzhan mi 'thad par dam 'cha' yang / lung de'i don ni byang chub sems dpa'i theg par gsang sngags kyang don gyis bsdus nas bstan pa yin la/ bye brag tu sangs rgyas pa/ la thes pa'i tshig gis phyi rol pa'i rtsaba'i grub mtha' lnga sogs grangs mtshungs 'asog pa'i ched du dgos dbang gis de skad gsungs pa yin zhing / gal te theg pa sasum las grangs gzhan nges par 'atre ga pa yin na/ lang kar bakhresas pa las/ lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /nyan thos kyi dang de bzhin du/ ༈de bzhin gnyesas dang rang rgyal gyi/ /theg pa de dag ngas bshad do/ /zhes theg pa lngar sasungs pa'ang mi rigs par thal lo/ de las lha dang tshangs pa'i theg pa ni mi dase bcu sprong gi tshul khrims bsrung zhing mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba dang de'i steng du kha cig bsam gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'o/ skabs don bye brag so sor 'chad pa la/ mdo dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis so/ dang po la'ang ༈nyan thos / rang rgyal/ byang sems kyi thes pa dang sasum las/ dang po nyan thos kyi theg pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba'o/ dang po sna/ 'khor ba la sa rang gcig pu thar 'dod kyi blos gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i thabs su gyur pa'o/121

gnyis pa ni/ shra ba kaca zhes pa'i sgra nyan pa dang thos pa gnyis ka la 'jug pas nyan thos zhes bya la/ rnam pa gcig twa na/ yul gcig la thos nas/ yul gzhan la sgrogs pa'i phyir thos sgrogs zhis kyang bya'o/ gsum pa lī / 'jus sgo/lta ba/ tshul khrims / sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu dang drug las/ dang po 'jug sgo ni/ 'khor ba'i duca khas yid skyo nas/ rang zhi bde don sanyer gyi bsam pas bden pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'jug ste/ rang shar las/ 'jug pa'i sgo sna bden pa bzhi/ /nyan thos spyi yi 'jug sgo'o/ /zhes so/ de yang sdug bsngal gyi bden pa nad ltabu/ kun 'byung nad de'i rgyu ltabu/ 'asog bden nad las grol ba'i bde ba ltabu/ lam bden nad kyi gnyen po sman ltabu ste/ sdug bsngal shes bya/kun 'byung spang bya/ 'asog pa thob bya/ lam brten byar byas rnas / bden bzhi 'a dmigs pa'i rgyu 'bras spang blang si sgo nas 'jug pa'o/ gnis pa lta ba snatsāgazung yul dngos po rags snang 'di gnyen po dang blos gzhis cing gzhom du rung ba'i phyir dang / 'dzin pa sems kyi rgyun dus sasum gyi chas gzhis tu rung ba'i phyir dang / sazung 'dzin rags pa 'di kun rdzob tu snang ba tsam las rang bzhirna med pa sa gang zag gi bdag med par rtosas kyang / sazung yul dngos po rasas snang rtsom pa'i gzhi rdul phra rab 'di gnyen po dang blos gzhom du med pa dang /'dzin sems skad cig ma dus kyi cha dang bral bas gzung 'dzin phra ba don dam du 122

'dod pa'i phyir chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs te/ lta phreng las / chos thams cad la mu stegs pa la sogs pas sgro dang skur bas kun tu brtags pa / ye med pa chad pa'i lta ba dang / rtag pa la sogs pa'i ya da par lta ba nitsā thag pa la sgrul du mthong ba bzhin du med de phung po dang khams dang skye mched 'a sogs pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i rdul phra rab dang / rnam par shes pa ni don dam pa ra yo da par lta ba/zhes gsungs so/ dbye na / ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi lta rim snang ba bcu bdun pa las/ chos tsam lta ba'i nyan thos pa/ /mdo sde pa dang bye brag gnyis / /phyi rol rdul la rtsod byed cing / /shes pa skad cig snang byed mthun/ /zhes so/ bye smra ni/rags pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa 'di ni sing ltar tshogs pa gcig tu snang yang /don dam par dul phra rab bskor ba bar med dang bcas pas cha ldan sil bur 'dod de/ klu sgrub kyi g.yu thang la sa/ kun rdzob bye brag 'dod gzhung nyid/ /snod kyi rjas rnams dngos po 'di/ /rdu' phran sil bu phan tshun pas/ /ma 'dres rne sing ltabu ste/ mthu'am snobs kyis 'dus par 'dod/ /don dam shes pa skad cig ma//re re yod par 'dod pa'o/ /zhes so/ mdo sde pa ni/ dul phra rab 'byar yang mi'abyar/ bar yang med pa 'bru'i phung po lta bur 'dod de/ de las/ mdo sde ba snogalharab rnams/ /'dus pa'i rnam pa gcig tu 'dod/ /don dam shes pa ma na par 'dod/ /ces so/ /'dis rdul phran las gong bu brtsam pa de'ang cha 123

med du rtogs pas bye smra las 'phags te don gyis bltar med pa'i phyir rdul phran khas ma blangs pa dang 'dra'o/ /mdor na chos bdag gzung 'dzin don dam du lta zhing 'khor 'das bden bzhi'i rgyu 'bras la blang dor du 'dzin pa ni nyan sgos pa ste/lam rim las/ gnyis med ma rtogs thams cad la/ /bden bzhi'i dngos por yod blta zhing / /spong dang mi spong byed gyur na/ /'di ni nyan thos sa pa yin//zhes so/ gsum pa tshul khrims ni/ so thar rigs brgyad gang rung ngam/mchog dge slong gi sdom pa la brten pa ni/ mdzod las/ so sor thar ces bya rnam brgyad/ /rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /mtshan las ming ni 'pho ba'i phyir//tha dad de dag 'gal ba med/ /spang bya lnga brgyad bcu dang ni/ /thams cad spong ba nos pa las/ /dge bsnyen dang ni bsnyen gnas dang / /dge tshul ched dang dbe slong nyid/ /ces so/ bzhi pa bsgom pa ni/ de las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pas/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la brten nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las nyan thos kyi sde smod tshul bzhin du thos/ thos don bsam/ bsam don bsgom pa ste/ de'ang dang por 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa bsgom pa sogs zhi gnas kyis sems las su rung bar byas rjes/ lhag mthong ni/ bden bzhi re re'ang bzhi bzhir phye ba'i bden chung bcu drug bsgoms te/ gzhi de las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa 124

mthong bas spang bar bya ba sogs sprong tshul ye shes bcu drug gis rim par spong ngo / de la bden chung bcu drug ni/ mi rtag sdul bsngal/ stong pa ༈ bdag med bzhini sdug bden gyi rnam pa'o/ rgyu/ kun 'byung / rab skye/ rkyen bzhi ni kun 'byung gi'o/ 'gog pa / zhi ba/ gya nom pa/ nges 'byung bzhi ni 'gog bden gyi'o/ lam/ rig pa/ sgrub pa/ nges 'byin bzhi sna lam bden gyi rnam pa ste bcu drug go/ ye shes bcu drug ni/ bden bzhi re re la'ang / chos shes / chos bsgod gnyis/ rjes shes/ rjes bzod gnyis te bcu drug go/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas nas rang don gtso bor spyod pa ste/g.yu thang las/ spyod pa'ang rang don 'ba' zhig pa'o/ zhes so/ drus pa 'bras rtsani/ rgyun zhugs dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba ste gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang / mthar thug zad pa shes pa dang mai skye ba shes pa 'i ye thes gnyis dang ldan pa'i lhag bcas lhag med kyi dgra bcom pa thob cing / 'bras bu bzhi po re re la'ang zhugs gnas gnyis su phye bas brgyad de/ dbye gzhi la ltos nas skyes bu zung bzhi dang / dbye chos la stos nas gang zag ya brgyad ces bya'o/di dag kyang rgyas pa las/ bden bzhi'i don rtogs rab tu spong ba yi/ /ye shes bcu drug cha sbyangs rab zhi ba/ /rgyun zhugs la sogs rim pas sbyangs nas ni//nyon mongs dgra rnams zhi ba'i sa ru 'gro/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa rang byang chub 125

kyi theg pa la'ang gsum/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ slob dpo na la ma brten par srid pa tha ma'i tshe byang chub mngon du byed pa'i thabs bdag med phyed dang gnyis rtogs kyi sgo nas rten 'brel gyi lam bsgom pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/pra treeka budru'i sgra las rang gi byang chub rang gis rtogs par byed pa'i phyir/ so so'am rang gcig pu byang chub sgrub pas na rang rgyal lo/ gsum pa la/ sngar ltar drug las/ dang po 'jug sgo ni/ rang shar las/ 'jug pa'i sgo ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis so/ /zhes pas/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jugade'ang rten 'brel ni/ he ru ka gal po las/ rang rgyal chos la blo sbyang phyir//phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel chos/ /zhes pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel bcu gnyis so/ji ltar 'jug na/ spyir rang rgyal dbang rab bse ru ltabu ni tshogs lam gyi tshogs bskal pa brgya dang / dbang 'bring tshogs spyod che ba bzod 'bring man chad kyis bsdus pa'i tshogs mi tshe brgya dang / dbang rtul tshogs spyod chung ba mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga man chad kyis bsdus pa'i tshogs mi tshe bcu gsum du bsags te/ rten de la byang chub thob pa'i skal ba med par shes nas smon lam btab pas sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyis yongs su ma bzung ba'i 'jig rten du skye ba len te/dbu ma rtsab las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni ma byon zhing / /nyan thos rnams ni zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni/ /rten pa med par rab tu 'byung / /zhes 126

so/ srid pa tha mar mkhan slob med par rang byung gi dge slong du gyur cing / dur khrod du phyin pa na/ rus pa mthong ma thag 'khor ba la yid 'byung ste/ rus pa 'di dag gang las byung brtags pas rga shi las byung / de skye ba las byung ba sogs/'di ltar rim gyis 'khor ba'i rtsab ma rig par rtogs te/ 'di las ji ltar thar bar bya snyam pa na/ yang ma rig pa 'gags na 'du byed 'gag pa nas rga shi'i bar 'gag pa ste/ lugs ldog rten 'brel rtogs pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'o/ gnyis pa ltab ni/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa nyan thos dang 'dra la/ de'i steng du chos bdag gi gzung cha rdul phra rab rang bzhin med par rtogs kyang da dung 'dzin sems skad cig ma don dam du lta zhing / 'khor 'das rten 'brel rgyu 'bras su 'dod pas na/ bdag med phyed dang gnyis rtogs zhes bya ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang / /'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ /rten gyi bse ru ltabu'i lam/ /yang dag bsdus par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / lta rim las/ de bzhin rang rgyal theg pa yang / /phyi rol bcu gnyis sgru ma tsam//rdul kyang phyogs chas ma grub 'phags/ /shes pa skad cig rjes su mthun/ zhes so/ gsum pa tshul khrims ni/ nyan thos dang 'dra ste/ yang 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ nyan thos rang rgyal bsrung mtshams ni/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i 'dul khrims yin/ /zhes so/ bzhi pa bsgom pa ni/ sa sde las/ nyan thos ji lta ba 127

bzhin du rig par bya ste/ de dag dang lam gyi rang bzhin mtshungs pa'i phyir/zhes nyan thos kyi sde sdod la dmigs nas lam bsgom par bzhed kyang / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdor nyan thos kyi sde stod las logs su rang rgyal gyi sde sgrod bshad ces gong ma rnams gsung zhing / mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa'agrel sogs las kyang nyan rang la lam gyi khyad par yod par bzhed pa ltar/ bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi steng du/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung bkag nas lugs ldog stong pa bcu gnyis khrigs chags su bsgom par byed pa'o/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/ gdul bya la ngag gis chos mi gsung bar/ lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi brdas don byed pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /ji ltar ji ltar nyan 'dod pa/ /de de la don de dang de/ /sgra med kyang ste de ltar snang //zhes dang / g.yu thang las/ /spyod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gzhan don shas 'ga' spyod pa'o/ /zhes so/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ dbang rnon bse ru ltabu gcig pur bzhugs pa ni lam lnga stan thog gcig tu rdzogs nas/ yid bzhin bde ba mchog gi sa zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i dgra bcom pa mngon du mdzad de/ mdzod las/ ston dang bse ru byang chub pa/ /bsam gtan mtha' rten gcig la kun//de yi sngon du thar cha mthun/ /zhes so/ nee tsoltabu khyur bzhugs pa tshogs spyod che chung gnyis ni rim par lam bzhi dang gsum mngon du mardod do/ de dag kyang 128

rgyas pa las/ rten 'brel sgyu ma mig yor tshul shes shing / /dngos po'i gzugs la thogs med rab tu 'jug /dge bshes mai slob rang gi rig pas rtogs//byang chub sa bgrod yid bzhin bde ba mchog /ces so/ gsum pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la gnyis/ theg dman las 'phags tshul dang / khyad par 'phags pa'i theg pa nyid bshad pa'o/ dang po ni / shes rab che bas bdag med gahais rnal mar rtogs nus pa dang / snying rje che bas gzhan don 'ba' zhig spyod nus pas 'phags te/ theg pa chung ngu la de dag med pa'i phyir ro/ ye shes rnam par bkod pa'i rgyud las/ thugs rjes sems can la dmigs shing / /shes rab chos kyi dbyings su khyab/ /theg pa chen po zhes bshad de/ /gzhan dag de las bzlog pa'o/ /zhes dang / blob dpon a ros/ theg pa'i khyad par shes rab nga rje kho na ste/ 'di dag che chung dbang gis theg pa'i khyad par bsnan/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du lhung //zhes so/ gnyis pa khyad par 'phags chos de ldan byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa 'a da pa la gsum/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs shing / snying rje chen pos gzhan don rlabs po che spyod pa'i masam dam par gyur pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/ bodhi satwa'i sgra las sems stobs chen chag na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la gcig tu mi zhum pa'i phyir byang chub sems 129

dpa' zhes bya'o/ gsum pa la drug las/ dang po 'jug sgo ni/ bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas te/ rang shar las/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ni/ /'jug pa'i sgo ni bde2 pa gnyis/ /zhes so/ /de yang dbu ma pa'i gzhung ltar na/ ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i snang ba 'di rnams snang yang ngo bo bden med sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i blos byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byas nas dge mi dge'i 'jug ldog gi tshul gyis kun rdzob kyi bden par 'jug la/ don dam gzhis kyi gnas lugs spros bral du shes par byas te zung 'jug si sgo nas 'jug go de la bden pa gnyis ni/ he ru ka gal po las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis su yang dag 'dus/ /zhes so/ de yang dbye gzhi shes bya tsam las/ snang lugs kun rdzob dang / gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis su dbye ste/ de las/ shes bya tsam gyi snang ba la/ /bden pa gnyis kyi zhing yang grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de las kun rdzob bden pa nee/blo'i yul du gyur pa'i chos mtshan ma can te/ de las/ bsu zhing blo yi yul gyur pa/ /kun rdzob spyi yi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ dbyen/ snang la don byed nus pa mi la mir snang ba ltabu yang dag kun rdzob/ snang la don byed mi nus pa tho yor la mir snang ba lta bu log pa'i kun rdzob ste/ de las/ kun rdzob dbye ba yang dag dang / /log pa'i kun rdzob ces bya'o/ /so so'i mtshan nyid rab bzhad bya/130

/snang la don byed mi nus log /yang dag snang la rdon byed nus/ /zhes dang /bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byas/ /zhis so/don dam bden pa ni/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ste/ sal po las/don dam pa yi mtshan nyid ni/ /spros pa thams cad bral ba yin/ /zhis dang ༈ dze tā ri'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa las/ yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis ka'i bdag nyid du yang med/ /mtha' bzhi dag las nges grol ba/ /zhes so/ dbye na/ spros pa phyogs re dang bral ba rnam grangs pa'i don dam dang / spros pa mtha' das dang bral ba rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam ste/ gal po las/ dbye ba rnam grangs don dam dang / /rnam grangs ma yin mtha' brgyad bral/ /zhes so/ de ltar bden pa gnyis po de gcig gam tha dad ce na/ tha snyad du chu dang chu zla ltar rang bzhin gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa stetsā byang chub sems 'grel las/ bu ram rang bzhin mngar ba dang / /me yi rang bzhin tshob ltar/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas/ /zhes so/ don dam par gcig tha dad gang du'ang brjod du med de/byams pas zhus pa las/ 'du byed kyi mtshan ma zhwa sa brjod du med pa'i dbyings de skyid spyang ma yin la/ gzhan yang ma yin no/ /zhes so/ de'ang dbu ma pas don 131

dam 'jog tshul la tha dad med kyang / kun rdzob tu snang ba sgyu ma tsam du grub par khas len pa rang rgyud pa dang / snang dus nyid nas spros pa dang bral bar 'dod cing kun rdzob tsam yang 'gog pa thal 'gyur ba'o/ sems tsam pa ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi yul dang yul can kun rdzob dang / gnyis med kyi shes pa rang rig rang gsal ni don dam bden par 'dod do/ dbye na/ phyi don shes pa'i rnam pa tsam du bden par 'dod pa rnam bden pa dang / snang ba shes pas sgro btags par 'dod pa rnam rdzun pa gnyis so/ gnyis pa lta ba ni/ bdag med gnyis phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'o/ de'ang kun rdzob tu chos thams cad chu zla ltar snang la/don dam par spros pa thams cad zhi ba'i tshul du 'jog pas bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa ste/ lta phreng las/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos thams cad don dam par ni rang bzhin med pa yin la/ kun rdzob tu ni sgyu ma tsam du so so'i mtshan nyid ma 'dres par yod do/ zhes dang / lam rim las/mnyam pa'i don nyid mi shes shing / /kun rdzob don dam gnyis 'byed la/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med na/ /'di ni byang chub sa pa yin/ /zhes so/ gsum pa tshul khrims la/ dge ba chos sdud kyi/ sems can don byed kyi/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang gsum/ dang po sna/ tshogs gnyis dang phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i legs spyad dge ba'i tshogs sgrub pa'o/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam sbyor 132

thams cad sems can gyi don du spyod pa'o/ gsum pa ni/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la sems bskyed len pa'i rten du so thar gyi sngom ldan dgos par ma nges kyang / byang sar nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims so thar rigs bdun la bzhad pa ltar de dag gi bslab byar gnas pa gzhir bzhag gi steng du/ byang chub la dmigs pa'i smon sems dang / de'i ched du tshogs dang bya ba la sbyor ba'i 'jug sems te/ dbu sems gang rung gi cho gas blangs la/ de'i bslab bya la bslab pa'o/ de la sems tsam pa ni rtsaltung bzhir 'dod de/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ rnyed dang bkur ster chags pa yi/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ /ser snas chos nor mi ster dang / /gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ /khro bas gzhan la 'tshogs pa dang / /theg pa chen po spong byed cing / /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o/ /zhes so/ dbu ma pa ltar na/bcu dgu'am nyi shur 'dod de/ rgyal po la nges pa lnga / blon po la nges pa lnga /phal pa la nges pa brgyad/ thun mong du smon sems btang ba dang bcu dgur nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te bslab btus su bzhad/ de'i steng du 'jug sems spangs te dge ba la mi sbyor ba dang nyi shur dkon mchog brtsegs dzilas gsungs so/ de dag kyang spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /thams cad 'bad pas srungs shig ces/133

/bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /zhes pa ltar dran pa dang / shes bzhin ma nyams pas/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing / dkar chos bzhi dang du blang ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas chud ma zos par bsrung ba la 'bad pa'o/ bzhi pa bsgom pa ni/ spyir slob pa'i lam bzhir byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsabadun bsgom ste/ tshogs lam chung ngur dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ 'bring du yang dag spong bzhi/ chen por rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi/ spyor lam drod rtser dbang po lnga/ bzod pa chos mchog tu stobs lnga / mthong lam du byang chub yan lag bdun/ bsgom lam sa dgur 'phags lam brgyad bsgom pa'o/ bye brag tu thog ma nas ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul 'khor lo tha ma nges pa don gyi mdo sde'i dbang du byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i tshul khong du chud par byas la/ rigs can des byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ snang yul ma 'gags la 'dzin rtog zhi ba'i stang nge 'dzin skye ba'i zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong ni snang ba sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du blta ba dang / gzung 'dzin phra rags thams cad stong par thag bcad pa chos nyid snong pa la brtag pa dang / mtha' bral dbu ma'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa rnams te/zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bsgom pa'o/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes bya ste//zhes so/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/ rjes thob kyi dus su bdag bas gzhan gces kyi sgo 134

nas sems can gyi don byed pa'o/ de'ang spyod pa'i rang bzhin pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu la sgyu ma tsam du spyod de/ drug ni sbyin sogs dang / bcu ni thabs/stobs/ smon lam/ ye shes bzhi bsnan pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang du 'du'o/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ sa bcu dang lam lnga rim gyis bgrod nas/mi slob pa'i lam bcu gcil kun tu 'od kyi sa la/ rang don du chos kyi skur grol te gzhan don du gzugs sku gnyis la brten nas sems can gyi don 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar tu mardod pa yin no/ de dag kyang rgyas pa las/ bdag med gnyis rtogs pha rol phyin rdzogs pa'i/ /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sangs rgyas sa bgrod go 'phang 'thob pa'i lam/ bden pa gnyis kyis rab tu 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/༈ de ltar rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i rnam gzhag mdo tsam smos nas/ da ni gnyis pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod kyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa la gahais te/ rgyu'i theg pa las khyad par 'phags tshul dang / khyad par can gyi theg pa nyid bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang gamiongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi thes pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sdu / gnyis pa gyi dge ba ni/ phyi nang gi theg pa gnyis so/ dang po la'ang / rang shar las/ phyi pa 135

rgyud la rnam sasum ste/ /kri ya u pa yo ga'o/ /zhes pas༈ bya ba'i rgyud dang gnyis ka'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi theb pa'o/ dang po la gsu ma༈ ngo bo༈nges tshig dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ don dam par mtha' bzhi dang bra' ba'i das par rtogs shing kun rdzob tu dngos grub gzhan la re zhing stsol ba'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ lam rim las/ gnyis med mnyam par ma shes pas༈ /don dam das pa chos nyid tsam/ /ye shes bzhi yon kun rdzob lha/ /res bsgom bya ba las kyi sa //zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ kri ya'i sgra bya ba ste/ phyi'i bya ba satso bor snon pa'i phyir/bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa las/ rgyud 'di ni lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pas na bya ba'i rgyud ces bya'o/ zhes so/ gsum pa dbye na drug gi dang po 'jus sgo la/ thog ma'i 'jug sgo smin byed dang / bya ba'i 'jug sgo gnyis/ dang po ni/chu dang cod pan gyi dbang zhakhor bcas bskur bas slob ma snod rung du byed pa ste/ye shes thig le las/ chu yi dbang bskur dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra dang dag pa gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug ste/ rang shar las/ 'jug pa'i sgo ni dag pa gsum/ /khrus dang gtsang sbras 'jug pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang dag pa gsum ni/ de las/ dag pa rnam gsum gang zhe na/ /lha dang dkyil 'khe ra dag pa dang / /rdzas dang longs spyod dag pa dang / /sngags dang stang 'dzin dag pa'o/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa lta ba 136

ni/ kri ya don dam chos nyid blta/ /kun rdzob rang rig yon tan lha/ /risas gsum dkyil 'khor snang ba la/ /skye bo 'khrul pa med par 'dod/ /ces pas bden pa gnyis te/ don dam bden pa ni/ sems nyid dag pa stong bsal gyi ye shes yad med snang stong gi mtha' bzhi dang bral bar 'dod de/ la shan las/rang sems mtha' bzhi yongs bral ba/ /rig phyir ye shes gzhan las min//zhes so/ kun rdzob la/ yang log gnyis las/ log pa'i kun rdzob ni/ dbu ma pa man chad kyis yang dag dang log par brtags pa'i kun rdzob thams cad yin la / yang dag kun rdzob ni/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i yon tan rigs gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor du snang bar 'dod pa ste/ de nyid las/ skyed bslang snang ba'i ye shes kyis/ /snang ba'i dngos po mtho 'jam rtsub/ /drug phyed rigs kyi dkyil 'khengar du/ /mthong ba rnam par dag ces bya/ /zhes so/ gsum pa tshul khrims ni/ yang 'byed 'phrul lde las/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems //sngags dang phyag rgya mi spang zhing / /rdo rje dril bu spang mi bya/ ༈lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /de ni yan lag dam tshig yin/ /rtsaba'i dam chig lnga po ni/ /khri la lhal bar mi bya zhing / /sha mi za zhing chang mi btung / /sgog pa la phug bza' mi bya/rici skyonas dam tshig bcu gcig tu gsungs/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las spyi'i dam tshig skugasum dang / bye brag gi dam tshig bcu gsum du bshad pa la sogs pa'o/ bzhi 137

pa bsgom pa la/ mtshan bcas/ mtshan med gnyis las/ dang po ni/ he ru ka gal po las/ chos nyid sgra dang yid gzugs thugs/ /ye shes yongs rdzogs skur sgrub bsgom/ /zhes pas kri ya don gyi lha drug gi sgo nas dam tshig pa bskyed de/ de'ang stong pa nyid kyi lha dang / yi ge'i lha dang / sgra'i lha dang / gzugs kyi lha dang / phyag rgya'i lha dang / mtshan ma'i lha'o/ rnam 'jioms las/ snong pa yi ge sgra gzugs dang / /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin te/ /zhes gsungs so//de ltar ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ mchod bstod dang bzlas pa sogs byas la/rje khol gyi tshul du bltas nas dngos grub blang ste/ rang shar las/ lha dang rnal 'byor dag pa gnyis/ /rje dang 'bangs kyi tshul du blta/ /zhes dang / rigs thams cad pa'i dngos grub len pa'i rgyud las/ rje dpon rgyal po'i tshul bltas la / /rang nyid bran gyi 'du shes kyis / /sngags sgrub dngos grub snying po ni/ /bla na med pa'i mchog tu blang / /zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshan bcas lha dang yig 'bru la sogs pa ra bsgom pa'i snang ba de'ang mi dmigs pa mtha' bzhi dang brasnyesmu pa'i ngang du 'jog pas bden gahais res bsgom ste/ la shan las/ snang stong rim gyis brtan par byed/ /ces so/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/ bya ba drug ste/ 'jug pa'i dus dang / zas dang / gos dang / gtsang sbra dang / dmigs rten dang /bzlas brjod sngags kyi bya ba rnams so/ gal po las/ gza' skar dus chigs 138

zas gos gtsang / /brtul zhugs dka' thub spyad pa spyod/ /ces dang / lta phreng las/ sku'i gzugs brnyan dang / thugs phyag mtshan dang / bzlas bajiod dang /zhes sogs gsungs so/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ mi tshe bdun na rigs gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can 'thob par 'dod pa ste/gal po las/ mi 35 bdurnga na sangs rgyas sa/ /rigs gsum mgon pos 'gro la'adul/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa u pa ya'i theg pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ lta sgom ya ga dang spyod pa bya ba ltar spyod pas dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ lta phreng las/ gnyis ka la brten pa las grub pa'o/ zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ u pa'i sgras phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang gi rnal 'byor gnyis cha mnyam du spyod pa'i phyir gnyis ka'i rgyud ces bya ste/ rang shar las/ u pa ya ni 'di lta ste/ /lta ba yo gar lta ba la/ /spyod pa kri nga/ra spyod pa'o/ /de phyir gnyis ka'i rgyud ces grags/ /zhes so/ gsum pa dbye na drug gi dang po 'jug sgo la'ang gnyis las/ dang po dbang ni/ chu dang cod pan gnyis kyi steng du rdor dril ming gsum sne/ ye shes thig le las/ rdo rje dril bu nee bzhin ming / /spyod pa'i rgyud du rab tu gsal/ /zhes so/ /bya ba'i 'jug ge dang / gsum pa tshul khrims dang / lnga pa spyod pa rnams bya rgyud dang / gnyis bholtab dang / bzhi pa sgom pa'i stang nge 'dzin ni yo ga dang shas cher mthun pa ste/14 9

g.yu thang las/ gnyis ka rgyud kyi 'dod pa ni/ /spyod pa bya ba'i rjes mthun yang //lta ba rnal 'byor rjes mthun phyir/ /rigs dang lta bas khyad par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / lta rim las/ gnyis ka rgyud kyi 'dod pa ni/ /lta spyod gong 'og rjes su mthun/ /zhes so/ 'on kyang rgyal ba rigs bzhir lta zhing bsgom pa sosas khyad par cung zad yod par gsungs so/ /drug pa 'bras bu ni/ mi tshe lnga na rigs bzhi rdo rje'adzin pa'i sa thob par 'dod pa ste/ rigs bzhi ni las kyi rigs rin chen rigs la bsdus pa'o/ gal po las/ rigs bzhi rdo rje 'chang sar gnas/ /zhes dang / kun byed las/ gnyis su med la mi tshe lngas sgrib gol//zhes so/ gsum pa yo ga'i theg pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba'o/ dang poni/ don dam mtshan ma med pa'i chos nyid kyi byin brlabs kun rdzob rdo rje dbyings kyi lhar brtags te rtogs pa bzang ngan blang dor gyi rtsol bas 'bras bu sgrub par 'dod pa ste/ lam rim las/ lhun grub mnyam pa ma mthong bas/ /chos kun rnam dag ye shes kyi/ /byin rlabs rdo rje dbyings sprul pa/ /blang dor 'byed pa rnal 'byor pa'o/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ yo ga'i sgra las nang gi rnal 'byor gtso bor byed pa'am ston pas na rnal 'byor rgyud ces bya ste/ lta phreng las/ rnal 'byor gtsobor byas pas 'grub pa'o/ zhes so/ gsum pa dbye na drug gi dang po 'jug sgo la gnyis las/ dang po dbang ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i steng du rdo rje 140

pon gyi dbang dang drub bsku ra rte/ ye thes this le las/ phyir mai ldo sa pa dbang ༈ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gas la bar byas/ ༈de sna drus si bye bras /zhing / /de ni slob da pon dbang zhes bya/ /zhes so / gnis pa bya ba'i 'jus sbo ༷ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi stang nge 'dzirna gyi sgo nas 'jug sne/ kun byed (zhi / ya ga sdug po b.long 'dod pa/ /mtshan ma yod med sgor zhusas nas༈1skos so/ gnyis pa lta ba ni/ bden pa gnyis te/ don dam bden pa ni/ chos mamos cad spros pa'i mtshan ma dang bra' ba'i rang bzhin 'od gsal sto nga pa nid de༈ gra ha las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ tsāngo bo nyid kyis sadod nas dag /ces so/ kun rdzob la sanis kyi/ 'o ba pa 'i kun rdzob sngar dang 'dra la/ yang dag kun rdzob ni/ cir snang thams cad chos nid rtsogs pa'i byin rlabs rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du snang ba'i phyir༈ snang ba rang rgyud du brtags ju 'di med par 'dod do/ gal po la sa/ ya ga'i thes pa ra gnas 'dod pas /'og min rdo rje dbyings su blta/ /zhes dang / lta rim las/ ya ga don da ma rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su / /rtogs pa'i byin rlabs lhar snang ba/ /de phyir skye bo ltar mthong 'khrul/ /zhes dang / g.yu thang las kyang /rang rig dngos mthong mtshan ma gnyis/ /dbyer med dbyings dang ye shes la sa ༈/byin rlabs rdo rje dbyings kyi lha/ /shar lta grogs po'i tshul du blta༈ /zhes so/141

gsum pa tshul khrim sa ni/ rtse mor gsungs pa'i rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig byang chub kyi sems dang por bskyed cing / de'i rjes su tshul khrims gsum gyi bslab pa la nan tan byed pa dang / bye brag gi dam tshig la/ snang mardod kyi dam tshig gsum/ mai bskyod rin 'byung gnyis la bzhi bzhi/ mtha' yas kyi gcig don grub kyi gnyis te bcu bzhir gsungs la/ yang 'byed 'phrul lder/ bya rgyud kyi dam tshig bcu gcig po'i steng du thun min gnyis bsnan nas bcu gsum du bshad de/ ji skad du/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bsrung mtshams ni/ gong gi bsrung mtshams steng du ni/ /lung gcig chu la mi btung zhing / /nyams dang kha mi bsre ba bsrung //zhes so/ /bzhi pa ba〈(ma pa la/ ma'argan bcas/ ma med gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga dang cho 'phrul bzhi'i sgo nas lha dang lha mo'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya bzhi ldan du bsgom pa ste/ lta phreng las/ phyi ya byad la gtso bor mi 'dzin par don dam par skye 'gag med pa'i lha dang lha mo dang / de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'phags pa'i gzugs kyi sku phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pa ra bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gtso bor byas pas 'grub pa'o/ zhes so de'ang dam tshig pa bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ spun nam grogs po'i tshul du bzang ngan med par bltas te/ mchod bsnod bzlas pa la sogs pa bya ba'o/ rang shar las/ lha dang rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyang / /spun dang grogs po'i tshul du 142

mod/ /ces so/ de la mngon byang lnga ni/ stong pa nyid dang / zla gdan dang /yi rdzorkyu nga ga 'bru dang /'othuṭwāṃs phyag matram̐/ dang mu/ngesku ṭwāṃngs su gas pa las na par byang chub ṭwāṃ/ 'phrulaṭwāṃzha naspe/༵nga 'alon dang /༵bang bskuṭwāṃ ṭā/ byin gyiṭwāṃb pa ṭwāṃng / mdaX' 'phrul / /ladzilaṭwāṃ/rlo cizla bgasu~X rje/ /ngobasdubasgom paṭwāṃ sku ru gaXl/ /tang 'aspen ṭwāṃ ba bskur ma~X/ /man byangaphyi lnga dang ༵ phrul bzha/ sdu/sgom zhang maṭwāṃ ༷ tripoyangayi/ /bad namaṭwāṃ sa ra tram̐ ba na/ /༷sa sa/ phyag rgya ṭwāṃ na/ ngag da dang bya ṭwāṃ ba la/ ramapabyeskuphyagachan/ kṣiṃng musaphyi rgya/rka dam rgya/sto na las las rgya /mas sa ṭwāṃs ༵ba nas bam pa' sper rlobyi/melangasprabulasogs kṣiṃ ye sheṭwāṃ ba man du ṭwāṃ ba dang sdir zhaX / ngas ye shes na de thams cad rang bgan du gnas pa/ gnyaṭwāṃpan/ ༷gamawo ma ༷da pa'i ngo bo nyid dang deṭwāṃ byin rlabs lhar snang ye shes snang dku /nyasaṭwāṃ med rngo~X ngang ṭwāṃmanyamapar 'ag pa stengo/ rdo rje 'byung ba las/dkus su da pa' sas dngas ngang/ /ṭwāṃ tram̐dadaspyos ṭwāṃbadamapablang / /bhes / sbyaṭwāṃ spyod ༷ na/ ṭwāṃtsang sbra sogs 'a kun da gyi /ོgaṭwāṃ dang ldan pa' sgo rnag ༵ ༷'a rnaṭwāṃ 'ar la gnas pas rang gzhan na da pa stemi/ rtsemo snye/ lha tang 'an la gnas te/ /sems can thams cad yongs gtodī /

//lhan tu sangs rgyas yid la byed/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas mchod pa mchog /ces so/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ mi tshe sasum na sdug po bkod pa'i sa la sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod de/ kun byed las/ yo ga sdug po bkod 'dod pas/ /mi tshe gsum na grol bar 'dod/ /ces dang / thugs kyi sgo lcags las/ gzung 'dzin bag chags lnga byang nas/ /ye shes lnga yi rtsal dag gis/ /sdug po bkod pa'i sa non nas/ /rigs lnga 'dus pa'i 'bras bu thob/ /skye med chos sku dag pa ni/ /skye med sgo nas 'gro don mdzad/ /phyag rgya rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'gro don rdzogs/ /sprul pa bye ba sa ya yis/ /rigs drug ngo la cir yang snon/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa nang pa thabs kyi rgyud kyi theg pa ni/ lta spyod stang nge 'dzin gsum dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa ste phyi rgyud rnams las khyad du 'phags pa'o/ dbye na༈rang shar las/ nang pa la ni gsum du 'dod/ /ma hā a nu a sta'o/ /zhes pas/rgyud ma hā yo ga lung a nu yo ga man ngag a ti yo ga'o/ de gsum gyi khyad par la/ zur chung pas/ rig pa'i cho 'phrul du snang ba ma hā/ rang rig pa'i rtsal du snang ba a nu/ rig pa rang snang ba a sta ste/ zhes 'dod pa ltar ru dga' rab rdo rjes/ cho 'phrul rtsal dang rang snang ba'o/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ de'i don ni/ chos thams cad sems nyid snang stong dbyer med kyi cho 'phrul du rtogs pa 144

gahā yo ga chos thams cad dbyings ye gnyis su med pa'i rtsal du rtogs pa a nu/ chos thams cad sems nyid ye nas skye 'asag med pa rang byung gi ye shes su rang snang bar rtogs pa a ti ste lta ba'i sgo nas khyad phye bar gsungs so/ yang skyo gong bu pa'i zhal nas/ ched 'dzin che chung yin te/ spyod pa gtso che ba ma hā/ṣkang nge 'dzin gtso che ba a nu/ lta ba gtso che ba a ti'o gsungs/ yang lha rje sdog ni/ stang nge 'dzin gsum gyis lha rim par bskyed pa'i phyir bskyed pa ma hā/nee la mi brten par lha rdzogs tshul du bskyed pa rdzogs pa a nu/ bskyed rdzogs gaṣkas las grol bas bskyed du med pa ni rdzogs pa chen po a ti'am/ yang na/rgyud kyi dngos po bcu la ched 'dzin che ba ma hā/ de bas chung ba a nu/ ched 'dzin las grol ba a sta'o gsungs/ me nyag 'byung grags kyi zhal nas/ yod bskyed rjogs gsum ka yod kyang / bskyed rim gtso por snon pa ma hā/ rdzogs rim gtsobor ston pa a nu/ de gnyis kyi rtsol ba dang bral ba rdzosas pa chen po'o gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen po ni/ gdul bya zhe sngang shas che zhing rtog pa mang ba'i don du snang ba thabs kyi rang bzhin pha rgyud ma hā/ 'dod chags shas che zhing sems gnas pa la dga' ba'i don du stong pa de kho na nyid kyi rdzogs rim shes rab ma rgyud stoskru/ gasta mug shas che zhing bya rtsol lhod pa can gyi don du gnyis su med pa'i ring bzhin a sta ya ga bsnan te/ tmakod pa chen po las/ sems yas pa la 145

bskyed pa ste/ /sems bcud can la rdzogs pa'o/ /mchog gsang rab la rdzogs pa che/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir gsungs shing / sems nyid ngal gso las kyang /ma hās rlung dang bskyed rim thabs gtso la/ /a nus khams dang rdzogs rim shes rab gtso/ /a stas thams cad gnyis med ye shes gtso/ /zhes so/ de la dang po ma hā yo ga'i theg pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba gsum/ dang po ni/thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa la gtsobor brten pa'i sgo nas lhag pa bden pa dbyer med kyi don la rtogs goms kyi sbyor bas grol ba thob pa'i rang bzhin no/ gnyis pa ni/ ma hā yo ga'i sgra las rnal 'byor chen po ste/ gnyis med kyi don la blo 'byor bas yo ga phyi pa las ches 'phags pa'i phyir ro/ gsum pa dbye na drug gi dang po 'jug sgo la gnyis las/ dang po dbang ni/ thun mong ba bum dbang gi steng du thun min mchog dbang gong ma gsum bsnan pas dbang bzhi bskur bar bya ste/ sgya 'phrul rtsargyud phyi ma las/ blob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /de ma thag pa bzhi pa ste/ /zhes so/ de yang bum dbang la phan nus gnyis su phye bas lngar 'gyur te/ rdo rje las rim las/ dbye ba rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ bdag phan nus pa gnyis ka'i las/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa bya ba'i 'jug sgo ni/ shes rab stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor dang / thabs snying rje sgyu ma dang / phyag rgya phra rags te/ stang 'dzin gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug ste/ bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i lam 146

yin pa'i phyir/ rang shar las/ 'jug pa'i sgo ni rnying 'dzin rnam pa gsum//zhes dang / yang 'byed 'phrul lde las/ ma hā ya ga'i 'jug sgo ni/ /stang 'dzin rnam gsum sgo nas 'jug /ces so/ gnyis pa lta ba ni/ rig pa spyos bral la snang ba ngo bo nyid kyi rgyur lhun grub tu 'dod pa'i don dam bden pa dang /de nyid kyi rtsal rtog tshogs thams cad sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rang snang ba kun rdzob kyi bden par 'dod la/ de gnyis kyang snang stong phyogs re ba ma yin te/ ngo bo dbyer mi phyed par mnyam pa nyid du snang ba'i phyir/ rnam bkod dā las/ lhas pa'i mnyam nyid dbyer med don/ /ming grangs cir yang bstan mod kyi kyang / /don du smra bsam yul las 'das/ /zhes dang / lam rim las de ming zhen pa grol phyir las/ /tha snyad gnyis par bsam brjod 'das/ /zhes so/mo gsum pa tshul khrims ni/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur ba rnams bsrung ba'i dam tshig thertsanyung bcu bzhi la sogs pa rnams dang / spyad bya'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud rdzilnga'i chirang bzhin du shes nas spyod pa gnyis su bzhed/ snga 'gyur gyi rang skad du/ rnal pada'abyor chen po'i dam chig nyi shu rtsabargyad gsungs te/ yang 'byed 'phrul lde las/’rdo la 'phyor chen po'i bsrung mtshams ni/ /rtsaba'i dam tshig gsum po dang / /yan sbyang ga rtswa shu rtsalnga bsrung / /zhes so/ de la rtsab ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam ni7jig gsum mo/ yan lag ni/ snga ma las/ spyad dang mi spang dang du blang /sku 147

/shes dang bsgrub par bya ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ bzhi pa bsgom pa la/ sgrub sde gtso bor byas pa dang / rgyud sde gtso por byas pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/'jam dpal sku 'khor lo bzhi la brten nas bde gshegs sku'i sgrub pa dang / ju mgrin rta skad thengs gsum la brten nas pad ma gsung gi sgrub pa dang / yang dag thugs rig pa rang byung gi ye shes yang dag grub pa gcig pu la brten nas thugs rdo rje'i sgrub pa dang / che mchog 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yon tan du rdzogs par ston pa bdun miyan tan gyi sgrub pa dang / phur pa mngon spyod kyi las kyis gdug pa can 'dul ba'i thabs gtso por ston pa phur pa phrin las kyi sgrub pa ste ye shes lha'i sgrub sde lda dang / ma mo rbod gtong / drag sngags dmod pa /'jig rten mchod bstod kyi sgrub pa ste thun mong gi sgrub sde gsum mo/ gnyis pa ni/ spyir ma hā yo ga la'ang pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum gyi dbye bas/ gsang 'dus la sogs pa pha rgyud du bskyed rim thabs kyi cha dang / de'i rdzogs rim kyang rlung gtso bor byed pas gsal snong rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len par 'dod/ bde dgyes yang dag sogs ma rgyud rnams su bskyed rim gyi spros pa shas chung zhing / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa khams byang chub kyi sems thig le gtso bor byed pa'i bde stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len par 'dod/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sogs ma ning gi rgyud rnams su bskyed rdzogs zung du 148

'jug cing de'ang rdzogs rim rtsathig rlung gsum las skyes pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang / khyad par 'od gas la ye shes chen po la gtso bor byed pa 'i tshul gyis nyams su len par 'dod do/ 'dir rtsargyud gsang ba snying po'i dbang du byas te bshad na/ rim gsum las/ mtshan ma bsgom pa'i rim pa dang / /de bzhin nyid ni bsgom pa yi/ /bye brag rnam pa sanyis su gsungs/ /zhes pas/mtshani bcas/ mtshan med gnyis/ dang po la/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/bskyed rim ni/ teng nge 'dzin gsum la brten nas dkyil 'khor rim gyis bskyed pa gtso bor byed pa'i sgo nas lha rtog dbyer med du bsgom pa'i nyams len/dela'ang / mos bsgom dang / nges rdzogs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ stang nge 'dzin la brtan pa ma thob kyang rnam pa tsam bsgom pa nub sacig la bskyed rim gyi cho ga'i yan lag tshang bar nyams su len pa ltabu/ gnyis pa ni/ zag bcas tshogs sbyor gyi rnal 'byor lnga dang / zag med rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'o/ rdzogs rim la/steng sgo 'ju 'dul gyi man ngag dang / 'og sgo khams gsum rol pa'i man ngag gnyis te/ rim gsum las/ gdams ngag steng dang 'og gi sgo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtshan med ni/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/ thabs la mkhas pa'i gding gis zin pas 'khor ba'i chos ci la'ang ma chags par spyod pa ste/ bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/149

bskyed pa ma hā yo ga ni/ /ta na dang ni ga na dang / /dam rdzas bdud rtsilnga po la//thabs chen lta ba'i spyod pas spyad/ /ces so/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ tshe 'di'am bar dor sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid mngon du byed pa ste/ gsang 'dus las/ 'di ni bcom ldan bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par brgyan/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ yang na lus ni spangs ma thag /brtson pa mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /ces so/ gnyis pa lung a nu ya ga'i theg pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshigadabye ba gsum/ dang po ni/ shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gtso bor brten pa'i sgo nas dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i don la rtogs goms kyi sbyor bas grol ba thob pa'i rang bzhin no/ gnyis pa ni/ a nu yo ga ste shes rab rjes chags kyi lam gtsopor ston pa'i phyir rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ gsum pa dbye ba la drug gi dang po 'jug sgo la gnyis las/ dang po dbang ni/ a nu'i dkyil 'khor du phyi nang sgrub gsang bzhis bsdus pa'i dbang chog sum cu rtsadrug ste/kun 'dus las/ phyi yi dbang dang nang gi dbang / /sgrub pa'i dbang dang gsang ba'i dbang / /bcu dang bcu gcig bcu gsum dang / /rnam pa gnyis kyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa bya ba'i 'jug sgo ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas 'jug ste/ kun byed las/ a nu dbyer med pa 'dod 150

pa'i / /dbyings dang ye shes sgor zhugs nas/ /zhes so/ ji ltar 'jug ce na/ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis te/ thugs kyi sgo lcags las/ skye med dbyings nyid ye shes te/ /ye shes rig pa dbyings haid tshul/ /gnyis med rol pa bde ba che/ /rim par 'jug pa ma yin te/ /snang srid phyag rgya thams cad la/ /chu la nya ldang ji bzhin du/ /thugs phrad snang srid phyag rgya che/ /zhes so/ sanyis pa lta ba ni/ chos thams cad rang gi sems yin la/ de nyid skye med spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin yum kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa ste/ ye ji bzhin pa'i dkyil 0keṅger zhes kyang bya'o/ spyi mdo las/ sems las byung ba stong nyid pas/ /de las byung ba thams cad stong / /zhes so/ skye med de nyid thams cad du mi 'gag par rig pa rang byung 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba ni ye shes kun tu bzang po'am/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ste/ de las /brtags na ma mthong cir yang snang ba nyid/ /ces so/ de gnyis ngo bo tha mi dad par gsal ba ni dbyings ye shes gnyis su med pa'i sras bde ba chen po ste rtsab byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khenar ro/ snga ma las/ gsang sngags zhes bya ba ni/snang ba dang mi snang ba gnyis su med pa/ gahais kyi ngo bo las grol ba / dbu mar sa pa gang yin pa de kho na nyid do/ zhes so/ de'i phyir chos thams cad da ma 'khor rnatshipa gsum dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin rtsab byang chub sems kyi 151

dkyil 'khor du ye nas sangs rgyas par lta ba ste/ de las/ tham sa cad de nyid der sacig pa sa/ /ye nas sangs rgyas bde chen nyid/ /skye 'asas med pa'i snying po yin/ /bya byed med pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ /ye nas grub zin lhun gyis grub/ /ces dang / g.yu thang las/ snang srid bzang mo'i mkha' klong las//ma bskyed dkyil 'khor kun bzang shar/ /shar ba nyid na shar ba med/ /yab yum sras bcas bde chen po/ /zhes dang / bang mardood 'phrul lde las/ rdzogs pa a nu yo sa ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du 'dod/ /ces so/ gsum pa tshul khrims ni/don bsdus las/ gzhi 'dzin pa ni dam tshig ste/ /sgo sasum sdom par gnas pa'i don/ /rtsab yan lag la sogs pa'i / /bsrung dang bsgrub pa de nyid do//zhes pas sgo gsum gyis rtsab dang yan lag la sogs pa'i dam tshig bsrung zhing bsgrub par bya ba rnams te/ de'ang dbye na/ gal mdo nges pa'i dam tshig bzhi/thun mong gi nyi shu rtsabargyad/ lhag pa'i bzhi/ brtul zhugs kyi nyer gsum/sgrub pa'i nyi shu/ spyod la ma rgyun gyi bzhi/ bdud lnga spang ba/ dgra bzhi gzhom pa/lta ba'i dam tshig ste rnam grangs dgur spyi mdo'i le'u re drug par gsungs mod kyang / bsdu na/ bsrung mtshams med pa cig car ba'i dam tshig dang / bsrung mtshams can rim gyis pa'i dam tshig gnyis su 'du ste/ spyi mdo las/ bsrung 152

bya bsrung du med pa ni/ /chos nyid dam tshig dam pa yin/ /zhes dang / dam tshig 'di ni rmad poche/ /kun gyi thun mong ma yin phyir/ ༈mos pa chung ngu thams cad la/ /bsrung ba'i mtsham sa dag bzung bar byas/ ༈zhis so/ ba'i pa bsgom pa la/ don bsdus las/ ngo bo thabs dang shes rab ste/ /zhes pa sa thabs lam dang / grol lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ steng sgo 'khor lo bzhi'am drug bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang / 'og sgo mkha' gsang gnyis kyi snyoms 'jug la brten nas lhan skyes kyi ye shes bskyed pa'i thabs bsnan pa rnams so/ gnyis pa la/ don bkod pa dang tsā rtags kyi rol pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i stang nge 'dzin te/ chos nyid snying po ji bzhin pa'i ngang las sgom byed kyi blo ma bcos par 'jog pa'o/ spyi mdo las/ ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la༈/de bzhin pa yi blo bzhag nas/ /bajiod pa med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /ma yengs rgyun du dran pa'o/ /zhes so/ gnyis pa ni/ spros bcas lha yi stang nge 'dzin te/sngags brjod pa tsam gyis chu las nya ldang ba ltar/ snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'a31ra gsal la ma 'dres par cig car du bsgom pa gtso bor byed pa'i nyams len no/bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/ a nu yo ba'i theg par ni/ /snying po tsam zhis bajiod snye rgas/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i lha ru bsgom/ /zhes so/ de'ang nges rdzogs ga mopa'i lam la zag bcas dang / zag med sanyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dun 153

pa sems pa'i rnal 'byor dang / rigs chen 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ gnyis pa ni/ dbugs chen 'byin pa'i / lung chen thob pa'i/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/ spyir mnyam pa nyid la gtso bor spyod pa ste/bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/ rdzogs pa a nu yo ga ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ zhes so/ bye brag tu dbye na/ byin gyis rlob dang / dbang bsgyur dang / thabs kyi spyod pa gsum ste/ spyi mdo las/ byin gyis rlob kyi spyod pa dang / /dbang bsgyur thabs kyi spyod pa ste/ /dper na nam mkha' rgyal po'am//ji ltar me dpung chu bo 'dra/ /zhes so/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ tshe gcig gis 'bras chos nyer lnga dbyer med lhun grub kyi ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du byed de/ thig le mchog gi rgyud las/ 'od gsal ba yi sems nyid ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med par/ /bde ba che de su bsgom pa / /'bras bu tshe 'dir rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dang / bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/a nu ya ga'i theg pa ni/ /bar ma chod pa'i tshe gcig gis/ /sangs rgyas sa la nges par 'gro/ /zhes so/ gsum pa man ngag a ti yo ga'i theg pa la / ngo bo/nges tshig dbye ba gsum/ dang po ni/ ye sangs rgyas ba'i don rang thog tu grol bar byed pa'i thabs/ spang blang re dogs dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can no/gnyis pa ni/ a ti yo ga ste/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i rdzogs rim mthar thug 154

payin pa'i phyir dang / theg pa thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur ba'i phyir shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ gsum pa dbye na drug gi dang po 'jug sgo la gnyis las/ dang po dbang ni/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang la sogs pas smin par byas pa'o/ gnyis pa bya ba'i 'jug sgo ni/ ci yang 'jug tu med pa'i sgo nas 'jug ste/ kun byed las/chos la bya ru med pa'i phyir/ /rtsol ba med pa'i sgo nas 'jug /ces so/gnyis pa lta ba ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang byung gi ye shes chen po'i ngo bor bya rtsol med par ye nas sangs rgyas par 'dod de/nam mkha' che las/ rang byung ye shes rtsol med las/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /zhes dang / khyung chen las/ rang byung ye shes mai rtog kun tu ji bzhin gnas/ /zhes so/ gsum pa tshul khrims ni/ med pa dang phyal pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig las mi 'da' bar bya ba ste/ yang 'byed 'phrul lde las༈a sta yo ga'i dam tshig ni/ /med pa dang ni phyal ba dang / /gcig pu dang ni lhun gyis grub/ /de yi don las 'da' mi bya/ zhis so/ bzhi pa bsgom pa ni/ a sta bkod pa chen po las/ yid can rnams la sems kyi sde/ /nam mkha' can la klong gi sde/ /rim rtsol bral la man ngag sde/ /zhes pa ltar/ rig stong chos sku'i ngang du 'jog pa sems sde/ chos nyid bya rtsol med pa'i ngang du 'jog pa klong sde/ ye grol spang blang bral ba'i chos nyid kyi ngang du 'jog pa man ngag sde'o/155

de'ang spyir rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs kyi bsgom pa ni/ khregs chod dang / thod rbal gnyis su 'du ste/ mu stag phreng ba las/ nyams blangs khregs chod thod rgal lo/ /zhes so/ de las dang po ni/ ka dag gi lta ba'i ngang las ma g.yos par 'ardzog pa ste/ khyung chen las/ lhun gyis gnas pas bzhag pa yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas budha ste//sems la skye 'gag med pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos kun mnyam nyid yang dag don rtogs nas/ /de nyid ma btsal bzhag na bsgom pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/de ltar bsgoms pa'i sa lam gyi bskyed rim bzhi ste/ gnas dang mai g.yo mnyam nyid lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs so/ gnyis pa thod rgal ni/ gnad drug la brten nas snang bzhi rim par 'char ba ste/ chos nyid mngon sum/ nyams gong 'phel/ rig pa tshad phebs/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang bas mthar phyin pa'o/ lnga pa spyod pa ni/ cir snang chos nyid kyi rol par shar bas blang dor med par spyod pa ste/bang mardood 'phrul lde las/ a sta yo ga'i spyod pa ni/ /lta sgom srog dang ldan pa yis/ /shugs las byung ba'i spyod pa ni/ /ji ltar spyon pa'i spyod pa bzhin//gang la'ang thogs pa med par spyod/ /ces so/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang po'i sa la da lta nyid nas gnas pa mthar phyin pa ste/ gding bzhi tshad du phyin pas 'khor ba myang 'das su grol ba'o/ yang 'byed las/156

rdzogasachen a sta'i 'bras bu sna/ /gdodanasasnyingapobyangachubatu da/ ོba mad 'bras bu rang la smin/ /zhes bya ba la sogs ri rgya cher gsungs so/༈ lnga pa lta spyod phyin ci ma lag pa 'i tshul la rgyu mtshan rshas pas smon nga la/ dngos dang 'phros don gnyis las / dang po ni/ rmad byung za hor mabanapo'i spyod pa dang / /mtshungs med dpal ljan klu yi lta ba gnis༈ /zung 'bre' brgyud pa'i bka' srol phyag rgyas btab / /ma tsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ste/ de la spyir sngon bod du chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs par dgongs nas ma khan po bodhi sutwa dang thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge slong bcu banyis spyan drangs te 'dul ba'i lha ma rgyun btsugs/ lo paṇa rnams kyis dbu ma risas tshogs so sas bsgyur te 'chad nyan gyi srol gtod/ phyis chos rgyal gyi sku tshe smad du 6 shang dang slob dpon ka ma la shī la gnyis kyis brgal brtags rtsod pa'i dus su'ang ༈ chos rgyal gyis deng phyin chad bod kyi 'bangs su gtogs pa thams cad spyod pa 'dul ba dang lta ba klu sgrub kyi lugs bzhin spyod ces bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge bkod pa ra mardodardoslob dpon chen po'i zhal nas kyang / nga yi gsang sngags 'di lta ba gtso che ste lta ba'i rjes su spyod pa ma shor bar mdzod/ de shor na dge snong sdig stong nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta bar 'gro/ lar spyod pa'i rjes su lta ba ma shor bar mdzod/157

de shor na dngos po dang mtshan mas bcings nas nam yang grol ba'i dusku mi 'ong /zhes gdams par mardod pa bzhin lta spyod ma mid pa zung 'brel du slob pa'i brgyud pa zam ma chad par byung ba dag dang / srol rnam pa gnyis las brgyud pa'i theg chen sems bskyed kyis gzhi gzung / thun mong so byang gi bslab pa ji skad bsnan pa rnams kyis rgyas btab pa bcas bka' srol dor du mi rung ba dag 'phel 'grib ci rigs pa ni byung mod kyi/ da lta dus ngan gyi rba klong g.ya ba'i skabs na yang nyung zad nas 'dul ba la gces spras dang 'khor lo gsum gyi gzhung 'grel la 'chad nyan bag re tsam ma nub par gnas pa ni/ chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / khyad par slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i thugs bskyed las byung bas na/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs phyogs kun tu 'phel zhing thams cad kyang lta spyod phyin ci ma log pa'i tshul gyis yun ring du rgyas par gyur cig ces pa'o/༈ gnyis pa 'phros don gyi gdams pa la/ spyod pa ma smad pa dang / lta ba phul du byung ba la slob par bsnan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma las/ so so thar pa ris bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la//byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal pa yod kyi gzhan du min/ /zhes 'don pa ltar 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi rgyun 'gog cing sdom pa la tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba las ring du byed 158

pasaso/ de la dge bsten pha ma/ dge tshul pha ma/ dge slob ma/ dge slong pha ma rnams la rim bzhin bsrung bya lnga dang bcu dang bcu gnyis dang nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsagasum la sogs pa 'dul ba las bsnan pa ltar 'jug cing / ltung ba mi 'byung ba dang byung na phyir bcos pa la mkhas par bya zhing / phyin chad sngom sems med na cho ga 'aron pa tsam gyis ltung ba las ldang bar mi nus so/ de la kha cig so thar dang mi ldan na byang sdom mi thob par gsungs pa dgongs pa can yin te/ mdo sde za ma tog dang klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i zhus pa'i mdo sogs dang 'gal bar snang ngo zhes zer ro/ klu sogs 'gro ba gzhan dag la cho ga dang gzhan gyi rnam par rig byed las thob pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa med kyang / gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba'i sems pa tsam gyis theg chen gyi chos thob pa yin no/ 'o na mi la yang mtshungs so zhe na/ las brgya rtsagacig pa'i cho ga nub na mtshungs kyang thabs yad bzhin khyad du bsad pas mi rung zhes shugs las rtogs par bya'o/ so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ bsnan pa 'dul ba gangs can mtsho/ /gastang mtha' med pa thams cad kyi/ /gnas pa'i snying dang snying po ni/ /so so thar pa 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa las kyang thar 'dod skye rgu rnams kyis yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi mar mthong nas dang du blangs shing byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa na nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims su gnas 'gyur ba sogs kyang shes par bya'o/ de ltar 159

mkhan chen zhi 'tsho'i lugs kyi phyi rol spyod pa ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas zhing dgag sgrub kyi bslab bya rnams la mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces spras su bya ba ma gtogs/ gzhan du kha cig so thar gyi sngom pa 'di khe chung la nyen che snyam du bsams nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa tsam yang mnod par mi byed pa dang / la la dag gzhan ngor srung sngom ltar snang gis mi tshe 'phul ba las don la spro ba med par bslab bya rnams la ji mi snyam par khyad du gsod pa sogs ni mi rung ste/ ston pa bla na med pa la ma gus pa'i phyir dang / bsnan pa'i sgor zhugs pa thams cad spyod pa 'dul ba kho na dang mthun par ma bslab pas/ nyes pa mang du bskyed cing sdom pa gong ma la mtho bsnyabs byed kyang rten med par mi skye'o/ 'o na sngags snom dbang bskur gyis thob pa'i tshe rigs lnga'i sngom bzung lan gsum bzlas par dgos pa med dam zhe na / sdom bzung lan gsum bzlas pas sngags sngom btags pa ba las mi 'byung na 'og ma smos ci dgos/ gal te mtshan nyid pa thob na byang sems kyi sdom pa srol gnyis gang rung la brten nas nod par yang so thar gyi snom pa thob par 'dod dgos pas ha cang thal lo/ des na/ dge slong byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /zhes 'don pa'ang sngom pa gsum mtshan nyid pa gang zag gcig la ldan pas gnas 'gyur ngo bo gcig ces bzhag pa las btags pa ba la gnas 'gyur yod pa ma yin no/160

de med pas dam chig kyang ma tshang bar 'gyur ba sogs dpyod ldan rnam sa kyis shes para'agyuraro/ ci sne bslab pa ma phul bslab pa nyams par ma byas kyang kha na ma tho ba la nyes dmigs mi blta bar gnas shing / ltung ba gang yang phyir bcos la brtson par mi byed pa ni de bas kyang nyes pa lci bar gsungs te/ jo bo rjes༈ de bas na tshangs par spyod pa ma yin par tshangs par spyod pa lta bur ston patsā dge sbyong gi rtags dang mtshan mas nga rgyal byed pa༈ byang chub sems dpa' khyem na gnas pa chos dang mthun par sgrub pa rnams la bdag ni rab tu byung ba'o snyam du brnyas par byed pa/ tshul 'chos pa chom rkun ltabu ste/ mdo las/ chom rkun za'o/ chom rkun 'thung ngo / zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ de lta bu'i sdig pa can gyi dge slong dang dge tshul gyis lha dang mi'i mchod rten du gyur pa'i ngur sprig gi gos gzung bar mi bya ste/ chos gos 'bar ba dang lhung gzed 'bar ba zhes bshad do/ ji skad du/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong gis ston pa'i bos ngur sprig kka rgyal mtshan se gol gtogs pa tsam du yang bcang bar mi bya'o zhes drangs te gsungs so/ yon tan kun gyi rten du gyur pa so thar ris bdun gang rung gi sngom pa la skyon med par bslab pa ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi mchod sdong ltabu bsnyen bkur ba'i gnas su gyur la/ khyad par dge sgrong gi sngom ldan ni thams cad bas 161

mchog tu gsungs te/ de nyid las/ so sor thar pa ris bdun du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa la/ /tshangs spyod dpal ni mchog yin te/ /dge slong sdom pa dag tu bzhed/ ces so/ 'grel par dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par das pa ni theg pa chen po'i gzhi phul tu byung zhing khyad par 'phags pa yin no zhes bcom ldan 'das de ltar bzhed do/ zhes dang / dge slong ni bzhi ste/ ming si dge slong dang / khas 'ches pa'i dge slong dang / blong bas na dge slong dang /nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i dge slong ngo / deng sang gi dus na tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dge sgrong ni dkon te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ bstan rtsadage slong nyid yin na/ /dge slong nyid kyang dka' bar gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong bslab pa la rma byung ba/ nyams par sla ba nag nog can du gyur pa dang zhig pa dang ma tshang bar gyur pa'i dge slong bas ni dge bsnyen rnam par dag pa theg pa chen po'i snod du bsngags so zhes bla ma dag ched cher gsungs so zhes 'byung ngo / zhar la rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims srung ba'i phan yan mdo tsam re bsnan par bya ste/ mardongs blun las/ gang zhig rab tu byung ba de'i bsod nams ni shin tu mang ste/ bdag gi bu'am bu mo'am bran khol gang yang rung ba rab tu byung bar gnang ngam bdag nyid rab tu byung na de'i bsod nams dpag tu med do/ sbyin pa'i bsod nams ni zad mtha' yod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab 162

tu byung ba'i bsod nams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du bsod nams zad mi shes so/ zhes gsungs so/ de'ang sngar bstan pa grwa ma nyams pa'i dus su bslab gzhi yongs rdzogs lo du mar bsrungs pas sems rnam par grol ba las/ bsnan pa nub la nye ba'i dus bslab pa sna re tsam la dmigs te gnyen po cung zad re rgyud la brten na phan yon che bar gsungs pa ni/ stang nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /dad pa'i sems kyis zas dang slom rnams dang / /gdugs dang ba dan mar me phreng ba yis//sangs rgyas bye ba phrag khrig rim gro byas/ /gang zhig dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa/ /de sna de bas bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs so/ kha cig dge slong gi bslab pa bsrung mi nus snyam pas sgyid lug cing bslab pa 'bul ba la brtson na'ang / phyin chad de'i rgyud la pham pas mi gos pa tsam gyi dgos pa yod kyang / gnyen po brten nus su byung na mi mthun phyogs ngo shes par byas nas mi 'bul ba gal che ste/ mdo dri ma med pa las/ sngom pa lan gcig phul na skye ba lnga brgyar mi lus su brgyud nas sdom pa blangs kyang lan de sted du 'bul dgos par gsungs so/ mdor na ston pa'i bsnyan pa la zhugs nas bar chad dang grogs ngan pa'i gzhan dbang du song ba'i tshul khrims 'chal ba dag kyang 163

rgyal ba nyid kyi smon lam tshad med pa'i stobs kyis bskal ba bzang po'i 'di'i nang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas gang yang rung ba'i gdul byar gyur nas grol ba 'thob par gsungs pas na mi phyed pa'i dad pa brten par bya ste/ mdo las/ phyi ma'i dus dam pa'i chos zad par 'gyur ba na gang dag nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas bu'i lag nas bzung ste chang skyog gang gi phyir chang ma'i khyem du 'khyam la/ nga'i chos kyi rjes su slob pa de dag thams cad kyang bskal pa bzang po'adi la mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ zhes bya ba gsungs so/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'ang srol rnam pa gnyis kyi bslab bya las gsal ba bzhin bsrung bar bya'o/ ci ste byang sems kyi bslab pa khyad du bsad nas gsang sngags kyi sngom ldan du rlom na rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung tshad med 'byung bas na las dang po pa dang rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi theg chen spyi'i bslab pa ji snyed pa'ang rgyud tshod bzhin nyams su bsnar bar rigs so/ de yi tshul mdo tsam ni byang chub lam gyi sgron ma las/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gsum ni sngom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims so/ de la sngom pa'i tshul khrims ni bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bsrung ba'i so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi sngom pa dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba mi dge ba bcu bsrung ba'o/ de la dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims ni sngom pa 164

yang dag par blangs pa'i 'og tu gang cung zad lus dang ngag dang yid kyis byang chub kyi phyir dge ba bsags pa ste/ de yang khyad par du thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa rnams la gcig tu dga' bas mngon par sbyar ba'o/ zhes dang / dge ba la brtson 'grus byed pa dang / bag med pa spangs pa dang / dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams bsrung ba dang / dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa dang / zas kyi tshod rig pa dang / nam gyi cha stod smad la mi nyal bar rjes su brtson pa dang / skyes bu dam pa la brten pa dang / nyes pa dag shes shing mthong nas spong ba dang / nyes pa chos bzhin du 'chags pa dang / de lta bu'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i chos rnams bsrung ba dang spel ba ste/ de ltar na dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims la gnas na dge ba'i chos kyi tshul shin tu bsdus par 'gyur te/ 'di 'dod pa'i longs spyod la lta ba cung zad tsam yang dang du len par mi byed na mang po lta ci spros/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi ste/ byang chub kyi sems bcu'i bdag nyid yin no/sems can don byed pa'i tshul khrims ni/ 'di la sems can gyi don bya ba yin te/nad pa la 81gas pa sdug bsngal can rnams la nad g.yag la 31gas pa'i —1gas byed pa yin no/ long ba dag gi long khrid dang / 'on pa dag la lag brdas ston pa dang / rkang lag med pa dag khur ba dang / 'dod pa'i 'dun pa can dag gi de 165

sel ba dang / gzhan gyi sma phab cing pham pa rnams de dag gi sdug bsngal sel ba dang / lam gyis ngal ba dag la bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / gos dang /khang pa dag gis phan 'dogs so/ gso ba rig pas nad pa dag la zang zing med pa'i sems kyis mi skyo bar phan 'dogs so/ mdor na sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba dang / de bsal bar sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba thams cad gzhan gyi don du bsngo ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/༈ gnyis pa lta ba phul du byung ba la bslab par bstan pa ni/ sngar theg pa'i rnam gzhag bshad zin pa las logs su ba med kyang mdoran/ gzhi snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs shing / bdag med gnyis kyai tshul khong du chud par byas nas/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems gnyis skyed par byed pa'o/ lam ni chos sum cu rtsabadun dang spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu la slob cing sa bcu sbyong ba'o/ 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa mngon du byas nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa ste/ le lag las/bdag med gnyis rtogs pha rol phyin rdzogs pa'i/ /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sangs rgyas sar 'gro go 'phang thob pa'i lam/ /bden pa gnyis kyis rab tu thob par 'gyur/ zhes sngar drangs pa bzhin no/ de la bden pa gnyis 166

ni/ don dam pa dang / kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni snang srid shā91ra 'das kyi chos sna tshosas su snang ba yin la/ don dam pa 'i bden pa sna chos nyid spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing blos bsam pa 'i yu la las 'das pa ste/spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yu la min/ /blo sna kun rdzob yi na par 'dod/ /ces so // de'ang dbu ma rang rgyud pa ni chos tham sa cad kun jio ba tu snang la/ de yang brtags na don dam par rang bzhin med par 'dod de/ dbu ma bden gnyis las/ kun rdzob 'di ltar snang ba 'di/ /ris pas brtags na 'ga' mi rnyed/ /ma rnyed pa nyid don dam ste/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do//zhes so/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba sna dpyad rung ma dpyad rung dus gtan du chos thams cad spros pa nye bar zhi ba khas len tham sa cad dang bral bar 'dod de༈ rtsab shes rab las/ gang gi rten cing 'bre' bar 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /chad pa med pa rtag med pa/ /'ong ba me da pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don main don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tsha' lo / /zhes so/ kun rdzob la dbye na snang 'a don byed mi nus pa chu zla lta bu log pa'i kun rdzob dang / snang la don byed nus pa yang dag kun rdzob nam mkha'i zla ba ltabu ste/ bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus ba'i phyir dang mi nus phyir/ /ya nga dag yang dag ma yin 167

ṅge'i/ /kunardzob kyi ni dbye ba'ang byas༈ /zhes so/ dpyad na yang dag dang log pa gnyis ka yang snang bar mnyam zhing / gzhigs na don la ma grub pas mnam pa'i phyir 'khor 'das snang srid thams cad da lta nyid nas rnam dbye med par mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa ste/ mdo las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha'i khams la 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa bajiod cing / 'ga' zhig gis bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod na gang ba'am bri ba med do/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid don dam pa gcig pu zhi ba'i rang bzhin brjod cing / gzhan mu stegs byed kun tu rgyu rnams kyis rtag pa ther zug pa'i chos su bstan yang / yang dag pa'i de ba'in nyid la gnyis su 'gyur ba med do/ zhes bya ba gsungs so/ bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag rgyas par gzhung gzhan la 'jug par bya'o/༈ drug pa ring brgyud bka'i chu bo ma nyams par bzhugs pa la yid 'tshengs pa sa smon pa la/ dang po rgya che ba rtsabar gyur pa rgyud sde dang / zab pa man ngag tu gyur pa sgrub sde gnyis lasatsā dang po la dngos dang / bsdus don bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zab mo nang rgyud sde gsum dgongs pa'i bcud//thun min man ngag gsang ba'i lam mchog nas/ /'ji' lus chos skur gshegs pa'i ngo mtshar 'bar/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba 168

gsungasate/ gsang sngags phyi rgyud rnams las khyad du 'phags pa'i lam zab mo brgyudapa la sel med cing man ngag gnad du phebs pa dang dam tshig rnam par dag pasasangs rgyas gzhan las mi 'tshol zhing tshe gcig gis grol bar byed pa nang rgyudasde gsum ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me lang las/ bskyed pa ma hā ya ga ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi ltabu'o/ rdzogs pa la nu ya ga ni chos thams cad kyi lagaltabu'o/ rdzogs chen a sta ya ga ni chos thams cad kyi 'bras bu ltabu'o/zhes pa ltar de kho na nyid lta ba/ la dor ba spyod pa/ bkod pa dkyil 'khor/rim pa bgrod pa dbang / mi 'da' ba dam tshig don du gnyer ba sgrub pa/ rol pa phrin las/ mi g.ya ba stang nge 'dzin/ gnas su stob pa mchod pa/ 'ching zlos sngags dang phyag rgya ste rgyud kyi dngos po bcu rgyas par snon pas na gzhi ltabu dang / mchog gi dngos grub la spyor ba'i nye rgyu rtsarlung thig le'i byed bcings la brten nas rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs rdzogs rim rgyas par ston pas na lam ltabu dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi spros pa rtsol bcas kyi thabs la ltos pa med par rig snong sems kyi gnas lugs kho nas gzhi thog tu grol bar byed pas na 'bras bu ltabur gsungs so/ de ltar man ngag a sta yo ga ni theg pa thams cad kyi skyel so/ lam thams cad kyi snying po/ phyogs bcu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i bcud ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid de/ jio gas chen brgyud 169

pa'i bla ma bar ma chad pa las byung ba'i thun min man ngag gi ngo sprod thes mchos rin po che'i mardood sogs las gsal ba lta ra/ gsang chen bas kyang ches gsang ba'i lam la brten nas/ skra dang sen mo tsam lhag mar bzhag pa las lus rdul phran du dengs pa'am/ lus ma spangs par 'og min mkha' spyod du bzhegs pa'am/lus de nyid kyis 'khor ba ma snongs par gnas pa 'ardo' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes pa sogs mthar thug gi grub mthar snyegs pas kun tu bzang po dbye ba med pa'i sa non pa'am chos sku 'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong du gshegs pa ni da lta'i bar rnam thar gcod pa dang ma bkod pa'ang mang du byung ste/ me dpung dang rig 'dzin gyi 'chi lugs/ nam mkha' dang mkha' 'gro'i 'chi lugs zhes gsungs pa'i 'bras rtags ngo mtshar ba'i tshul log sred can gyi spyod yul du rmi gyur pa ste/tshig la rton cing zhen pa dang blo gros dang skal pa mi ldan pa das gis ji tsam dbya da kyang rang rgyud chud gzan pa dang / los lta'i stobs kyis rnam smin ya nga ba dag la bskal ba mang po ra spyod dgos par gsungs zhing / chos dang gang zag gang la'ang ma brtags par skur pa 'debs pa spong ste/ brgyad stong par/ rab 'byor chos kyis phongs par 'gyur ba'i las bsags pa de ni ngan 'gro ngan song log par ltung ba rnams su skye zhing / mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por sdug bsnga' lo/ der yang mes sdud pa'i bskal pa byung ba de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams ga'an 1spya0

gyi dmyal ba chen po rnams su skye zhing / der yang mes sdud pa'i bskal ba byung ba nayang / gzhan gyi zhes sogs dpa ga tu med pa gsungs shing / rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul gyi mdo las/ bskal pa dag ni du mar yang / ༈lus ni dpag tshad lnga brgyar 'gyur / /de la mgo yang lnga brgya ste/ /mgo rnams re re dag la yang / /lnga brgya'i lce las nyung mi 'gyur/ /lce gcig la yang thong bshol dag /lnga brgyar tshad ni mi nyung bar/ /rab tu 'bar bas rmo byed de/ /skur 'debs sdig pa'i las kyis so/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ de ltar gsang sngags bla med kyi tshul rnams re zhig snod dang mi ldan pa dag ni ma khas su zin kyang ji lta ba bzhin rtogs par mi 'gyur zhing sems dang 'du shes dang lta baphyin ci log tu gnas nas 'arnga' lus med gdung dang ring bsrel med ces skura'adebs kyi las sna tshogs la sems pa ni grub mtha'i 'og ma'i rdul phran phra rags 'gog pa'i rigs pa tsam yang ma nges pa ste/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las/rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gog pa'i dus su bdag nyid ni/ /shes bya'i rang bzhin phog par lta bar rtogs bya ste/ /de yi lta ba'i rnam pa'i rten mtshungs 'u sa dang ldan nyid phyir/ /gang tshe 'byung ba yod nyid khas len de tshe bzhin/ /zhes rgyang 'phen pa la gsungs pa bzhin no/ ༈ gnyis pa bsdus don bshad pa ni/ ji skad du/ don dam nges pa'i theg pa ni/ /gsum du nges par snang ba ste/ /kun 'byung 171

'dren dang dka' thub rig /dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar theg pa'i dbye gzhi gsum la sa/ 'dir dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa ni nyon mongs mi spong bar thabs kyis lam du byed pa yin no/ de la dbye na bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum las/ dang po sku'i rgyud bskyed pa mahāyo ga ni ranatre chen po bco brgyad kyi dgongs pa bzhin gnyis med kyi don la blo 'byor ba'i phyir rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya'o/ de yang gsang ba sgru 'phrul ba'i lugs la/ gang rtogs pa ra bya ba gzhi'am rgyu'i rgyud/ gang gis rtogs shing bgrod pa thabs sam lam gyi rgyud/gang du mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum gyis chings su bcings te/gnas lugs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi la 'khrul pa btags pa'i gzhi yi snang tshul rnams ma grub par tshad ma bka' gzhung gi gtan tshigs/ sgra mthun don spasas kyi gtan tshigs/ chig don mi mthun pa'i gtan tshigs rnams sam kun khyab tshad ma gsum gyis gtan la phab ste rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyed lta ba nges pa sngon du 'gro bas/ lam rgyud kyi thabs sam rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid stang nge 'dzin thabs grol gyi lam rnams bsgom zhing rgyud kyi dngos po bcu la slob par byed/ 'bras rgyud la gnas skabs lam 'gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi dang mthar zug kun tu 'od dang ma chags pad ma can dang 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa thob pa ste gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don mtha' dag 'di yi nang du 'dus so/ ji skad du/ shes 1spyalha

'jug mtshan nyid 'byor ba'i gzungs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mazucan du gang gyurapa/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ de dag ston pa'i sde stod la/ rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las/ rgyud sde la/ zur lugs pa phal cher/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad dang / bshad rgyud sde bzhir dbye bar mdzad de/ de la sde brgyad ni/ sems dang ye thes rang snang du ston pa rtsaba'i rgyud gsang ba snying po/ rol pa mngon pa ra bajiod pa lha mo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ston pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad mi / phrin las rdzogs par ston pa bzhi bcu pa/ dbang gtso bor snon pa bla ma/ yon tan mthariri phyin par ston pa brgyad cu pa / sde snod yangs la khyab par ston pa 'ardzam dpa la sgyu drwa/ dam chig mchog tu snon pa le lag dang brgyad do/ bshad rgyud sde bzhi sna/grol lam rim cig car du ston pa ye shes snying po dang / rdo rje me long thabs lam rim cis car du ston pa rgya mtsho dang thal rgyud do/ kun mkhyen chen po ni/sgyu 'phrul sde bzhir bzhed de/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang snang dbyer med du ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ las tshogs rgyas par snon pa rnam par snang mardod sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ rol pa mngon du ston pa lha mo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/zeg pa kun la khyab par ston pa 'jam dpa la sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'o/ rdor sems sgyu drwa la'ang nang gses kyis dbyen/ rtsargyud snying po dang / bzhad rgyud sde brgyad du 173

bzhed de/ sems dang ye shes rang snang bar ston pa dpazhwa gsang ba'i snying po dang / phrin las rdzogs par ston pa bzhi bcu pa dang / dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ra snon pa brgyad pa dang / dbang bskur ba gsal bar ston pa bla ma dang / dam chis mchog tu ston pa le lag dang / yan tan rgyas par ston pa brgyad cu pa dang / lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal bar ston pa rdo rje me long dang / bskyed rim gsal bar snon pa rgya masnardo dang / thabs lam gsal bar snon pa thal ba dang sde brgyad do/ bzhan yang rdo rje sasang ba'i snying po dang / sgyu 'phrul snying po bkod pa༈khro bo snobs kyi rgyud sogs phran tshegs mang du bzhugs shing / spyir rdoo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la rgya gar na le'u 'bum phrag sacig bzhugs par grasas so /gnyis pa sgrub sde ni 'jatsha dpal sku/ pad mtshogasung ༈ yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsiyon tan/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong / 'jig rten mchod bstod dmod pa drag sngags sogs sgrub sde spyi bye brag rnams dang / gzhan yang sasang ba 'dus pa/ bzhin rje gshed/ zla gsang thig le/ bde mchog dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyang sdud par gsungs so/ gnyis pa gsung rgyud a nu yo sa'am rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ don bsdus las/ kun bzang thugs rjes 'gro don du/ tsātheg pa gsum snang 'dul mardod pa'i/ /don dam nges pa'i theg pa las/ /gsang smo mtshon pa'i mdo rgyud don/ /rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste/ /bya ba rgyu dang byed pa 1spya4
