rkyen/ /bya bral 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor das /ji sted chos kyi rtsabar bshad//ces pa ltar/ gzhal bya 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams 'jal byed mtha' drug tshul bzhi la brten nas/ bya ba rgyu'i rna' 'byor snang srid thams cad skye ba med pa yum kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa ye ji bzhin pa 'i dkyil 'khor dang /rtsal snang 'gag med kun khyab tu thar ba rang byung kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor dang / dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa sras bde ba chen po rtsab byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khar du gtan la phab nas༈ byed pa rkyen gyi rnal 'byor thabs kyi nges pa'i lam rim cig char gyis lhan skyes ye shes 'dren pa dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba'i lam ni/ thos bas ma rtog dpyod kyi rjes su 'jug pas gnas lugs kyi lta ba nges pa sngon du btang nas༈ sgom thabs yi ge'i rjes su 'jug pa mtshan bcas lha'i rnal 'byor bskyed sngags bajiod pa tsam gyis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khesar ma 'dres yangs rdzogs bkra lam gyis gsal ba'o/ don gyi rjes su 'jug pa de bzhin nyid dam mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa'i rdzogs rim la gzhol ba ste/ de nyid las/ thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshul 'gro ba'i//de ni 'jug pa rnam gsum ste/ /rtog dpyod don dang yi ge nyid/ /ces so/ bya bral 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor ni/ tshogs lam du mos spyod kyi lha sku shar ba 'dun pa sems pa'i rnal 'byor/ sbyor lam du rlung sems kyi lha sku 'grub pas risas chen 175

'byed pa'i rnal 'byor/ mthong lam du bde stong 'od gsal gyi lha sku 'grub pa dbugs chen 'byin pa'i rnal 'byor/ sgom lam du blob pa zung 'jug bee lha sku rgyun mi 'chad par 'grub pas lung chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mthar lam rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi bar chad med lam la 'dod chags chen po'i dbang bskur brnyes pas sgo gsum gyi bag chags phra ba'ang gtan bcom ste mi slob zung 'jug gi lha sku 'bras chos nyer lnga'i yon tan la dbang 'byor zhing rtag khyab lhun grub kyi phrin las la 'jug par gsungs so/ de ltar ston pa'i sde snod ni/ kun btus rig pa sogs rtsaba'i mdo bzhi/ mtha' drug gsal bar byed pa'i rgyud drug dkon rgyud bcu gahais/ lung gi yi ge bdun cu la sosas pa'o/gsum pa thugs kyi rgyud a ti yo ga ste shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ gtan chisas ngo sprod rin po che rnams la brten nas don dam ka dag blo 'das chen po dang / kun rdzob gzhi snang lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab nas ka dag gi gnas lugs zab mo khregs chod kyi man ngag nam mkha' sum 'phrugs sam cog bzhag bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs shing / lhun grub thod brgal gyi rim pa rnams bca' ba lus kyi gnad gsum/ 'khrid pa dbyings kyi gnad gsum/ snang ba yul gyi gnad gsum du bsdus te/ sgron ma bzhi'i tshul la brten nas dbyings kyi snang ba dang / rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud smin pa las snang bzhi tshad du 'khyol te 176

bum nang gi mar me ltar gnas pa sazhir gnas kyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas nang dbyings ga'on nu bum pa 'i skur sangs rgyas shing 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ngo / spyir rtsol med ye shes kyi theg pa 'di la a sta bkod pa chen po las bstan pa ltar/ yid can rnams lī sems kyi sde/ /nam mkha' can la hlong si sde/ /rim rtsol bral la man ngag go/ /zhes pa ltar/ slob dpon 'ardzam dpa la bzhes gnyen gyis sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum du phye ba 'a sa/ chos thams cad sems nyid las gud na med pa spang bya'i mtha' las grozhwa ba sems sde/ chos can thams cad chos nyid kun tu bzang mo'i klong du 'ub chub pas gnyen po'i mtha' las grol ba klong sde/ don rang gi mtshan nyid yi na lugs ltar gtan la 'bebs pas spang gnyen gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol ba man ngag gi sde zhes gsungs/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag mtha' yas pa bzhugs kyang 'dir smras pa rnams ni man ngag gi lugs ltar byas pa'o/ de ltar snon pa'i sde snod kyang sems sde la rjod byed kyi rgyud sho lo ka 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsaganyis yod par gsungs shing bsdu na/chos nyid brjod du med pa'i klong dang / lta ba min pa med pa'i klong dang / spyod pa yin pa med pa'i klong gsum po la bam po drug stong sum brgyar gnas par gsungs pa'ang bsdu na/ gnas pa gzhi thog phebs pa'i 'phyong / snang ba rang sar hrol ba'i 'phyong / ngo mnyam tha dad med pa'i 'phyong gsum du 'du la/ chos nyid 177

la 'chugs pa med pa'i gzer bu lnga bcu/ yul sems la lta ba'i gnas lnga brgya bcu gcis snang sems cig char du shan 'byed pa khri phrag sa/nyis / lta ba thod brgal du la zla ba lnga khri/ sgom sku1da rtog pa gcod pa'i gnas chig stong rnams rgyud sde chen po stong phrag gsum du bzhugs par gsungs so / klong sde la bsdu na dgur 'du bar gsungs te/ lta ba 'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong tsā bsgom pa yi na min med pa'i klong / 'bras bu re dwogs med pa 'i klong / ngo bo grub bsal med pa'i klong / rang bzhin ma 'gag pa'i klong / mtshan nyid snang sems grol ba'i klong / dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa 'i klong / rol pa 'gag me da rang shar gyi klong /lhun mnyam ye grol cog bzhag gi klong dang dgu'o/ de dag kyang bsdu na/ lhurna grub yangs pa chen po'i klong / rang gsal bya rtsol med pa'i klong / ma byas ye nas grub pa 'i klong dang gsum du 'dus shing / de dag gi tshul rgyas par ston pa'i rgyud stong phras gsum la le'u chig khri chig stong / sho lo ka 'bum phrag drug cu rtsabazhi༈ lī bzla ba khri phras brgyad/ than 'byed khri phrag gnyis/ 'gags dgu brgya༈gnad nyis snong / gzer bu lnga bcu rnams su 'du bar gsungs pa dag go ma na ngag si sde la'ang zab la rgya che ba'i rgyud sde mtha' yas kyang bsdu na/ slo ba dpon shri seng ha'i dgongs pa ltar/ lus dang 'dra ba phyi slor/ maig dang 'dra ba nang skor/snying dang 'dra ba gas nga slor/ thams cad rdzogs pa dang 'dra ba yang gsang bla na 178

med pa'i skor dang bzhi ru 'du zhing / de lta ra ston pa 'i rgyud kyang tshis rgyud khri phrag gnyis/ le 'u stong phrab sum cu rtsa lnga sho la ka 'bum phras drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gnad stong phrag lnga/ 'phyong chen po brgyad/ gzer bu brgya dang brgyad cu/ 'gags stong phrag dgu brgya/ shan 'byed khri phrag bdun/ la bzla ba 'bum phrag phyed dang gnyis sogs tshad gzung du med par gsungs so/ rgyas par gzigs 'dod pa dab gis/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i 'grel pa rnams dang / dgongs 'dus rnam bshad 'od zer brgya pa/ snying thig ma bu'i lo rgyus stong thun chen mo / snga 'gyur bsnan pa'i rnam bzhag rin po che sogs la sa mkhyen par 'gyur ro/༈ gnis pa sgrub sde chu bo gcig 'dres kyi tshul la spon pa la/ ma dor bsnan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnis la sa/ dang po sna/ rab 'byams zhi khro'i khyab bdag sgrub sde brgyad/ /bka' bab rig 'dzin so so'i dgongs bcud dang / /kun 'dus pad ma 'i bka' srol sacis tu 'khrul / /ma tsho skyes rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rgyas gyur cis /ces gsungs te/ rab 'byams zhing gi rdul sted du bzhugs pa'i longs spyod jio gas pa'i sku zhi ba lhun gyis grub mi dang khro bo'i mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun gyi mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'am nges don sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i yon tan ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid sgrub sde bka' gter gyi lha tshosas khyab bdag sprul sku'i rnam par shar ba tshom bu lnga dang brgyad du 179

bzhugs pa dag rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon lnga'am brgyad la bka' babs/ rirma par bka' gter gyi brgyud srol ma lus pa ni slob dpon chen po pad ma la 'dus shing bod du bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du rje 'bangs skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur zhing rgyud dang man ngag bstan par mdzod de rgya cher dar/ phyi rabs kyi don du yi ger bkod de zab gter bka' rgyas btab pa rnams phyis mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can dang / gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem gru can rnams kyis gter nas bzhes te 'gro don phyogs med du rgyas pa ste/ de lta bu'i sgrub sde bka' gter gyi brgyud srol ma nyams par gnas pa mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig ces pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/de yang nang rgyud sde gsum las dpal ma hā ya ga la/ rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gahais su bzhugs pa las/ rgyud sde la slob dpon ku ku rā dza'i dgongs pa ltar tan tre chen po bco brgyad ces grags pa rnams te/ de yi ngos 'dzin la zur lugs pa rnams ni/ sku rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ yon tan gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po/phrin las kyi rgyud karma mā le dang lnga ni rtsaba'i rgyud sde'o/ he ru ka rol ba'i rgyud /rta mchog rol ba'i rgyud / snying rje rol ba'i rgyud / bdud rtsirol ba'i rgyud/180

rdzurapabacu gnyis pa 'byung ba'i rgyud rnams ni sgrub pa lag len du ston pa rol ba'i rgyudasdelnga'o/ ri bo brtsegs pa/ ye shes rngam glog dam tshig bkod pa/ stang 'dzin tsegacig glang chen rab 'bog gi rgyud rnams ni spyod pa lag len du snon pa'i rgyud sde lnga'o/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang thabs kyi zhags pa pad mo phreng ba'i rgyud gnyis ni ma tshang ba kha skong ba phyi ma'i rgyud do/ dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i rgyud ni thams cad kyi bsdus don du gyur pa'o/ yang na kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi bzhed par/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga la gsum rer phyes pa'i bco lnga dang / sku gsung thugs kyi spyi rgyud gsum sde bco brgyad du 'jog go de la dang po bco lnga ni/ sku'i sku rgyud glang po rab 'bos sku'i gsung rgyud glang po chur 'jug sku'i thugs rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi sku rgyud ri bo brtsegs pa/ gsung gi gsung rgyud pad ma dbang chen/ gsung gi thugs rgyud zla gsang thig le/ thugs kyi sku rgyud rtse mo 'dus pa/ thugs kyi gsung rgyud gcig las 'phros pa/ thugs kyi thugs rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/yon tan gyi sku rgyud sgron me 'bar ba/ yon tan gyi gsung rgyud bdud rdzis ma ya 'bum sde/ yon tan gyi thugs rgyud dpal mchog dang po/ phrin las kyi sku rgyud dpal phreng dkar po/ phrin las kyi gsung rgyud ma mo rgyud lung / phrin las kyi gas rgyud phur pa bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'o/ gnyis pa spyi rgyud gsum ni/ spyi'i sgyu 181

sku rgyud thabs kyi zhags pa/ spyi'i gsung rgyud sa ma ya bkod pa/ spyi'i thubs rgyud gsang ba sgru 'phrul dang bco brgyad du bzhed do/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde rnams ni/skal ldan rgyal po dza nas ku ku rā rdo/ in dra bo lha chung ba/ seng ha rā rdo༈ u pa rā dza/ sras mo go ma de bi/ slob dpon sleg pa'i rdoo rje/ sangs rgyas gsang ba rnams 'a sa slob dpon pad ma la brgyud de byorna pa'o/ ya/nga sgrub sde bka' ma rnams las slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra la thugs mi bskyod pa'i rigs he ru ka gal po sogs yang dag thusas kyi bka' babs/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la sku rnam snang gi rigs 'ardzam dpa la khros pa gas nga rgyud sogs bzhin rje gshed kyi bka' rnams dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la gsung snang mtha'i rigs rta mchog rol pa sogs pad ma gsung gi tan tre rnams dang / slob dpon bi ma mi tre la yon tan rin 'byung gi rigs bdud rtsibam brgyad sogs rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bka' rnams dang / slob dpon pra lha hasnyi la don grub kyi rigs phrin las phur pa'i rgyud rnams kyi bka' babs/ sgrub sde gter ma'i phyogs ni byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos kyis mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo la gtad/ mkha' 'gro mas sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rgyud sde rnams rin po che'i sgrom bur bcug ste dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par rgyas btab ste sbas pa las/phyis dus la babs pa na sgrom bu rnams so sor blangs te/ che mchog bse sgrom bi 182

spul/ yang dag dngul sgrom hūm̐ ka ra/ gzhin rje'i lcags sgrom 'ardom dpal bzhes gnyen/ rta mgrin zangs sgrom na gardzu na/ phur pa'i g.yu sgrom pa da ma 'byung gnas/ ma mo bse sgrom dha na sa skri ta/ mchod bstod mchong sgrom ram bu gu hya/ drag sngags gzi sgrom zhi ba'i snying po rnams la gtad cing dngos grub brnyes/ bde gshegs 'dus pa tshom bu gcig tu 'dus pa 'i rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' rnams phyis su slob dpon pad ma la babs shing rim par bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams la brgyud pa'o/ de yang 'jim dpal sku'i rgyud rnams 'khor lo bzhi dang /pad ma gsung gi rgyud rta skad thengs gsum/ yang dag thugs kyi rgyud ru lu 'bru brgyad/ che mchog yan tan rgyud bdud mirnam dag phur pa phrin las kyi rgyud thal 'byin rnam bzhi/ ma mo rbod gtong gi rgyud rtsarlung thig le/ 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi rgyud mchod bsgrub brten gsum/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi rgyud rdzong 'phrang sgog gsum mam 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi dgongs par bsdu la/ bla ma rig 'dzin gyi tshul rnams bsten sgrub rnam bzhi'i dgongs par bsdus so/ mdor na 'jig rten las 'das pa lnga / 'jig rten pa gnyis/ 'das ma 'das kyi so mtshams gcig ste brgyad do/ de ltabu'i tshul rnams shes par 'dod pas dpal sbrulapa chen po bka' brgyad kyi spyi don rnam par bzhad pa dngos grub snying po dang //da 'bum rin po che'i dkar chag rnam gnyis/ chos 'byung lha dbang g.yul 183

las rgyal ba'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs/ snga 'gyur bsnan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gyi 'grel pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan sogs las shes par bya'o/༈ da ni bdun pa phyi dar zab mo gter gyi chos tshul rnams la smon pa ni/rgyu dang 'bras bu gsang sngags theg pa che/ /tshang la ma nor rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lung / /ḍā ki'i zhal gyi drod rlangs tho le ba/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ de yang gzhi mi spong bar rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa ni theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi khyad chos te/ rgyas par skyed lung bla ma yang khyed kyi ral sgra'i stong thun/ chu 'bar gyi glan shākya bzang po'i sbrul nag gi snong thun/ mda' stag chos shāka pa'i dug shing gi snong thun rnams las bsal lo/'di ltar rig 'dzin sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs shing gsang ba gsum gyi dgongs spyod rgya mtsho ltabu la slob pa ra 'dod pa rnams kyi ngor zab cing rgya che ba'i rgyud sde mang du bzhugs kyang / snyigs dus tshe thung gcig gi yun la gzhal dka' zhing 'tshengs pa'i dus mi rnyed pas na/ chos tshul spyi dang khyad par bla med rgyud sde rnams kyi dgongs don gzhi lam 'bras bu gnad mtha' dag tshang la ma nor bar bde blag tu rtogs pa'i thabs su gyur pa ni ring rgyud bka'i chu bo ma nyams par gnas pa la/ rgyud dkrugs pa bsdebs/ lung bcus pa bsrangs/ man ngag gab pa mngon du phyung ste rdo rje'i tshig gis bkrol zhing rgyas btab pa'i zab chos 184

gter du bzhugs pa rnams te/ gzhan du bka' mas khog phub/ sater mas zur brgyan zhes bshad pa dang don gcig go de ltar o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'ibadag rkyen las rim par gter ston rig 'dzin brgyud pa zam ma chad par byon te bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyis mtshon gter chos ji snyed spyan drangs parnams ni nye brgyud sel med cing / rtsagasum lha tshogs rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi dbal dang / ṭwāka ki chos srung rgya mcho'i kha rlangs ma yal ba/ lam pa'i gang zag dad brtson shes rab dang ldan pa rnams kyis rgyud sgrub thabs dang 'brel/ sgrub thabs phrin las dang 'brel/ phrin las phyag bzhes dang 'brel/ phyag bzhes man ngag dang 'brel bas gtan la phab cing / rim pa dbang gis bgrod/ gzhi dam tshig gis bzung / thag lta bas bcad/ la spyod pas dor/ nyams su stang nge 'dzin gyis blangs/ don man ngag gis grub pa sogs gsang sngags bslab pa'i mtha' bcu'am drug gis nyams su blangs pas/ tshe gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed nus pa'i zab chos bla na merda pa ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam mi khyab pa las byung bas na/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs nye brgyud gter ma'i bka' srol lam bstan pa 'di nyid da mar rnam 'dren lnga pa ma byon pa'i bar de srid du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces pa'o/185

༈ brgyad pa bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi che ba'i yon tan las brtsams te smon pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs ngon bdud rdzibacud//mkhas grub bye ba'i zhal nas snyan du brgyud/ /rtog ge ngan pa'i rang bzos ma bslad pa/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ de la tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis ni rtsaba'i brgyud pa gsum bstan pa yin la/ de yang bshad rgyud rgya mtsho las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /datre ngas pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /ces pa ltar/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa dang gsum mo/ de yi tshul la spyi dang bye brag gi ngos 'dzin lugs gnyis las/ dang po ma hā dang a nu'i lugs ltar na/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po mtshan rdzogs rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bzhengs pas zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs par sprul pa'i sgo nas lhan cig pa'i 'khor rnams la chos sku skye med don gyi gsung / longs sku dgongs pa brda yi gsung / sprul sku brjod pa tshig gi gsung / mngon byang rig pa byin rlabs kyi gsung dang mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gsung gis brda sprod pa'o/ gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda brgyud la/ rig 'dzin mi ma yin pa dang /mi dang mi ma yin pa gnyis ka las brgyud pa'o/ dang po ni lhan cig pa'i 'khor gyi nang nas rigs gsum sems dpa' rnams kyi lha klu gnod sbyin rnams la gsang 186

sngags kyi chos bsnan pa yin la/ de ya nga 'phasas pa 'jam dpa la sa'on tshul mdzosapa'i skur bstan pas lha yi gnas su lha grags ldan mchob skyong la bshad de lha'irig 'dzin rnams la dar bar byas/ spyan ras gzisas bdud rtsi sman gyi skur bzhengs nas klu'i gnas su klu rgyal mgrin pa nag po la bshad de dar bar byas ༈phyag na rdo rje 'jigs tshul bsdigs pa 'i skur bstan nas gnod sbyin gyi sanas su gnod sbyon kun tu bzang po la bshad de dar bar byas pa'o༈ sanyis pa ni / sto na pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsabargyad na lha grags ldan mchog skyong ༈ sanod sbyin skar mda' gdong / srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ klu rgyal 'jog po / mi yi/ rig 'dzin li cwa bi dri med grags pa rnams nang du yang dag 'jog las la ngas te ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse mor 'dus pa la dpa la phyag na dzwo rjes sngar ston pas 'og min du gsungs pa'i rgyud sde rnams slar yang bzlas te bstan par mdzad/ de'i tshe srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis gser gyi gligs bam la beeḍūrya'i zhun mas yi ger bris te mi snang bar rgyas btab par byas so / sasu ma pa sang zag snyan brgyud ni/ gang gi tshe ma la yar phyag na rdo rjes chos bstan pa de'i tshe/sa hor ra'i rgyal po rdo la rmi ltas ngo mtshar can bdun byung ba dang mthun par rgyud sde'i glegs bam rnams mi yul du dngos su babs te/ kri yi rgyud rnams wa ra ddha / u pa ya'i rgyud rnams ri bo bya rkang can dang bsil ba'i tsha' / ya sa'i rgyud 187

rnams dur khrod me ri 'bar bar/ mahā yo ga'i tanatre rnams rgyal po dza'i khang steng / a nu yo ga'i rgyud rnams sing ga la'i gling gi nags tshal du babs par grags so/ de ltar ma hā yo ga'i rgyud rnams ni/ skal ldan rgyal po dzwa nas ku ku rā rdo/ in dra bo lha/ seng ha rā dzwa/ u pa rā rdo/ sras mo go ma de wi / slob dpon sgeb pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas gsang ba rnams las slob dpon bi ma la dang slob dpon pad ma la brgyud de rim par byon pa'o/ a nu ya ga'i rgyud rnams kyang dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos rgyal po rdo'am lung bstan rdo rje la dbang bskur zhing bstan pa thams cad kyi don thugs su chud/ tshur mthong gi ngor dge bsnyen li tsā bi dri med grags pa la brten nas tshig rgyud rnams mthar phyin par mdzwad/ de nas rim par/ u pa rā dzwa/ shas tre pu tri/ nā ga pu tri/ gu hya pu tri/ ro langs de ba/pra wa hasnyi/ rdo rjehūm̐ rma dzwad/ sdethi ra ma sta/ ā tsar ya de ba gsal mdzad/ dharma bo lha/ mkhan po chos rgyal skyong / bal po nor 'dzin/ gtsug lag dpal dbe'abru sha'i slob dpon che btsan skyes/ de las gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsan te rim par byung ba yin no/ gnyis pa thun min rdzogs pa chen po'i brgyud pa la'ang gsum las/ dang po rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang pos ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sogs rang snang lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor rnams la don gyi 'og min du brda tshig blo las 'das pa'i chos bstan pa rnams so/188

gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda brgyud ni/ gang gi tshe rgyal po dza'i khang thob tu rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams dngos su babs pa'i tshe/ a sta yo ga'i rgyud rnams a rgyan dru na ko sha'i gling du babs zhes lo rgyus rnams las byung yang glegs bam dngos su babs pa med cing / rdo rje sems dpa'i slob ma lha'i bu kun dga' snying po mi yu la du byon pa sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje la rdo rje sems dpa' dngos su zhal ma rngal/rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang dang rgyud sde rnams rdzogs par gtad/ ri ma la ya'i rtse mor mkha' 'gro bde ba'i ro ldan ma dang / bde byed ser mo gnyis kyis lo gsum du yi ger bkod de mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba'i phug tu bzhugs so/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje nas/ rim par slob dpon 'jam dpal bzhes gnyen/ rig 'dzin shrī maing ha/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tre/ lo chen bee ro tsan rnams la bka' babs pa dag go sasum pa sang zas snyan brgyud ni bshad ma thag pa slob dpon pad 'byung bi ma bee ro sasum las bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams la brgyud de sems klong man ngag gi bka' babs rim byon gsan yig chen mo rnams las byung ba bzhin no/ tshig rkang gsum pa sa ni nye brgyud gter gyi brgyud pa rnams bstan te/ de la'ang sngar gyi rtsaba'i brgyud pa gsum gyi steng du/ smon lam dbang bskur/ bka' babs lung bstan/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya dang gsum mam/ shog ser tshig brgyud sogs brgyud pa bdun dang 189

dgur dbye ba'i tshul rnams ni yon tan mdzwod kyi 'grel pa zab don snang byed nyi ma'i 'od zer las gsal lo/ de la smon lam dbang bskur ni pad 'byung bi ma bee ro rnams dang / chos rgyal yab sras/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes dang nam snying / gnyags dzā na ku mā ra/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'ardzoms/ nyang ban stang 'dzin bzang po sogs kyis zab gter ji snyed sbas pa rnams bden tshig smon lam gyis rgyas btab par mdzod pa'o/ bka' babs lung bstan ni gter 'byin gyi skyes bu gang la phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang dang phrin las rab 'byams kyi byin rlabs dang lung bstan dbugs 'byung stsal ba'o/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya ni/ gdul bya dus la babs pa'i tshe gangs brag ri mtsho la sogs pa gter gnas rnams las chos nor dam rdzas kyi gter kha mtha' med pa spyan drangs te snyigs dus kyi rgud pa bzlog cing las 'phro ldan pa rnams 'khor ba mtha' can du mardod pa'o/ de ltar zab mo gter gyi chos tshul mtha' dag zog po su 'brid mkhan gyis rang dgar bcos pa ltabu ma yin par lung tshad ma dag las mang du byung ba'i tshul gter ston brgya rtsa'i rnam thar snga phyi rnams su rgyas par bzhugs la/ phyogs tsam smyos na klu'i rgyal pos rgya mtshe'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi chad pa'i gter chen po mi zad pa dang / chos rtogs pa chen po tshad med pa'i gter chen po mi zad pa dang / sems can mgu bar bya ba'i gter chen po mi zad pa dang / nam 190

mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gter chen po mi zad pa ste/ bzhi po de dag ni gter chen po mi zad pa yin no/ zhes dang / 'phags pa bsod nams thams cad sdud pa stang nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ dri ma med pa'i gzi brdzid chos 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi chos kyi gter ri dang / ri sul dang / shing dag gi nang du bcug pa dag yod de/ gzungs dang chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa gligs bam du byas pa dag kyang lag tu 'ongs par 'gyur ro/ zhes dang / chu klung rol pa'i mdo las/ nga yis bsnan pa'i chos kyi gzhung / /thugs nas thugs kyi gter du sbos/ /yang na sa yi snying por bya/ /ci phyir mu stegs can mgo rgod/ /des don dkrug par gyur ta re/ /de phyir chu klung rgyun mi gcod//zhes dang / chos rgyal rata na gling pa'i gter lung las/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnams/ /spyir yang bod rnams gsar ngas che ba dang / /snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par snying brtse bas/ /mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag /las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab/ /ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan/ /sgom chen la sogs phyogs dang ris dregs can/ /rang che 'byin phyir gter la rtsod na yang / /snyigs ma'i chos byed phal cher gter gyis 'dren/ /zab la kha tshang ma bsgribs mtha' rgyas shing / /mdams pa sna res gang zag grol bar nges/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin bod kyi bstan 'dzin skyes bu 191

gzur gnas rnams ni gter chos nyams su bzhes mi bzhes sna tshogs kyang skur pa btab par mi mardod de thams cad mkhyen pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba dang/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho rnams kyi bsung rab las shes par 'gyur bas 'dir spro bar ma byas so/ mdor na bdud 'ardzoms 'gro 'dul gling pa'i gsung las/ khyad par gter du bzhugs pa'i zab chos phal mo che mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ges bcings pa ste/ de ni skal mnyam gyi gang zas las gzhan gyi khrol mi srid pas na/ bla( rgyan chen po'i bka' rtags phyag rgya'i ri mo dngos la thug pas/ gang zag phal pa'i brgyud pas bar du ma chod cing /khungs btsun pa dang / brda ma bcos/ tshig ma 'khrul/ don ma nor bar mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda bsgyur bas zab cing byin rlabs che ba dang / skal ba dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag blo ji ltar sgrin kyang dmus long gis glang chen dpyad pa ltar phyogs tsam yang brtag mi bzod pas gter 'byin gyi skyes bu nyid phal pa'i spyod yul las 'das par yid ches pa yin no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snyigs dus su tshe la long med pas thos pa dang smra ba la dga' ba'i dus ma yin/ dal 'byor lan gcis rnyed pa la mtshan ldan dge ba'i bzhes gnyen gyis zin pa dgos/ de yi gdams ngag bsnan pa bzhin rgyud dang 'dres pa gtso/ gzhan thob dang go sa ming dang grags pa rtsal du bton nas dgon gog re bzung shes pa tsam gyis bstan 192

pa la bya ba byed pa ma yin/ don gyi snying po bla ma'i man ngag la bcol nas blo sna brtsang zhing 'khor ba'i bya bzhag rnams tho yar la mi dang / thag khra la sgrul du 'khrul pa ltar snying po med par shes nas 'chi khar 'gyod ma dgos par lam sna zin pa zhig byung na chos pa rab tu gyur pa yin te mi rtag pa'i tshoms las mtshan stong sgas 'bar bde gshegs snying po'i sku/ /bsod narma sa brgya las grub pa'ang mi rtag na/ /dbu ba rdos 'dra yid brtan mi rung ba'i/ /rang gi lus 'di nges par cis mi 'jig /ces gsungs pa la dran pa ra nye bar bkod de/ da re zab chos 'gran zla med pa dag rnyed pa'i dus su sa rgya mi bskor zhing rang sdug mi nyo bar chos gzha' ma la 'jug cing / skye bo gzhan yang dge ba la bskul ba sogs sgo gsum dam pa'i chos dang mi 'gal bar ci nus pas 'jug pa dang / rnam dkar dge tshogs dag kyang byang chub tu bsngo zhing / a rgyan dus sasum mkhyen pa'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa las byung ba'i gsang sngags zab mo spyi dang / khyad par zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi phrin las kho nas kyang 'gro ba dpag tu med pa 'khor ba dang ngan song gi g.yang sa las skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam mi khyab pa bden pa'i lung las bsu med du grub pas na gling dang mgon dang dpung gnyen phul du phyin pa'i tshul la nges pa rnyed pa'i sgo nas/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzam gling yul gru kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig193

ces pa ste/ jo po rje dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi zhal snga las/ deng sang sems can dus dang nyon mongs dang / /lta ba tshe yi snyigs mar gyur pa ste/ /gzhung rnams mnyan par dgos pa med pas na/ /snying po don gyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /deng sang dus su gzings dang 'dra ba yi/ /gzhung rnams rgya chen mnyan pa'i dus med pas/ /yid 'khrug byed pa thams cad spangs byas la/ /dam pas nyer bstan 'ba' zhig bsgom par bya/ /tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang 'di tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /'dod pa'i dngos po dang du blang bar bya/ /zhes gdams par mdzwad pa bzhin no/༈ dgu pa bka' gter chu bo yongs rdzogs kyi tshul la smon pa ni/gser zhing nor bus spras pa'i yon gyis kyang / /mi 'gugs dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs mdzod chos/ /brtse bas rjes 'jug skal pa kho nar bkram/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gser sbyang btso ma'i zhing sa mtha' dbus med par dpag bsam gyi rdzon pa rab tu mang pos 'khrigs shing lo ma me tog 'bras bu yongs rdzogs bee ḍūrya dang / mar gad dang / in dra ni la dang / nor bu sna tshogs pas phras madzres par spras pa/ ljon rshang de dag gi bar bar du rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ba dag phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 194

dpag tu med pa la nyin re bzhin lan gsum gsum du phul bar byed kyang /'dodayon gyi dngos po de dag gis nam yang khug par mi srid pa/ thub pa'i bltan pa rin po che mdo sngags zung 'jug gi lam ston pa spyi dang / khyad par zab monang rgyud sde gsum gyi chos tshul rnams ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang las brgyud cing rig pa khyad par can gyi 'khor dpal chen phyag na rdo rje sogs rigs gsum sems dpa' rnams kyis bsdu ba mdzad de gnas dang yul gyi ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rab 'byams la gtad pa dag bla( rgyan he ru ka'i 'du khang sogs gsang mdzod dam par bka' rgyas btab cing 'byung ba gang gis kyang mi 'jig para'adzin cing bzhubs pa las/ grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis gdan drangs te 'phags bod kyi yul du dar bar mardod la/ snod min log sred can dang rtog ge ba dag gi spyod yul du ma gyur pa 'bras bu'i theg pa yang gsang bla na med pa'i tshul de dag brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rnams kyis gzhan don mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sprin rum las dad brtson shes rab ldan pa'i gdul bya kho nar zab chos kyi char zim bar ma chad par bkram shing 'khor ba ru log tu mardod pa'i rgyun ma nyams par gnas pa 'di ltabu dag paṇa grub rig 'dzin rnams dang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bdag rkyen las byung bas na/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu thar 'dod skye rgu kun 195

gyi gling dang dpung gnyen du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces pa'o/ de ltar sngon gyi bsags rgyab bzang po la brten nas tshe 'dir dam pa'i chos dang mjal zhing gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs su zin kyang / 'khor ba las blo ma ldos par 'di snang gi 'tsho rtsis la mngon par zhen nas sprul pa'i sku yin/ rin po che yin/ mkhan po che ge mo yin zer nas bla ma dang chos grogs la zur mig tsam yang mi blta bar 'dod yon bsu brid dang sha chang bud med kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bsgom sgrub rgyab tu bor/ tshe 'di'i rkyen zlog rim gro lhur len chos su brdzib dang / 'chad nyan dbang bskur gyis nor rdzas gsog pa mang rab zhig grog tshang brdol ba ltar snang ba ni bsnan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam ste/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i man ngag rin po che'i mdzwod las/ chos byed rnams kyi ma nye rnam drug ni/mchod gnas nye 'brel byed pas tshogs gnyis phyogs ma nye/ /sgrub pa dal khom byed pas dngos grub phyogs ma nye/ /dge sbyor rkyen zlog byed pas sangs rgyas phyogs ma nye/ /bzlas brjod long gtam byed pas nus mthu'i phyogs ma nye/ /yon tan nga rgyal byed pas gnas lugs phyogs ma nye/ /lag len mi chos byed pas lha chos phyogs ma nye/ /de ltar ma song shin tu gces pa lags/ zhes dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ nor gyis nor 'tshol tshong pa la/ /g.yo sgyu che zhes kun gyis smad/ /chos kyis nor 'tshol zog po la/ /ngo mtshar che zhes kun gyis bsnod/196

sdo mi gsungs pa ltar legs par brtags na bstan pa nyams shing dam pa rnams kyi tsugs khrel ba'i gnas su 'dug pas cung zad re bag yod par mardod 'tshal /mdoran slob dpon chen po'i rjes 'jug tu khas 'ches shing bka' gter gyi dbang bskur thob pa dag le lo dang phyi bshol du ma song bar man ngag ngo sprod la brten nas bsgom sgrub nyams len dang dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung ba gal che ste 〈snab dpon chen pos/ da khyed rgyal pos dbu mdzad rje 'bangs rnams nyon cigaji bsnan pa 'di la dal 'byor gyi mi lusathobaca gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugasaca tshe 'di la byang chub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyisaca rtsab dang yan lag gi dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung ba gal checa de ma bsrung na 'tsho byed kyi sman btsal bas reg phung gi dug dang 'phrad pa ltabu'o: dam tshig bsrung ba la dad pa dang brtson 'grus thes rab gsum tshang dgos: dad pa med na gsang sngags kyi snod du mi rung : brtson 'grus med na le lo can tha mal du 'chor: shes rab med na sasang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mo dbye mi shes: zhes gsungs pa bzhin blo ldan rnams kyis gsang sngags bka' gzhung bzhin dam tshig la skyes bus gzhu 'gengs pa ltar thang lhod snems bskyangs med par bsrung dgos/ de la thog mar dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu drug tu bzhad de/ ji skad du/ mi shes pa dang bag med dang / /nyon mongs mang dang ma gus dang / /brjed ngas dran pa mi gsal ba/ /'di drug dam tshig nyams 197

pa'i rgyu/ /zhes so / nyams tshul la rnam pa lnga ste/ spyi mdo las/ nyams par gyur pa gang zhe na/ /kun tu nyams pa chen podang / /rtsab nyams dang yan lag nyams/ /de bzhin zlas nyams zhar nyams lnga / /zhes sku / mi nyams par bsrung ba la nges 'byung dang skyo shas dad pa dang dag snang dran pa dang shes bzhin bag yod rnams brten dgos par gsungs te/ bzhis springs las/ bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas te bag med pa/ /'chi ba'i gnas su thub pas bka' stsal te/ /de bas khyod kyis dge chos spel slad du/ /gus pas rtag tu bag dang bcas par mdzod//ces dang / rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni//shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ gang bsrung bar bya ba ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las rgyud sde so sor rtsaltung bcu bzhir bshad pa rnams dang / bla med kyi lugs la thun mong du brtul zhugs nyer lnga/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa/ rtsaltung bcu bzhi/ yan lag sbom po'i ltung ba rnams dang / gzhan yang pha ma dgra bcom gsod pa/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byin pa lta bu mtshams med lnga'i las dang / mchod rten bzheg pa/ byang sems gsod pa/dgra bcom ma sun byung ba/ 'phags pa slob pa gsod pa rnams ni bstan pa'i sgo 1mi8

zhugs pa rnams kyis bgyi bar mi srid kyang / las kyi dbyen byed pa dang / nye ba lnga'i mtha' ma dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog pa ni deng sang shin tu 'adzrem par 'os pa haid do/ de bzhin du lci ba bzhi dang log pa brgyad du bzhad pa rnams kyang rang rgyud la brtags te spang bar bya'o/ gang zhe na/ mkhas pa'i gral gong / dge slong gi phyag sgrub pa po'i zas/ sngags pa'i nor te log pa'i lci ba bzhi/ mi chos kyi mna' zos pa/ nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims nyams pa/ byang sems kyi bslab pa nyams pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa ste nyams pa'i lci ba bzhi/gasta mug gi dbang gis snon pa'i sku la smad pa/ nga rgyal gyi dbang gis mkhas pa'i yon tan la smad pa/ phrag dog gi dbang gis bden pa'i tshig la smad pa/phyogs ris dbang gis chos la dgag sgrub bgyid pa ste smad pa'i lci ba bzhi/mtshams med lnga las khrag 'byin lci/ mi dge bcu las log lta lci/ mnyam pa'i chos la khyad 'don lci/ rang bzhin med la 'gal 'dzug lci ba ste bkur ba'i lci ba bzhi dang bcu drug go /log pa brgyad ni / dge ba can la smad pa/ sdig pa can la bstod pa/ dge ba can gyi thugs dkrugs pa/ dad pa can gyi tshogs bcag pa/bla ma spangs pa/ yi dam spangs pa/ mched lcam spangs pa/ dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dral ba rnams so/ de lta bu'i ltung ba dag mi gos pa'i thabs la brtson zhing /bye brag tu sngar bstan pa bzhin ma hā yo ga la sgyu 'phrul ltar rtsaba'i dam tshig lnga 199

da nga ya na lag dam tshib bcu la rnam grangs sum brgya drug cur spros pa dang ༈ a nu yo gar lung thams cad kyi rtsab spyi mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las rtsaba'i dam tshig gsum dang yan la ga snyer lngar bzhad pa dang / gzhan ya nga bal mdo nges pa 'i dam tshig bzhi/ thun mong be dam tshig nyer brgyad/ lhag pa'i dam tshig bzhi/brtul zhugs kyi nyer gsum/ sgrub pa'i nyi shu/ spyod lam rgyun gyi dam tshis bzhi sogs dang / a ti yo gar srung mtshams can rim gyis pa la/ spyi dang / khyad par/ lhag pa'i dam tshig gsum las/ dang po ni so thar byang sems bsang sngags thun mong gi srung sngom mi 'dor ba'o/ gnyis pa la rtsaba'i dam tshig nyer bdun dang / yan lag nyer lnga rnams so/ gsum pa ni lhag pa'i dam tshig nyi shur grags pa rnams te rgyas par sngom gsum rnam par nges pa'i 'grel pa rnams dang / yon tan mdzod kyi 'grel pa zab don snang byed 'od zer brgya pa sogs la 'jub par bya'o/ gal te nyams na ngo tsha 'jigs skrag gis sngar ma'i spang du sbrul zhugs pa'am sgeg mo'i mgo la me shor ba ltar nyes dmigs shes pas che 'dod khengs sems kyi dbang du ma song bar thabs sna tshogs kyis gso ba'i tshul phyir bcos kyi gzhung la bslab par bya'o/ ji ltar zhe na/ dbang bzhi la ltos pa'i gso thabs/ dus 'das la ltos pa'i gso thabs/ snying po rgyan las bshad pa'i phyir bcos nyer lnga / ya ga gsum gyi rnal 'byor spyi khrus kyis gso ba sogs la 200

'bad cing sdig pa dag pa'i rtags thob pa ra byed la dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang bsnan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam yang gdab par bya'o/ de ltar lta dgongs dam tshig dang ldan pa la ni phyi ma lta ci tshe 'di la yang rtsagasum lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlob cing / ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams kyis phrin las bsgrub/ ye shes dang las las grub pa'i rdo rje chos srung rnams kyang lus dang grib rmi bzhin 'grogs zhing don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba ni nges pa ste/ gsang ba'i snying po las/tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang //gtsug gi nor bu 'bar ba ltar/ /g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan pas/ /sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi/ /gtsug tu bzhag ste bkur bar bya/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i rigs mchog 'dzin pa de/ /'jig rten gtso dang kun gyis bkur/ /dam pa dang dam pa yis/ /sras dang spun dgongs byin gyis rlob/ /ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/༈ bcu pakhyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs las brtsams te smon pa ni/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i ye shes la/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gdangs shar bas/ /blun sgom sems las 'das pa'i rdzogs pa che//mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ 'khetshor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems la snang yang khye rdo la 201

bsnyebs pa ltar lung rig zab mo 'a/ kha 'byams pa sa phyi rol shes bya la mi rtos mi dpyod par ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ges rdo 'phen pa'i byed po la dpyod pa ltar bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas sems nyid ngos bzung dang bral ba gzhi med rtsabral rnam thar sgo gsum gyi bdas nyid rgya chad phyogs lhang med pa ni ngo bo 'dod nas dag pa zhes/ ming dang tshig dang yi ge'i spyod yul las 'das pa ste/ stong rkyang med dgag sga phyogs kyang ma yin pa rang gdangs kyi ye shes lhun grub rang byung gi snang ba 'du 'bral med pa dag khregs chod kyis satan la phab ste soms pa mthar son pa las 'byung bzhi rags pa'i dul phran ye shes kyi mes bzhus te grol sa ka dag chen po'i klong du thim par 'gyur la/ gzhan rdon du gyur na ring bsrel rnam bzhir sprul te 'ardzob par mardod cing / rig pa rang byung gi ye shes 'pho 'gyur med pa chos dbyings spros med kyi spubs su 'khyel ba las rang bzhin dang 'gro 'dul sna tshogs sprul sku rnams rgyun chad pa med par byung ba'o/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rig gdangs dngos ni/ khregs chod kyis lus dul phran dang sems chos nyid du grol ba las kyang khyad du 'phags pa thod brgal man ngas si rim pa sazhen la brten nas sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba tshad med pa mngon sum pa'i gtan tshigs kyis lam du byed de snang bzhi tshad du 'khyol ba las/ khams gsum phyi nang gi 'byung ba rnams 'od gsal du dengs nas rdo rje'i sku grub ste gzhan don 'khor ba 20lha

ma stongs bar rten de nid kyis gnas pa slob da rio 2 cherme rio pa dma dang bi ma la ltabu ste/ mdor na ka dag dang lhun grub gnyis ka'i grol sa mthar thus ka das chen po gdod ma'i sanas lusas su thim nas rang snang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang zhing khams tshad med pa la dbang 'byor ba dang / gzhan don du 'u sas 'byung bees spru' pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros rte gdul bya thabs sna tshogs kyis 'dul bar mardod pa yin no/ de lta bu'i gnas lugs zab mo'i rang bzhin sna/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis/ rgyal ba'i 'khor lo bar pa rnam thar gsum/ /bstan bya'i ngo bo so so rang rig la/ ༈se ma sa can khams na bde gshegs snying po'i sku//rang bzhin bzhugs la rdzobs pa chen por grags / /thes bsungs pa bzhin no/de la dbyings ka dag sna se mas nyid ye nas dag pa'o/ ye shes ka das sna ris pa skyes sam gnas dus nyid nas ngo bo med pa 'o/ gnyis rme da ka dag sna gang snang ba nyid las tha dad pa'i chos nyid ma grub pa 'otsā de bzhin du dbyings lhu rna grub ni ye nas 'od gsal ba'i sem sa nyid sus kyang ma byas pa ra gdod ma nas dus gsu ma 'pho 'gyur nge da pa'o/ ye shes lhu na grub ni dkyil 'khor gsu ma dang cir sne nga thams cad ye shes kyi rol bar thar ba nid su sa kyang ma byas nga ra ye thes snyed rang snang ba'o/ banyis med lhu na grub ni de ltar ye shes su snang ba ya nga rtag ri dang bden pa'i rang bzhin ma yin te/ chu zla'am gzugs brnyan ltar snang 'a ngo bos 203

stong pa'i bdag nyid rdo༈ de lta bas na gang zag rim gyis pa rnams kyis thog ma/ra 'khor lo dang po'i mdo dang bstan bcos la brten nas rgyu 'bras blang dor dang gang zag bdag med kyi tshul rnams nges dgos/ de nas 'khor lo bar pa'i mdo sde dang dgongs 'grel rnams la brten nas mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba chos kyi bdag med pa'i gnas lugs mthar phyin par nges shing / de yi 'og tu 'khor lo mtha' ma'i mdo dang bsnan bcos rnams kyi dgongs pa btsal te sems dang ye shes shan 'byed cing / sngar gyi snang stong bden gnyis kyi kun rdzob las khyad par du byas pa sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i gnas lubs gnas snang bden gnyis la myong ba 'don dgos/ gdod gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang dgongs 'grel rnams la brten nas 'khor lo mtha' ma'i bstan don 'od gsal ba'i gnas 'u gas de lha sku phyag rgya dang zhing dang gzhal yas khang la sosas pa'i rnam par shar ba mtshan bcas lha'i rnal 'byor dang ༈ 'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo sde rnams kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal bar sngags kyi mtshan med rdzogs rim la 'jug dgos/ thams cad kyi mthar theg pa kun gyi rtse mo rtsol med kyi ye shes la 'jug par bya ste/ de ltar na sgro 'dogs pa dang skur pa btab pa'i gzhi med cing gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ grub mtha' thams cad rang sa rang sar bden cing gong ma'i lam stegs su'ang shes par 'gyur ro/204

blob dpon ārya de ba'i zhal snga nas / bsod nams ma yi na dang po ra ldo ga༈ ༈bar du bdag ni ldog pa dang / /tha mar lta ba kun ldos si / /gang sis thes de malas pa yin/ /ces pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ de ltar a sta ya sa'i lta sgom spyod pa'i tshul lam gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam sazhag rgyas par ni 3nga rta chen po kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gzhung las thes par 'gyur zhwa ༈ blo dang mi ldan pa 'i blun po zu lum can dang rtog ge'i rjes su 'brangs pa bsod nams mi ldan pa snams kyi spyo da yul las 'das pa dang re zhig snod du ma gyur pa sa na sgro skur smra ba la 'jug pa sa ci bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa 'i mdo la sa / rgyal pos la nga ba du ma bsags te glang chen bstan nas/ mtshan nid so so ra smros thib ces bsgos pas de dag rnams kyis glang po che'i sna la reg pa rnam sa ri lcasas kyu 'dra'o/zhes zer/ mig la reg pa rnams ni phor ba 'dra'o/ rna ba la reg pa rnams ni zhib ma 'dra'o/ rgyab la reg pa rnams ni khyogs dang 'dra'o/ mjug ma 'a res ru rnams ni thig gu 'dra'o/ zhes zer ro/ de rnam sa kyis glang po che smus sazhan la smras pa ma yin yang / thams cad du rtogs pa ni ma yin no/ de bzhin du sa ngas rgyas kyi rang bzhin yang stong pa nyid dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / 'od sas la ba la sogs tha dad par smras kyang thams cad du rtogs pa ni ma yi na no/ thes dang gang so so skye po dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub se tsha sa205

dpa' rnams kyis kyang ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi snying po mthong ba ma yin no dper na dmus long zhig gis gzhan la mar gyi kha dog dris pas/ kha ba 'dra'o zhes sprus pa dang / des kha ba la reg pas mar gyi kha dog grang mor 'dzin to/dris pa/ kha ba'i kha dog ci 'dra/ smras pa/ ngang pa'i gzhog pa 'dra'o/ ngang pa'i gshog sgra thos pas kha ba'i kha dog 'ur 'ur por 'dzin to/ dris pa/ gzhog pa'i kha dog ci 'dra/ dung dang 'dra'o/ dung la reg pas 'ardzam por 'dug pas/ de yang 'ardzam por 'dzin to/ ji ltar smras kyang dmus long gis kha dog ji lta ba bzhin mi shes pa de ltar sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin mthongabar yang rab tu dka'o༈zhes gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la thes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang / de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / 'od gsal ba'i sems dang / rang bzhin rnam dag dang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / rnam kun mchog ldan/ gnyug ma mi shig pa'i sem sa dang /rang byung gi ye shes dang / gzhi rgyud rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes tha snyad sna tshogs su bsnan pa rnams don gcig kyang ngo sprod kyi rim pa la ring ba dang / phyogs tsam pa dang / nye ba dang / shin tu nye ba dang / ches nye ba dang /tsan slebs pa lta bu'i khyad par rnams rton pa bzhi la brten nas rtogs par bya ba nyid do/206

༈ bcu sacib pa man ngag a ti yo sa'i zung 'jug lam gyi rim pa las brtsams te smon pa sna/ ya/da med phyogs rer zhen pa'i dmigs gtad zhis/mthar 'dzin lta ba'i 'dzin snangs drung nas phyung / /gzhi 'a ma 'bras bu snang stong zung du 'jug /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bsungs te/zab gsal gnyis su med pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'i rang ma tshan ni sems nyid ngal gso la sa / ma hā'i rlung dang bskyed rim thabs gtso la/ /a nu'i khams dang shes rab jio gas rim gtso༈ /a tis tham sa cad gnyis med ye shes gtso/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhirme/ chos phung ma lus pa'i snying po dang bcud phul du byung ba mthar thus mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim ye shes la lam du byed pa ste bya rtsol med pa'i theg pa zhis blo 'das kyai sanas lugs ma bcos pa nid rtsal du bton pa'o/ kun byed las༈ sems nid byang chub sems kyi ngo bo la༈ /lta ba bsgom med spyo da pa spyad du med/ /'bras bu sgrub me da sa la bgrod du me da//dkyil 'khor bskyed med bzlas bajiod rdzosas rim med/ /dbang 'a bskur rme da dam tshig bsrung du med/ /ye shes lhun grub das pa 'i chos nid la / 7glo bur rim rtsol rgyu 'bras chos las 'das/ /zhes pa ltar nges don mdo rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa mthar thug blo 'das kyi don la ma reg pa ra/ med dgag nges don du rlom pas rang stong dang ma yin dasag nges don du bsams nas gzhan stong du smra ba 207

lta bu phyogs rer zhen pa'i 'dzin stangs sam dmigs gtad kun dang bral ba༈gzhi rdzogs pa chen po sems can gyi khams na bde bar gshes/sa pa'i snying po'am rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor rang chas su bzhugs pa dag lam rdzogs ju chen po gnas don lus gsum gyi bag chags glo bur ba sbyong byed rtsol med kyi thabs zab mo la brten nas/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba nang gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i sku'i bdag nyid sku dang ye shes bla na med pa'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa ste gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs mtha' das cang med chang/ pa'i med dgag dang rtag brtan ther zug dpyad gzod kyi bden grub tu 'jog pa las khyad par du byas pa snang stong zung 'jug gi 'od gsal spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba ni/ dper na nam mkha' la tshon mi chags pa dang sgro skur gyis bsgyur du med pa bzhin grub mtha' dang theg pa gang gis kyang brdzi bar nus pa ma lags so/ 'o na kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gsung rab dag las snying po bstan pa'i mdo dang rgyud kyi dgongs pa phal cher ma yin dgag tu bzhed pa ma yin nam zhe na/ 'khor lo bar pa ltar na gtan tshigs gtso bo med dgag yin kyang lta ba spros bral dang / 'khe ra lo tha ma dang sngags rgyud ltar gtan tshigs gtso bo ma yin dgag tu bstan kyang lta ba sngar bzhin spros bral du bzhed pa las rang stong gzhan stong gang yang ma yin te/ de gnyis la zung 'jug bzhag tu med cing 208

gsor mi rung ba'i lta ba zhes gzur gnas dam pa mang po thugs tshabs che bar mdzod do/ kha cig spros bral yin zer na ha shang gi lta bar 'gro༈ g.yung drung dang nam mkha' zer na bon gyi lugs yin zer ro/ de ltar na sher phyin gyi mdo sde rnams las nam mkha' mang du snang bas bdag cag gi sto na pa 'di gshen rab dang gcig tu 'khums so/ rtag pa med pa'i mardo' bzhes kyis/ /g.yung drung chos ni 'jig par byed/ /ces 'byung bas zhi ba lha de yang bon po yin 'dra'o/ spros bral ha shang gi lugs yin na klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung las spros bral 'ba' zhig gsungs snang bas ha shang yin par thal ba sogs tshig la rton na sngar gyi mkhas pa dag kyang deng sang gi las dang po pas mtshang brtebs par 'gyur ro/ 'ardom dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i zhal snga nas / deng sa nga ni rnying ma'i chos kyi sand dang mthun mi mthun gyi dpyad pa gtong ba tsam ya nga med pa ra/ kha nas gang byung zhig brjod shes na chos su brtsi—bas/ bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam gyi mtha' la thug pas kun bzang thugs kyi bsnan pa yun ring du mi gnas pa 'i brda snon pa ste shin tu skyo ba'i gnas so/ zhes gsu ngas pa thusas mad pas man ngag brgyud ldan dag las rtsing chos su ma song bar zhun gdar bcad pa gnad che'o/༈ bcu gnyis pa mthar thug grub mtha'i skyel so la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i smon pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug don/ /zab zhi spuos 209

bral 'od gsal 'dus ma/ byas/ /rig stong mi shibs rdo rje grub pa 'i mtha' /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ de ya nga man ngag a sta yo ga'i theg pa la/ brtson 'grus can 'bad bcas kyi grol ba ka dag 'khregs chod kyi 'a ma dang ༈ le lo can 'bad med du grol ba lhun grub thod brgal gyi lam dang gnyis/ de re re la yang snang ba yu' gyi blo can bsgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba dang / rig pa rang snang gi blo can lta thog nas bsgom pa 'tshol ba gnyis su yod la/ nyams su blang bya ni/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i snying po las/'di ni gsang chen nges pa yi/ /'bras bu lam du gyur pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi brnyes so/ /zhis gsungs pa ltar/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i zhe phug mthar thug pa mkhas pa dang grub pa dang lo paṇa bye ba mang po lhan cig pas zhal bsdur yang 'di las lhag pa'i nges don gyi sanas rnyed par mi 'gyur ba'i rdzogs rim la zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba theg chen thun mong ṅga lta dgongs dang /'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i bzhis lugs gtan la 'bebs pa thun min sngags kyi gnad gsang thams cad yar ldan du rdzogs pa ste/ ji ltar na mtshan nyid theg pa dang phyi rgyud rnams lta ci smos/ nang rgyud ma hā ya ga'i bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i lam snang stod zung 'jug gi lha sku bsgom pa dang rdzogs rim nam mkha'i gzugs lha10

can/ nyi zla'i sazugs can/ mnyam rdzogs gzugs can rnams kyi gnad bsang dang / a nu yo ga'i gsang dbang dang sher dbang gyi lam khyer rang lus thabs ldan gsal snong dang gzhan lus phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bde stong zung 'jug rnams/man ngag a sta yo ga'i dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod kyi ye shes rig stong zung 'jus nyid la 'dus pa'i phyir/ ma hā a nu gnyis kyang mthar gyis rdzogs pa chen por sazheol zhing babs pas don gyis sanyug ma mi shig pa'i gnas lugs gzhi 'bras dbyer med rdo rje theg pa'i gsang lam gyi snying po la brten nas snang ba mched pa thob pa nyer thob kyi ye shes bzhi'am/ thod brgal snang bzhi ltar sbyar bas snang ba dang po gnyis su rnam smin rig 'dzin dang / gsum pa tshe dbang / bzhi pa phyag chen rig 'dzin la dgongs spyod rgya mtsho lta bu mthar phyin pa las/ lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i grub mtha' tshe 'di nyid la stogs nus pa rgyud don lung sis phye ba tsam la rags ma las par lung don man ngag gis gnad du bdeg pa ma tsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la khams gsum gyi grong khyer dong nas sprugs par gyur cig ces so/༈ bcu gsum pa ma khas pa'i bgyi ba gsum gyis rgyal bstan 'dzin par smon pa la/ dngos dang / 'phros don bshad pa gnyis las dang po ni/ mang du thos pa lung gi sprin 'khrigs rshang / /pha rol rgol 'joms rig pa'i glog phreng 211

'bar/ /man ngag gnad kyi bdud rtsi snying la sim/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces pa gsungs te/ spyir na bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa thams cad thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab rgyud la brten dgos shing / bye brag tu bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po rnams ni thugs las chung ngur bzhugs pa mi rigs te/mdo las/ dase slong dag myur du mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang bya bar 'dod pas thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin pa yangs su 'tshol ba la bslab par bya'o/ zhis gsungs pa bzhin rang rgyud thos pas dgrol ba dang lung rig man ngag zab rgus rgyud gtams par byas te/ gzhan don du ming dang go sa cung zad kyis sbyin bdag 'tshol rgyugs dang dpal 'byor longs spyod bsdu shes pa tsam gyis bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bur rlom pa ltabu ma yin par/ gdul bya 'khor du nye ba dbang brtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa rnams la lung rgyas shing rigs pa dang man ngag mdor bsdu ba'i tshogs bshad dang / dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brangs rnams la lung ribs mdo tsam dang man ngag rgyas par bstan pa slob bshad kyis rjes su bzung zhing rton pa bzhi dang dgongs ldem dgongs kyi rim pa rnams kyang ma 'tshol bar gdams par bya'o/yang re 'ga' 'khor du gtogs pa ma yin pa pha rol rgol bar gnas pa tshad min gyi blo can gzu por mi gnas pa sgro skur smra ba lhur len pa log pa'i sa mkhan du gyur pa dag mchis na dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung dang 'thad sgrub kyi rig pa/lha12

rgol snga phyi gnyis ka'i khas len pa'i man ngag rnatsha sa la brten nas mdo rgyud kyi chos dang mthun par phyin ci log gi spobs pa 'joms shing bsnyil ba dang rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi ba la brtson par bya'o/ 'dir lung rigs man ngag rnams ni sprin la sogs pa'i gzugs su bkod do/ de la lung ni gang zhe na/ gzhal bya shin tu lkog gyur gyi gnas 'jal ba la mdo rgyud kyi chig dum bur phyung zhing yid ches su byed pa'o/ ji skad du/ lung ni yid ches tshig yin te/ /nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi chig /smra bar mi 'gyur rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/zhes so/ rigs pa ni gzhal bya mngon gyur dang cung zad lkog gyur 'jal ba la mngon rjes kyi tshad ma'i stobs kyis 'thad pa sgrub pa'o/ tshad ma rigs pa'i sgo zhes bya ba las/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig phyir/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun 'byin nyid/ /ltar snang bcas pa sazhan rtogs phyir/ zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na bya byed stos pa'i risas pa dang chos nyid kyi rigs pa rnams la 'jug go de dag gi tshul ni rong ston shes bya kun gzigs kyais/ ltos pa'i rigs pa gang zhe na gang 'du byed rnams 'byung ba na rkyen la stos pa'o/ bya ba byed pa'i rigs pa gang zhe na/ gang rang gi mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i chos rnams so so rang gi bya ba byed pa'o/ gtan tshigs kyi rigs pa gang zhe na/gang bsgrub par bya ba'i don tshad ma dang mi 'gal bar ston pa'o/ chos nyid kyi lha13

rigs pa gang zhe na/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid du gnas pa'i chos rnams la chos nyid du grags pa'o/ zhes gsungs so/ man ngag ni/ rgyud las/ tshegs chung don che thabs dpag med/ /bya sla dpag dka' man ngag go/ zhes pa ltar tshegs chung ngus don dpag tu med pa dag rtogs sla ba'i thabs su gyur pa'o/ 'o na pha rol po'i rgol ba la brten pa'i rtsod pa ji lta bu zhe na༈de la spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni phyi rol mu stegs pa rnams kyis nang pa sangs rgyas dang / nang pa la nyan thos sde pa rnams mdo 'don pa 'i tshul ma mthun pas sde pa bco brgyad du gyes pa dang / thun mong du nyan thos pa rnams kyis theg pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma yin par smra ba dang /theg chen la yang sems tsam pa dang dbu ma pa rnams phan tshun rtag chad kyi skyon 'gel res byed pa dang / bod du gsang sngasas snga 'gyur ba la phyi dar gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang pho brang zhi ba 'od/ la chen rin chen bzang po/ rngog blo ldan shes rab sogs dang / phyis su 'gos lo glo ba lhas btsas dang 'bri gung dpal 'dzin sogs kyis byas pa 'byams yig dang sngasas log sun 'byin du grags pa'i bstan bcos mang rab byung ba'i rgyun 'ga' tsam deng sang yang phyogs 'ga' zhig na shub bu shub bur zlos par byed do/ rtsod pa de dag gang gis zhi bar byed ce na/ mkhas pa de dag las kha cig gi gsung ni gsang sngags la skur ba 214

btab pa min zhing dgongs pa can du bshad la / la la ni sgro skur dang yam rgyugs kyis las ngan bsags pa'ang byung ngo / de la 'di snyam du bsam par bya ste/ phyi dar gyi dus su paṇa grub ji snyed byung ba rnams kyi gtsug si nor bu ltabu ni jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad nyid yin la/ de yi gsung byang chub lam gyi sgron ma ni bstan pa'i dag ther du mardod/ de las ma do sngags kyi chos la 'jug tshul gsal bar skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang 'brel te bstan pa las/ gsang sngags rnying ma chos log tu sgrub pa'i tshig lam sgron rtsa'agrel dang bka' gdams gling bam sogs las gcig kyang med pa ma zad rnying ma'i rgyud dang slob dpon chen po la bsngags brjod phul ba'i tshul 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur bas shes so/ 'on kyang thang yig las/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud rnams pham/ /chos ma yin rnams chos kyis pham/ /dge 'dun gyis ni mu stegs pham/ /dbang pos lha min pham par 'gyur/ /lha min gyis ni zla ba pham/ /nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho pham//zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar/ theg pa dang grub mtha' rgya mtshe'i pha mthar son pa rong zom chos kyi bzang po/ rog ban shes rab 'od/ bang ston lo tsā ba/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ sog bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan rnams kyis gsang sngags bka' sgrub mdzwad de log par smra ba'i spobs pa maba' dag ming gi lhag ma tsam du mdzad/ tshul de dag re re bzhin bskyar zlos byed par dgos pa ma mchis 215

shing yig tshogs kyi ngal bas ma bris zhwa / thes par 'dod pa rnams kyis nges don 'brug sgra dang mi bskyod rdo rje'i dris lan sog bzlog pas mdzad pa dag la blta bar bya'o/ sgyu gnyis pa 'phros don gtso che ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig so sor 'chad pa la/ jiod byed gzhung dang tshig la 'khrul ba sel ba dang / brjod bya la los rtog se la ba/ gdams pa khyad par can gyis mjug sdud bsnan pa gsum las/ dang po la spyi dang bye brag gnis las/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi mkhas pa la las rnying ma'i rgyud rnams rgya gar na med sangs rgyas kyis ma sasungs bod kyi sngags mkhan dang lo tsā bas byas zer ro/ de yi lan ni kho bo cag ci bder nyal chog pa zhig grub thob o rgyan pa rin chen dpal dang paṇa chen shākya mchog lda na pas mardod pa ni rim par o rgyan pa 'i zhal nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba kha cig rgya gar na rnying ma bsgyur rgyu med zeratsā de la chag lo tsā ba nyid bdag rang gi dbang zhus kyi bla ma yin yang rgya gar na rnying ma 'i rgyud bsgyur rgyu mi 'dug zer/ de 'dra khong rang blo chung gi gtam yin/ lo tswa ba rgya gar shar phyogs su yug re las ma phyin pas rgya gar na gang yad cha ci yod/ de las bod na gar yod kyi cha ya/nga mi chod/ spyir yang rgya gar tshad khungs che bas dpe rnams rul ba mang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' ra chad bzung med pa la/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis de'i khungs ci chod/ ngas nub phyogs a rgyan gyi yul la phyin pa yang mu dang mtha' ma chod/ de yang dang po'i rgya dpe rnams 216

dus phyis bal po na mang ba yin/ de bas bal po bhe nyi ra'i gtsug lag khang gcig na rnying ma'i rgyud rnams kyi rnam grangs rang yang bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs 'dug ngas bod kyi rnying ma rnams la ngas rnying ma'i rgya dpe dang paṇaḍi ta tshur dgug khyed rang rnarma sa kyang yul skyid grong du 'dong / ngas la tsā ba byas bsgrur zer ba byas kyang bod kyi sngags pa rnams bu smad gso bas g.yengs te ma 'grub/ rnying ma'i 'gyur da rung bya rgyu 'dug pa la/ zhes gsungs so/ gnyis pa rgyud bye brag pa la log rtog se la ba ni༈ sngar gyi rtsod yig rnams las 'byung ba bzhin slob dpon pad ma'i thugs dam bzhin rje pra phog snang gi rgyud gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis brtsams zer yang / rgyud kyi rgya dpe dngos slob dpon shan sta pa'i phyag tu son pa spyod rgyud du bkral ba sogs kyis khungs brdol/ rnying ma'i tshe bdag gnubs kyis brtsams zhes 'be|sa lhas btsas smra bzhin rgya gar du chos 'tshol bar phyin pa las paṇaḍi ta nag po pa'i phyag nas rnying ma'i tshe bdag byung ba lo tsā ba rang gis rang la yid ma ches pa lta bu ngang bsgyur ba bstan 'gyur gyi khrod du bzhag /sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i snying po la rma rin chen ma chog gis brtsams chos yin zer ba'i rdzun phugs bcom ldan rig pa'i ra' gri kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshani/ 'atre sa la gzhon nu dpal/ sha gad 'i tsā sogs kyai phyag dpe dngos po son pas mtshang brtospu/ tshul 'di ni thar pa lo tsā bas༈217

gsang sngags snga 'gyur sgru 'phrul drwa ba yi/ /rgyud rgyal dpal ldan gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang rnams la bka' nyid du/ /rtsod pa med mod 'on kyang snga dus su/ /skad gnyis smra ba lhas btsas la so sas pas/ /skyon bzhi yod ces rgya dpe ma mthong phyir/ /bod kyis byas zhes gangs can 'dir bsgrags pas/ /mkhas rlom 'ga' yang the 31ma gnas su gyur/ /dus phyis gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas pa'i mchog /zab dang rgya che'i gsung rab rnam 'byed cing / /bstan pa'i khur 'dzin mkhas pa'i mdun sa na/ /rgyal mtshan ltar mtho dpal ldarna ral gri yis/ /rgya dpe legs rnyed rtsod bral nyi zla ltar/ /kun la gas la mardod gtsug gi rgyan du mchod/ /ces gsungs so/ rgyud 'di la lag pa'i skyon ba'i bstan pa'i rtsod spong rnams ni gsang 'grel spyi dang khyad par 'gyur med phan bde 'od zer gyi zab don sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde'u mig las gsal bar bstan pas der blta bar bya'o/ grub thob a rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ yang bod kyi shes par 'dod pa 'ga' zhig na re/ rnying ma'i dgongs pa 'dus pa bod kyi sngags rgan tshos bcos pa yin pas mi dag zer/ de 'dra yang 'os su mi 'gro ba'i gtam yin/ shes na de 'dra ba'i chos rang re tsho yang 'chos dang de legs rgyu ni sangs rgyas kyi bka' la'ang med ces gsungs/ chos rje mi pham pas kyang / rnying rgyud thams cad la'ang rgya dpe dang mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi dpe yod par gor ma 218

chag ste/ ci rigs pa bod du bsgyur ba 'dis dan dpang byas pa yin no/ des ma chog par re re bzhin du rgya dpe re gsar du ma mthong bar yid mi ches na/ phyis kyi 'gyur ba'i chos thams cad la rgya dpe re re bzhin ston rgyu khyod tsho la yod dam soms shig gsungs/ rog shes rab 'od kyi gsung las kyang / dus phyis rgya gar du bstan pa'i grwa nyams rgyud sde rnams rim gyis nub/ rgya dpe rnams pha' cher chud cos/ grub thob kha yar gyis ma kha' 'gro'i sasang mardood nas blangs pa rnams khong du ma chud de gnyer tshag ma byas/ de'i tshe bstan pa phyi dar du grabs pa'i skabs na/ rgya paṇa gser 'dod rnams kyis bod na chos gang rtsis che dris nas bcos ma mang po byas/ lo tsā mkhas grags 'dod pa rnams kyis/ dbyar mang yul du bsnad/ dgun bal yul du 'khyams/ sngon gyi lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsgyur ba rnams la rang bzo'i 'gyur bcos sna chogs byas/ zhes dang / rgya gar ba'i khung bzang drangs te gsar chos rtsis che byas pa sa bstan rma nyams dmas pa yin gsungs/ des na phyis kyi lo paṇa rnams bstan pa kho na thugs la gdags pa yin na smod mi ribs mo da/ ma khe grasas don du sanyer ba kho na ches ma nga la/ don du ni bye brag bzhad mdzod chen mo'i rgya dpe phyed tsam pa de bsgyur ba lta ci 'ju bar yang ma spobs pa 'di rgyu mtsharna ci la thug dpyod ldan rnams kyis legs par brtags na/ deng sang rgyal ba'i bka' bsgyur rin po che 2/9

zhes gsar rnying yongs rdzogs kyi sngas mgor 'jog pa 'di snga 'gyur lo pa ṇa rnams kyi bka' drin yin par shes na rgya dpe yod med zhib bsdur ma dgos par phyin ci log gi lta ngan thams cad ngang gis zhi bar 'gyur ro/ mardor na paṇa chen shākya mchog ljan pa'i zhal nas/ rnying ma'i chos rnams 'phags yul nas//bsgyur bar 'bad pas bsgrub mi dgos/ /slob dpon sprul ba'i sku nyid kyis//gsungs pa nyid du grub pas mchog/ /'phags pa'i yul nas phyis bsgyur ba'i//sngags dang brda skad ma mthun kyang / /mchog dang thun mong sgrub pa la/ /mi bsu grub phyir de tshad ma/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa la dran pa nye bar bzhag par bya'o/yang kha cig khyed cag gi rnying ma rgyud 'bum de bka' 'gyur khrod du med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zer/ de ni sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa las gsal ba ltar mnga' bdag khri ral gyis bca' ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya rdo rje rtse gcig pas bcings te gsang sngags nang gi chos rnams bka' gnyan pa'i phyir thun mong sde snod rnams dang lhan cig bsdebs par ma gnang zhing dkar chag tu 'god par yang bkag go 'o na phyis dkar chag bkod pa min nam zhe na/ bden mod kyi de ni gdul bya lubor du nye ba rnams kyi ngor dgos pa'i dbang gis bzhag la/ gang dag kun bzang yab yum dang ma hā a sta la sogs pa'i chos skad thos pas snying gas pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal byed pa rnams la ni nam du'ang gsang bar 'os pa yin no/ de la skyes lan 2lha0

du 'di bskur bar bya sne/ rtogasabajiodadapagabasama'akhrisgengad bsnana'agyur — khrod du mi bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ de la rgya dpe yod dam med/ ya da na yar 'dab bco lnga pa la slar zhus dag bgyi 'os/ med na bsre bslad btang ba mai 'thad do/ des na rtogs dpyod rnam thar re la yang lhad bcub rgyu e rnyed blta rme gre zhan smos ci dgos te mkhas pa rnams kyis brtag par bya'o༈ gnyis pa rjod byed chisal 'khrul ba sel ba ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa 'i sasang snying spyi don yi da kyi mul sel las/ kha cig na re/ khyed kyi rgyud 'di das ha cang so sla 'ing / tshig mi madzres pa ci rigs pa snang bas/ sdeb sbyor gyi tshul la sogs pa dang mi ma thun pa'i phyir dang / thes pa gong 'og cha shas dang / nang chan mi 'dra ba rgyud sacig na'ang bstan pa'i phyir dang / bldab pa dang / zlos pa ra yang 'ga' zhig gnas pa'i phyir/ gang zag gis sbyar ba'o zhes 'adzrer ro de'i lī na bsod pa / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa 'a thusas rje mnga' bas sna se ma sa can gyis bo sgra zhing rtogs par bya ba'i phyir basman pa yine gyi/ mi go bar bya ba'i phyir rig byed so so'i mchod sbyin lta bu ma yin cing / tshig kyang sngon gyi dus kyi skad rnying la brten pa ci rigs su snang ba ni/ de dus de bas lhag pa 'i skad gcis zhwa brten du med pa'i phyir dang / rnam pa gcig tu na go sla ba'i phyir 'o paṇa thugs rje can gyis bsgyur te/'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag ngan pa de dag gis ma bslad pas nor ba'i gzhi med 221

pa ra byas pa yin no/ gal rte tshig le gas pa 'ba' zhig legs pa yin na snyan ngag mkhan pos rang bzo byas pa'ang de ltar 'gyur ba dang / rnam pa gcig tu bod kyi chos ji snyed pa'ang yang dag pa ra mi rung ste saṃ skṛ ta'i tshig dang sdeb sbyor ltabu brgya stong gi cha yang med pa'i phyir ro/ lto sa sa la ltos nas 'ardoog so zhe na mtshungs te/ 'dir yang de bas dman pa la ltos nas mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /nang tshan gyi cha shas mi 'dra bas chos ya/nga dag par mi 'gyur na/ kye rdo rje bla med kyi rgyud du nyan thos sde pa bzhi dang / bden pa bzhi'i rnam ga'ag byung bas yang das pa ma yin par 'gyur ba dang / jio ma pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las rgyud kyi 'khenar du gnas brtan kun dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos byung bas gdul bya dang 'dul byed theg pa dang bsam pa 'gal ba dang / nges bajiod bla ma'i rgyud du 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes byung bas na rgyud ma yin par thal ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lor gzugs med kyi lha la gnas nges pa can bshad pas chos mngon pa dang mi mthun pa dang / 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od las / byang chub sems dpa' lu nga bstan 'byung gi rna' 'byor pa lung bstan mi 'byung ngo / /zhes bshad pasatsā mtshan nyid las sngasas dam na par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i nang tshan cung zad 'gal bar snang bas de dag yang dag pa ma yin nam zhes mtshungs so/ bldab bu dang zlos bur bstan pas the tshom gyi gzhir ga la rung ste/ dri ma med pa che chung gi mdo dang 222

stang 'dzin rgyal po/ stang 'dzin mchog dam pa'i mdo༈ mya ngan las 'das pa che chung gi mdo la sogs pa la'ang / balngab pa dang zlos par snang ba dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i byang chub sems kyi le'u dang / rigs kyi yum dang / khro bo bcu'i sngags dang / las dang drag po'i brtul zhugs / phyar bu byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga lta bu dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi pa che chung dang / krirna ya ma ri che chung / de la sogs pa'i rgyud 'di dag la'ang / nang tsha' dang che chung la sosas pa'i ji risas su zlos bur bldab na yang dag pa ma yin par 'gyur ro/ zhes bya ba sogs mang du gsungs so/ gnyis pa bajiod bya don la log rtog sel ba ni/ glang dar gyi bsnan pa bsnubs pa'i skabs las 'phros te deb ther jio gas ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston nang / 'on kyang khyem pa gos dkar gyi rten la sas nga sngags sgrub pa dag ni nang gi de nyid rgyal blon gyis ma rtogs shing / rab byung sga rtags med pas banod pa ma byung ba dpag med yo da pas kun mkhyen ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal nas/ de ltar 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung mod kyi/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong la zhes drangs shing gsungs pa ltar mdo sgyu sems gsum ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su thim nas ring zhig lon zer ba phyogs gcig rdzun du song ba yin la/ phyogs gcig bden par mchis te rtsa—ba nas nub pa ma yin kyang nyams pa mang du yo da pa ni chos 'byung lha dbang g.yul lha23

las rgyal ba'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs las/ snyigs ma'i dus su bka' ma rnams tshogs dus kyi 'o ma bzhin dbang dang gdams ngag gi bka' 'chal zhing / brgyud pa mang pos bar du chod pas dam tshig gi sel dang 'dres 'khyer gyi bslad zhugs pa mang bas byin rlabs kyi babs so nyams par 'gyur ba yin la zhes pa ltar mardo sgyu sems gsum dang klong sde'i brgyud pa rnams la gsar ma'i dge bshes mang po tshang ka thebs nas byung ba 'di la dgongs pa yin zhing / spyir bsnan pa'i gnas tshad la ye shes khong chud dang / lung dang sgrub dus sogs snga ma snga ma dag gi byirna rlabs dang nus pa phyi ma rnam sa la phyogs tsam re las mi 'byung ba'i nams tshul yang shes par gyis shig de bzhin du jo bo'i rnam thar na/ yang jo bo'i thulas dgongs la/ mi yul du bzhugs pa'i gsang sngags la nga las mkhas pa med snyam pa'i thugs rgyal mnga' ba la/ phyis bod du byon nas pe har gling gi dkor mdzwod gcig sgo phyes nas rgya dpe gzigs pas/ jo bos de gong ma gsan ma gzigs pa mang po bzhugs 'dug nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags la mi shes pa med snyam/ ṭwā kai mas kyang nam mkha' nas gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa bstan/ rgyud sde mang po bstan pa yin pa la/ 'di rnams mi gda'/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di la mtha' yad yod mi 'dra gsungs zugs rgyal chags/bod kyi rgyal po la rjes su yi rang ba mang po phul / bod du bstan pa dar ba 'dra ba 224

rgya sar du yang ma byung ba 'dra gsungs/ zhes dang / slob dpon pad ma rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa de'i drin las rgya gar na yongs su ma grags pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod mang po bsgyur nas bsam yas pe har dkor mardood na bzhugs so/zhes bsngags brjod mardod pa des bstan pa rnam dag byung bar yid ches bskyed nus mod/ las kyis mnar ba'i sdig to can sems ma rangs par gnas pa rnams ni tshig 'di rnams mthong zhing thos pas mya ngarna gyi snon mar gyur kyang thabs med pas ci bya ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ lha yi rgyal pos char bab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang / /skal pa med la bzang mi myong / /zhes bya ba ltararo/ mdor na thams cad mkhyen pa mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis dge ba'i bzhes gnyen sangs rgyas rin chen la stsal ba'i dri lan du/ gsang sngags rnying ma pa 'di la/ snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang dgag 'dug cing / da lta yang skur pa 'debs pa mang du 'dug pa/ 'di ji 'dra zhig yin zer ba la/ gsang sngags bstan pa snga dar gyi dus 'gyur ba la rnying ma dang / phyi dar la 'gyur ba la gsar ma zhes 'byung ba yin/ rnying ma la skur pa 'debs pa mang ba'i rgyu mtshan/ sngon glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas bar stongs byung dus gsang sngags pa rnams spyor sgrol la sogs pa phyin ci log byed pa byung ba dang / ding sang yang khyem pa lcang lo can gyi 225

spyodapamangabs/ gang zag gi spyod pa la dpags nas chos la smod pa 'di byung ba 'dra/ de min sngags rnying ma 'di dang po chos rgyal dam pa rnams kyis bee ro tsa na dang / mi gnyags gnyis dge slong mi lnga la sogs pa'i tshad ma'i skyes bur gyur pa lo tsā ba rnams la gser bres bshar la yon du bskur nas/ rgya gar du brdzangs te/ rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa'i gsang sngags bla na med pa'i chos rnams paṇaḍi ta dang / grub rma brnyes pa rtsod med du grags pa rnams la zhus shing bsgyur༈gzhan yang pad ma 'byung gnas dang / bī ma la mi tra dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba la sogs pa 'ang pod du spyan drangs nas de dag gis kyang gsungs pa'i chos/theg pa bla na med pa'i chos zab skyon dang bral ba yin te/ 'di'i tshul nyams su blangs pas grol ba dang / grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa byung ba tshad mas grub bo/ bsam yas na yang da dung snga 'gyur gyi rgya dpe mang du yod par 'dug cing /bod pa lo tsā bas kyang rgya gar du byon pas/ yul dbus 'grur tshal na sasang rnying / lung gi mdo lnga la sogs pa'i rgya dpe 'dug zer/ des na 'di ltabu'i theg chen bla na med pa'i chos zab mo la skur pa 'debs pa rnams dmyal ba'i rgyu kho nar bas so/ ding sang phyag rgya pa 'di dar cing bla ma dang chos kyi che ba bajiod pa la mkhas pa ma gtogs/ chos drug dang rlung 'khrid ro snyoms la sogs pa thabs gegs sel zab mo mi yin dgu yin gtso/ rdzogs chen ye shes gsang rdzogs kyi 226

man ngag sna re tsam la mi snyan dgu snyan du btags par snang ngo / zhes bya ba gsungs so/ gsum pa gdams pa khyad par can gyis mjug bsdu ba ni/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma las/ 'dir gsang sngags la log par rtog pa ni gnyis te sgro 'dogs par byed pa dang / skur ba 'debs par byed pa'o/ snga ma ni tshar bcad par bya'o/ /phyi ma ni rjes su gzung bar bya'o/ 'di ltar 'di na kha cig gsang sngags kyi rgyud chen po mtha' dag gi dgongs pa yang mi shes/ bla ma dam pas kyang ma zin cing sdig pa'i bzhis gnyen brten pas gsang sngags kyi tshul ji lta bar ma shes par dgongs pa can gyi bka' la brten nas 'di skad du/ bdag cag ni gsang sngags pa'o/ bdag cag ni spyod pa thams cad bag yangs su byed cing phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ro zhes sgrogs shing gnas pa de dag ni ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la skur pa btab pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa dag sbags pas sangs rgyas kyi bsnan pa nub par byas pa dang / mngon spyod drag po byas pa dang / bud med dag bsten pas pham pa byung ba'i phyir ro/ zhes dang / de ltabu dag ni snying rje'i sems kyis tshar bcad par bya'o/ yang 'di na la la dag 'di skad du/ gsang sngags kyi tshul chen po ji lta bar mi shes par gsang snga gas kyi theg pa ci zhig bya/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang /lhan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gtsang ba de nyid la 'jug par bya'o/ 'di lha27

ltar bud med bsten pas ni mi tshangs par spyod pa'i pham pa 'ong la/ mngon spyod drag po byas pas ni srog gcod pa'i pham pa 'ong bas de la 'jug par mi bya'o thes rgyud kyi dgongs pa mi shes par skur pa 'debs pa de dag ni zab cing rgya che ba dbang po sgon po'i spyod yul sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying por gyur pa/ skal ba dang /bag chags dang / las 'phror ldan pa 'ga'i spyod yul du gyur pa yin pas de ltabu la skur pa 'debs pa de ni nges par sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom mi bya ste/ de bzhin gzhegs pa'i bka' la skur pa btab pa dang /chos zab mo spangs pa'i phyir ro/ zhes dang / de lta bu'i gang zag ni snying rje'i sems kyis rjes su gzung bar bya'o/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/༈ bcu bzhi pa rtsom pa po rang gi 'dod pa'i lha dang 'brel ba'i smon pa ni/ rmad byung a ti ya ga'i gseng lam nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi ye thes sku/ /khyab bdag 'jim dpal rdo rjer rab bsgrubs pa/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'e bsnan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ theg pa rmad du byung ba zab mo a sta yo ga ste rnal 'byor chen po'i gseng lam mam myur lam la brten nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi phung po gcig tu grub pa/ gnas lugs gzhi yi 'jam dpal bde gshegs snying po stong gsal sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba/ sgrub pa lam gyi 'jam dpal blo bur kun rtog gi 228

gnyen po tshogs gnyis zung 'jug la brten nas/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i 'ardom dpal khyab bdag ribs kun gyi mkhyen rab rdzogs pa rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i rang zhal mngon du gyur nas/ zhakhor ba ma stongs kyi bar mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bsnan pa rin po che rgyas shing spel ba la mthu thob par gyur cig ces so/༈ bco lnga pa pha rol rgol ba bcom pa'i sgo nas bsnan pa rgyas par smon pa ni / yang dag tshad ma gsum gyi nga ro yis/ /lta dman ri dwags tshogs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /theg mchog seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sa gsum khyab/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba ste/ lung rig man ngag gi tshad ma'am yang dag pa'i lam la brten nas/ lta ba dman pa la dga' zhing rtog ge tshur mthong gi gnas su 'phyan pa nges don snying po'i bstan pa la rgyab kyis phyogs te sgro skur smra ba'i ri dwags kyi tshogs rnams thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkri zhing / theg mchog bla med kyi chos tshul bzang po'i sgra dbyangs phyogs kun tu khyab pas gdul bya'i rgyud smin cing grol ba'i sa la bkod de/ tshe rabs kun tu mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgyas par byed nus par gyur cig ces pa ste/ sdud pa las/ ji ltar seng ge ri sul rgyu zhing 'jigs med par/ /srog chags phra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgrogs ltar/ /mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ /mu stegs can mang skrag byed 'jig lha29

rten sgra yang sgrogs/ /ces gsungs pa dang tshul mthun par snang la/ rgyas par ni mang du thos pa lung gi sprin 'khrigs shing / zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i skabs dag las bzhad zin to/ 'on kyang deng sang ni rgol snga phyi rtsod pa lhur len pa'i dus ma yin/ rang gi sgo gsum 'dul zhing sgrub pa lhur len pa'i dus su gsungs la/ lar snga rgol phyi rgol dpang po rnams tshad ma'i gzhung las byung ba ltar rnyed par dka' zhing / rigs pa'i sgo 'byed tsam rer bslab pa ma gtogs ched du gnyer bar mi bya ste/ tshad ma kun las btus pa las/ tshad ma dang gzhal bya nye bar brjod pa nyid kyis mu stegs pa'i 'dod pa snying po med pa'i phyir/der zhen pa rnams ldog pa'i don du 'di brtsams pa yin gyi/ 'di tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gzhug pa'i don du ni ma yin te/ rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro zhes dang / jo bo rje mar me mardod kyi zhal nas kyang / mngon sum rjes dpag dgos pa med/ /mu stegs rgol ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ de bas na bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis rang phyogs la chags nas don med par theg pa dang grub mtha' gzhan la mi dga' bas 'chad pa rtsod pa dang rtsom pa lta ci spos/ khong 'khrugs shing yid mi bde ba bskyed pa'i ngag 'chal rnam g.yeng gi gtam dag la yang 'jug par mi bya ste/ 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/ smra ba 230

la dga' ba dang / smra ba la dga' ba'i nyes pa mthong bar bya'o/ zhes dang / thos pas rgyags nas gus par mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par 'gyed pa'i smra ba rnams la chags/ /brjed par 'gyur zhing shes bzhin med par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /nang gi sems las shin tu ring bar 'gyur/ /lus dang sems kyang rab sbyangs ma yin gyur/ khengs pa dang ni dud pa mang por 'gyur//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /byis pa dam pa'i chos bsam rab tu nyams//sems ni mi nyan shin tu rtsub par 'gyur/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong dag dang rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rtag tu bla ma dag la gus pa med//sbags pa'i gtam dag la ni dga' ba skyed/ /snying po med la gnas shing shes rab nyams/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go zhes ngang / bdag ni sgrub snyam da ni ci bya zhes/ /'chi ba'i dus tshe byis pa mya ngan byed/ /gastang rnyed ma gyur shin tu sdug bsngal gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rtsabaskyod bzhin du 'gyur zhing g.yo ba ste/ /de ni de ltar the tshom 'gyur du nges/ /de ni nam yang blo brtan mi 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /gar la blta ba'i khrod na 'dug pa zhig /dpa' bo gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa bzhin//bdag nyid nan tan nyams par 'gyur bas te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni g.yo ldan yang zhing re chad 'gyur/ /phyir zhing phyir zhing rnam par 231

'gyod par 'gyur/ /'phags pa dam pa'i chos las rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /mthu chung bsdi snang dag gis dgar 'gyur te/ /mi shes ldan pa g.yo zhing 'gyur ba yin/ /spre'u ltar de yi sems ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go zhes dang / yun ring dus nas smra la dga' bas na/ /des ni bdag nyid dga' ba mi 'thob bo/ /chig gang dga' ba mtha' yas 'thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsams kyang mchog yin no/ /bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med / /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug /shun pa zos pa'i mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no//shing gi shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro ltabu ni de yi don sems yin/ /de lta bas na smra la dga' spongs te/ /rtag tu bag yod byos la don soms shig /ces gsungs pa ltar snying pos dben pa'i smra ba dang bstan pa'i gad bdar ram byi dor du rlom pas rtsod yig sogs pha rol po tshar gcod par 'dod kyang rang nyid ngal ba bskyed pa'i rgyur zad pas na/ blo ldan rnams kyis bayag rnga'i rtse mo bzhin dam pa gong ma mi kha dang gling gzhi ngan pas ma gos pa tshad thub skyes bu dag gi rnam thar skyong ba la bslab par bya'o/༈ bcu drug pa theg pa thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur pa la smon pas rgyas btab pa ni/ rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i gos bzang rtser/ /'od gsal 232

rdo rje snying po'i tog mdzes pa/ /phyobs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mtho//mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ lung a nu yo ga'am rjes su rnal 'byor man chad bstan pa yongs rdzogs gos bzang ste rgyal mtshan gyi gzusas su bkod pa la/ slob dpon chen po pad ma dang bī ma la mi tra bee ro tsa na gsum las brgyud pa kun mkhyen klong chen yab sras kyis rgya cher gsal bar mardod pa snying thig 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs ni gong du ji skad bshad pa ltar theg pa thams cad kyi rtse mo zhi sgo gnyis su med pa 'di las gong du theg pa dang grub mtha' zhes pa rdul tsam yang ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rin po che tog gi gzugs su bkod pa ste/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ mnyam nyid don rtosas rang rig rgyal po ni/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu klung kun 'bab ltar/ /bla med don rtogs thabs chen 'di dag tu/ /rnam thar theg pa bsam yas ma lus 'dus//zhes gsungs pa bzhinano/ de ltar bdud dang mu stegs dang phas kyi rgol ba gang gis glasas mi rnyed cing zil gyis mnon pa'i skabs mi thob pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba rdzogs chen bstan pa'i btsas gsum gyi byin rlabs las byung ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid kyi rgyal mtshan srid pa gsum gyi bla na rtag tu bsgreng zhing / mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che tshangs chen gyi bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cis ces pa ste/233
